Building on this observation, the paper proposes Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation (CSCR), which uses the difference between the two counterfactual shifts, rather than their absolute magnitude, to measure a token’s true sensitivity to the outcome, and reallocates token-level advantages accordingly, avoiding uniform gradients on non-polar surface tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Diagnostic experiments are run on typical RLVR domains such as math and code over long-CoT trajectories. At threshold λ=0.05, 82.4%–84.7% of tokens are insignificant under both conditions and only 8.2%–10.4% are significant under both; among those, 91.4%–95.8% share the same sign; about 58% of forward-KL optimization magnitude overlaps between the two opposing conditions; large-shift tokens are concentrated in surface-form words. Under the same RLVR framework, CSCR provides consistent gains over GRPO and OPSD-style baselines. The provided excerpt cuts off before full numerical results (model sizes and absolute scores are not fully shown), but the diagnostic statistics alone already support the main claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: Must read. The counterfactual construction in Section 1 (Table 1 and Figure 1), together with the definitions of z^pos and z^neg and the interpretation of the “same-sign ratio”, is the key to the whole paper and should be read carefully with the formulas. The forward-KL overlap and the qualitative analysis of surface tokens are the most direct rebuttal of the premise behind OPSD-style methods. In the method section, focus on how CSCR converts the difference between counterfactual shifts into advantage-reallocation weights without introducing an additional teacher. In ablations, look at stability across thresholds λ and at whether sensitive tokens concentrate on genuine reasoning steps (arithmetic operations, key lemma invocations, critical code statements). A good direction to dig deeper: whether counterfactual sensitivity overlaps with tokens identified by process reward models, attention weights, or logit-lens “decision tokens”, and whether sparsity worsens as CoT length grows.

recommendation.zh: 直接动摇GRPO/OPSD的token级信用分配基础，应立刻在内部RLVR实验中复现反事实评分诊断，§3的符号反转分析是核心。
recommendation.en: Directly undermines the token-level credit allocation foundation of GRPO/OPSD; immediately replicate the counterfactual re-scoring diagnosis in internal RLVR experiments, with §3 sign-reversal analysis as the core.

paper.title: ReDiPPO: Reference-Guided Value Calibration and Discrepancy-Aware Token Reweighting for Mathematical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Among existing policy optimization methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) remains particularly appealing because its learned critic can, in principle, provide token-level credit assignment. However, in mathematical reasoning tasks characterized by long reasoning horizons and sparse outcome rewards, reliable token-level credit assignment remains challeng

summary.core_problem: 数学推理长轨迹、稀疏结果奖励场景下，标准PPO的critic无法准确评估中间推理状态，导致优势估计噪声大、策略更新次优。
summary.importance: 方法改进，针对RLVR长horizon信用分配痛点，在PPO框架下引入训练时特权信号校准critic，无需修改推理流程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReDiPPO框架：1）参考引导critic，训练时用正确参考答案作为特权信号辅助价值估计，推理时保留标准critic；2）差异感知token重加权，基于两类critic的估值差调整token权重，降低噪声梯度影响。
summary.experiments: 在主流数学推理基准上对比标准PPO基线，取得更高推理准确率，缓解了长轨迹下的价值估计偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard PPO critics fail to accurately evaluate intermediate reasoning states under long-horizon sparse outcome rewards in mathematical reasoning, causing noisy advantage estimates and suboptimal policy updates.
summary_en.importance: A method improvement targeting long-horizon credit assignment in RLVR, introducing training-time privileged signals to calibrate PPO critics without modifying inference pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ReDiPPO with two core components: 1) A reference-guided critic that uses ground-truth answers as privileged information during training to improve value estimation, while keeping a standard critic for inference; 2) Discrepancy-aware token reweighting that adjusts token-level weights based on value gaps between the two critics to reduce noisy gradients.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on standard mathematical reasoning benchmarks, outperforms vanilla PPO baselines and reduces advantage estimation noise on long reasoning trajectories.

recommendation.zh: PPO长推理链critic校准的小改进，未跳出特权信号训练的常规思路，做RLVR可扫一眼核心设计。
recommendation.en: A minor PPO critic calibration tweak for long reasoning chains; worth a glance if you work on RLVR, no fundamental new insight.

paper.title: SkillRise: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Cross-Task Skill Evolution
paper.abstract: Large language model agents often encounter related yet distinct tasks that share reusable solution patterns. Yet standard agentic reinforcement learning treats tasks as independent episodes, while existing approaches to skill learning either focus on repeated attempts of one task or use pipelines with multiple stages that entangle extraction, retrieval, and execution. We introduce SkillRise, a unified reinforcement learning framework for learning skills across tasks. SkillRise organizes related

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent强化学习方法将任务视为独立片段，无法有效积累跨任务可复用技能的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出统一的跨任务技能进化RL框架，解耦任务求解与技能管理的信用分配。
summary.technical_approach: 将相关实例组织为渐进难度序列，单策略交替执行任务求解和技能文档维护；用跨任务解耦信用分配，当前任务结果监督求解，下游折扣结果监督技能 curation。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld三个基准上测试，Pass@1超过所有对比基线，摘要未披露具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agentic RL methods treat tasks as independent episodes, failing to accumulate reusable skills across related LLM agent tasks.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation proposing a unified RL framework for cross-task skill evolution with decoupled credit assignment for solving and curation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organizes related instances into progressive difficulty sequences, a single policy alternates between task solving and curating an evolving skill document; decoupled cross-task credit assignment supervises solving with current outcome and curation with discounted downstream outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld benchmarks, achieves the strongest Pass@1 among compared methods, specific gain magnitude not disclosed in abstract.

recommendation.zh: Agent跨任务技能学习的增量方法，解耦信用分配的思路对RL后训练有微弱启发，看摘要和实验表即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental agent cross-task skill learning method, decoupled credit assignment gives weak insight for RL post-training, check abstract and tables only.

paper.title: CAST: Game Solvers as Turn-Level Teachers for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) to act in long-horizon games is a promising step toward generalist decision-making, yet reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies on sparse final rewards that reveal little about which decisions determine success. Denser process signals could supply this missing turn-level credit, but existing sources are hard to keep both cheap and accurate. We observe that changes in a game solver's state value reveal whether an action advances the state

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是长程决策场景里 RLVR 的 credit assignment 问题：最终胜负奖励太稀疏，无法告诉模型一条轨迹里哪些回合真正推动了成功。作者关心的不是一般意义上的游戏求解，而是如何把 solver 已有的状态价值信息，转成适合 LLM agent on-policy 学习的逐回合监督信号，而且不依赖 teacher logits。这个问题与预训练主线并不直接相连，但它涉及 post-train 阶段如何构造更高质量过程监督，对理解“可验证奖励 + 过程信号”接口有一定启发。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接影响有限，更接近 agent RL/post-train 方法。启发点在两处。第一，它说明在有外部可计算 teacher 的环境里，标量价值差就可能足够承载细粒度监督，不一定需要完整动作分布或昂贵搜索，这对代码执行、工具调用、可验证推理等场景有迁移意义。第二，它把 on-policy distillation 和 advantage-weighted RL 连接起来，给“过程监督从哪里来、如何稳定注入 PPO/RLVR”提供了一个干净例子。贡献量级上，属于一个设计扎实的训练信号方法，而不是会反过来改变预训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 CAST：Credit Assignment from Solver Teachers。对 LLM 在某个游戏状态 s 采样出的动作 a，solver 可以评估动作前后的状态价值 V(s) 和 V(s')。两者差值构成 solver advantage，表示这一步是否让状态更接近成功。作者把这个标量作为 turn-level process signal 注入 RLVR 目标，对每一步动作概率进行 advantage-weighted 更新。

论文的关键点不只是“用 value difference 做奖励 shaping”，而是给出一个 distillation 解释。作者在 soft-optimal solver 假设下证明，solver 隐式动作分布下某动作的 log-probability 与其一步状态价值变化严格成比例。因此，最大化 solver advantage 加权的策略目标，等价于把学生策略朝 solver 的隐式动作偏好做 on-policy distillation。这样就绕开了传统 distillation 需要 teacher logits 的要求；solver 只要能给状态价值或 cost-to-go，就足够提供监督。

为了让信号稳定，作者又加了两步轻量变换。第一，对 solver advantage 做 asinh 压缩，平滑处理极端值，保留小信号分辨率。文中把它解释为一种更鲁棒的 KL 约束近似。第二，做 batch-level RMS normalization，消除不同游戏、不同难度下数值尺度不一致的问题。这样同一套 RLVR 更新可以跨域使用，而不会被某个环境的 value scale 主导。

与已有方法相比，SFT on expert trajectories 只覆盖 solver 访问过的状态，模型一旦偏离就缺少指导；GiGPO 这类方法依赖跨轨迹比较；过程奖励模型又需要额外学习器和标注。CAST 的取舍是：假设存在 solver 或可近似 value network，用极低额外开销换取逐步监督，并保持 on-policy。
summary.experiments:
实验在 Sokoban、Minesweeper、Rush Hour 三类游戏上进行，分别覆盖长程规划、部分可观测推断、组合搜索约束。主结论是 CAST 在 in-domain 和 unseen-difficulty 设置下都优于 outcome-only RLVR baseline，也优于 process-level baseline GiGPO，并且达到 DAPO 峰值验证表现所需的训练步数更少，说明样本效率更高。

摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但全文强调几个结果。第一，solver overhead 很小，因为只需评估动作前后状态价值，不需要大规模搜索整条轨迹。第二，asinh 压缩和 RMS normalization 都是有效组件，去掉后训练更不稳定或跨游戏泛化变差。第三，用 learned value network 代替 exact solver 时，性能保留了大部分收益，说明方法不严格依赖可解析求解器。第四，训练在游戏上得到的策略还有一定 zero-shot transfer，到 held-out 的 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上无需额外微调也有收益，这一点更多说明学到的是某种通用决策偏好，而不只是记住游戏规则。

如果从方法可信度看，最重要的不是绝对分数，而是几组消融：solver-advantage weighting 是否优于 outcome-only；信号变换是否必要；exact solver 与 learned critic 的差距有多大；unseen difficulty 上是否仍保持优势。这些实验共同回答了“信号是否真在做 credit assignment，而不是仅仅提供更密集 reward”这个问题。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看方法图和理论部分，抓住一个核心：为什么一个标量 value difference 可以替代 teacher logits。只要这个等价关系成立，整篇论文就顺了。然后看训练目标如何与现有 RLVR/PPO 结合，再看 asinh 和 RMS 两个稳定化技巧。实验部分优先看三类游戏上的主表、sample efficiency 曲线、unseen difficulty 泛化，以及 exact solver vs learned value network 的对比。

阅读时要注意边界条件。这个方法依赖环境里存在足够强的 solver 或 value estimator，因此更适合可验证、可搜索、状态转移清晰的任务；对开放式语言任务，teacher 信号未必可得。另一个要点是它更像 post-train credit assignment 技术，而不是 pretrain 方法。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；如果你做 RLHF/RLVR、tool-use 或 code agent，可以再细看理论推导和 reward shaping 的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in long-horizon RLVR for LLM agents. Final win/loss rewards are too sparse to indicate which turns in a trajectory actually mattered. The authors ask how to turn solver-side state-value information into turn-level supervision that can be used on-policy by an LLM agent, without requiring teacher logits. This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface because it studies how stronger process signals can be injected into verifiable-reward training.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on foundation-model pretraining is limited; it sits closer to agent RL and post-training. The useful idea is that in environments with an external computable teacher, a scalar value difference may already contain enough information for fine-grained supervision. That has implications for code execution, tool use, and other verifiable settings where dense process labels are expensive but evaluators exist. A second contribution is conceptual: it connects on-policy distillation with advantage-weighted RL, giving a clean example of how process supervision can be derived rather than separately annotated. The contribution is a solid training-signal method, not a change in pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CAST, short for Credit Assignment from Solver Teachers, uses the solver as a turn-level teacher. For an action a sampled by the LLM at state s, the solver evaluates the state before and after the action, V(s) and V(s'). Their difference defines a solver advantage indicating whether the action moved the trajectory closer to success. This scalar is then injected into the RLVR objective as a turn-level process signal, weighting policy updates at the action level.

The important point is not just reward shaping. The paper gives a distillation interpretation. Under a soft-optimal solver assumption, the log-probability of an action under the solver’s implicit action distribution is strictly proportional to its one-step state-value change. Therefore, maximizing a solver-advantage-weighted objective is equivalent to on-policy distillation toward the solver’s action preferences. This avoids the usual requirement for teacher logits: a solver that can provide state values or cost-to-go is enough.

To stabilize training, the method applies two lightweight transformations. First, an asinh transform compresses extreme solver signals while preserving resolution near zero; the paper interprets this as a robustified KL-style constraint. Second, batch-level RMS normalization removes scale mismatch across games and difficulty levels. Together, these steps make the process signal numerically stable and comparable across domains.

Compared with expert-trajectory SFT, CAST remains useful when the model visits off-expert states. Compared with cross-trajectory comparison methods such as GiGPO, it uses direct local feedback. Compared with learned process reward models, it does not require a separate dense-labeling pipeline, provided a solver or a good value estimator exists.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are run on Sokoban, Minesweeper, and Rush Hour, chosen to cover long-horizon planning, partial-observation inference, and constrained combinatorial search. CAST outperforms outcome-only RLVR baselines and the process-level baseline GiGPO in both in-domain and unseen-difficulty settings. It also reaches DAPO’s peak validation performance in fewer training steps, indicating better sample efficiency.

The abstract does not include the full numeric tables, but the paper emphasizes several findings. Solver overhead is negligible because the method only needs local value evaluations rather than expensive full-trajectory search. Both asinh compression and RMS normalization matter; removing them hurts stability or cross-game robustness. Replacing the exact solver with a learned value network retains much of the gain, which is important for settings where exact solvers are unavailable. The trained policy also shows some zero-shot transfer to held-out ALFWorld and WebShop without further fine-tuning, suggesting that the method is not only memorizing game-specific trajectories.

For judging the paper, the most informative results are the ablations: solver-advantage weighting versus outcome-only RLVR, the necessity of the signal transformations, the gap between exact and learned teachers, and whether the advantage persists on unseen difficulty levels.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the method overview and the theory section. The central question is why a scalar value difference can stand in for teacher logits. Once that equivalence is clear, the rest of the method is straightforward. Then read how the objective is integrated into RLVR or PPO-style updates, followed by the two stabilization tricks, asinh compression and RMS normalization. In the experiments, prioritize the main tables on the three games, the sample-efficiency curves, the unseen-difficulty generalization results, and the exact-solver versus learned-value comparison.

Keep the boundary conditions in mind. The method assumes access to a strong solver or at least a reliable value estimator, so it is best suited to verifiable environments with clear state transitions. It is much less directly applicable to open-ended language generation. Also, this is primarily a post-training credit-assignment paper rather than a pretraining one. A useful skim should take around 20–30 minutes; readers working on RLHF, RLVR, tool use, or code agents may want to spend more time on the theoretical derivation and the shaping details.

recommendation.zh: 把“求解器 value 差分”当作可验证过程奖励很干净，适合复用到 RLVR/工具任务；重点看等价于 distill 的推导与信号尺度如何归一。
recommendation.en: Using solver value deltas as dense, verifiable process rewards is a clean RLVR trick; focus on the distillation equivalence and how they normalize/scale the per-turn signal.

paper.title: Hybrid Advantage Estimation with Unified Critic for VLM Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) now act as agents in interactive environments, where success requires coherent reasoning and decision-making across turns. Although end-to-end training in agentic environments can improve such multi-turn decision-making abilities, current methods mainly rely on either token-wise optimization over concatenated token trajectories or turn-wise optimization with uniform within-turn credit. In this work, we establish theoretical formulations for the two levels of o

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 VLM 多轮 Agent 强化学习中的信用分配问题。现有方法通常在两种粒度之间二选一：token-wise RL 把每个 token 当作动作，适合细粒度语言生成；turn-wise RL 把一整轮输出当作动作，更容易利用环境反馈。但多轮任务同时需要轮内生成质量和跨轮策略调整，单一粒度容易造成训练信号不匹配。论文关注的典型失败是模型只看最近观察，忽略过去动作和失败反馈，反复输出已经失败的动作。
summary.importance: 这篇工作和基座预训练的关系主要在 post-train/RL 接口。它讨论的是如何把多轮环境反馈转成适合 VLM policy 更新的 advantage 信号。对于预训练研究者，启发点在于：当模型从静态指令学习进入交互式任务时，训练目标的粒度会影响模型是否学到长期状态更新，而不只是单轮响应风格。统一 token 和 turn 两种价值估计，也降低了多头 critic 或多套训练目标带来的系统复杂度。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用 POMDP 形式化 VLM 多轮交互，把历史观察、动作、奖励和当前轮已生成 token 纳入状态历史。它分别推导 token-wise 和 turn-wise RL 的优化形式，并指出两者的策略梯度 surrogate 在结构上相同，关键差异集中在 advantage 估计。基于这个观察，论文提出 Hybrid Advantage Estimation：用线性组合同时融合 token 级和 turn 级 advantage，从而兼顾轮内 token 生成的细粒度学习和轮间环境反馈的策略学习。进一步地，论文说明在合适的折扣因子和学习目标选择下，同一个 critic 可以同时估计 token-wise value 和 turn-wise value，不需要为两种粒度维护完全独立的价值模型。最终方法 HyGAE 是一个 actor-critic 框架，训练 actor 时使用混合 advantage，训练 critic 时使用统一价值目标。论文还从偏差-方差角度解释混合估计为何比单一粒度更稳定。
summary.experiments: 论文在五个多轮决策 benchmark 上评估 HyGAE，并与多种 token-wise、turn-wise 以及层级式基线比较。报告的平均成功率为 0.91，在所比较方法中表现最好。消融结果显示，混合 advantage 的解析形式和 mixed return 的定义对稳定训练很关键；简单拼接或不精确地混合两种信号会削弱效果。定性分析展示了一个主要改进点：模型更能利用过去失败反馈调整后续动作，而不是在相似观察下重复错误输出。给定材料没有列出五个 benchmark 的名称、模型规模、训练数据量和逐项分数，精确数字需要查看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中的失败案例，理解论文为什么认为 VLM Agent 存在 nearsightedness。然后看 Preliminaries 和方法部分的 POMDP 定义、token-wise/turn-wise surrogate 推导，重点是“二者差异主要落在 advantage 估计”这一点。方法部分需要关注 hybrid advantage 的线性组合、统一 critic 的折扣因子和学习目标设置。实验部分优先看主结果表、混合 advantage 和 mixed return 的消融，以及训练稳定性曲线。若只关心可复用价值，重点读公式推导和 ablation 即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in multi-turn VLM agent reinforcement learning. Current methods usually choose either token-wise RL, where every token is treated as an action, or turn-wise RL, where an entire response turn is treated as one action. Token-wise training gives fine-grained language-generation signals, while turn-wise training uses intermediate environment feedback more naturally. Multi-turn agents need both. The failure mode highlighted by the paper is myopic behavior: the model reacts to the latest observation, ignores previous failed actions and feedback, and repeats an unsuccessful output.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model research is mainly through the post-training and RL interface. The paper studies how multi-turn feedback should be converted into advantage estimates for updating a VLM policy. The useful point is that the granularity of the RL objective changes what the model learns: single-turn response quality, within-turn token choice, or cross-turn strategy adaptation. A unified critic for both token-level and turn-level values can also simplify training compared with maintaining separate value models or loosely combining separate objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method starts from a POMDP formulation of VLM interaction, where the history includes observations, actions, rewards, and the prefix tokens generated in the current turn. The paper derives token-wise and turn-wise RL objectives and argues that their policy-gradient surrogates have the same gradient structure; the main difference lies in how the advantage is estimated. Based on this, it proposes Hybrid Advantage Estimation, a linear combination of token-level and turn-level advantages. This lets the policy receive fine-grained guidance for language generation and turn-level guidance from intermediate environment feedback. The paper further shows that, with a suitable discount factor and learning target, one critic can estimate both token-wise and turn-wise values. HyGAE instantiates this idea as an actor-critic algorithm, using the hybrid advantage for actor updates and a unified value target for critic training. The bias-variance discussion is used to motivate why the hybrid estimator can be more stable than either single-granularity estimator.
summary_en.experiments: HyGAE is evaluated on five multi-turn decision-making benchmarks against several token-wise, turn-wise, and hierarchical baselines. The reported average success rate is 0.91, the best among the compared methods. Ablations indicate that the exact analytic form of the hybrid advantage and the definition of the mixed return are important for stable optimization; naïve or imprecise mixing weakens performance. Qualitative analysis shows that the trained agent is better at using past failure feedback to change future actions instead of repeating the same failed response under similar observations. The provided text does not include the benchmark names, model sizes, training data scale, or per-task scores, so those details should be read from the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction and the failure example to understand the nearsightedness problem in VLM agents. Then read the POMDP setup and the derivation of token-wise and turn-wise surrogates, with attention to the claim that the main difference is advantage estimation. In the method section, focus on the hybrid advantage formula, the unified critic target, and the discount-factor choice. In the experiments, read the main result table, the ablations on hybrid advantage and mixed return, and any stability curves. For reuse, the most important parts are the derivation and the ablation evidence.

recommendation.zh: 读理论推导和 ablation 即可；若 unified critic 真稳，会影响多轮 RLVR 的 credit assignment 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and ablations; if the unified critic is actually stable, it is a useful signal for multi-turn RLVR credit assignment.

paper.title: Progress-conditioned Group Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
paper.abstract: Group-based policy optimization has been increasingly used to train large language model (LLM) agents from sparse outcome rewards by comparing trajectories or steps within a group. However, on difficult long-horizon tasks, this comparison can suffer from a sampling imbalance: repeated or low-effect actions dominate the high-probability region of the policy while useful state-changing actions remain under-sampled. This imbalance produces many all-failed rollout groups, where outcome rewards provi

summary.core_problem: 在长序列任务的组策略优化（Group Policy Optimization）中，当所有采样轨迹都失败时，基于结果奖励的优势估计器（如 GRPO）会失效，导致模型陷入“重复低效动作”的信用陷阱（credit trap）。
summary.importance: 针对长序列推理和 Agent 任务中稀疏奖励导致的训练停滞问题，提出了一种无需额外辅助模型或密集奖励的 fallback 机制，对改进 RLHF/RLAIF 在复杂任务上的探索效率有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出进度条件组策略优化（ProGPO）。核心思想是利用“首次访问的观察覆盖率（first-visit observation coverage）”作为进度的代理指标。在所有轨迹均失败的组（all-fail groups）中，如果某一步转移到了该轨迹中未曾访问过的新观察状态，则视为有进度；而重复或停滞的动作则无进度。基于此计算非零的优势值，鼓励模型探索新状态。当组内出现结果差异（有成功有失败）时，ProGPO 会精确回退到标准的基于奖励的优势估计。
summary.experiments: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 两个具有挑战性的 Agent 基准测试上，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct 模型进行实验。结果表明，在相同的计算约束下，ProGPO 持续优于现有的强组策略基线方法（如 GRPO、GiGPO、HGPO）。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对“credit trap”的定义和图解（Fig. 1, Fig. 2），以及 Methodology 中 ProGPO 的具体优势计算公式，理解其如何平滑地在 fallback 机制和标准机制间切换。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In group-based policy optimization for long-horizon tasks, when all sampled trajectories fail, outcome-based advantage estimators (like GRPO) fail to provide learning signals, trapping the model in a cycle of repeated low-effect actions (the 'credit trap').
summary_en.importance: Provides a fallback mechanism to address training stagnation caused by sparse rewards in long-horizon reasoning and Agent tasks, without requiring auxiliary models or dense rewards. It offers direct insights for improving exploration efficiency in RLHF/RLAIF for complex tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Progress-conditioned Group Policy Optimization (ProGPO). The core idea uses 'first-visit observation coverage' as a proxy for progress. In all-fail groups, a step transitioning to an unvisited observation within the trajectory is credited as progress, while repetitive actions receive none. This generates non-zero advantages to encourage exploration. When outcome variation exists (both successes and failures in a group), ProGPO exactly reverts to standard reward-based advantage estimation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on two challenging agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop, using Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct models. Results show ProGPO consistently outperforms strong existing group-based baselines (e.g., GRPO, GiGPO, HGPO) under the same computational constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the definition and illustration of the 'credit trap' (Fig. 1, Fig. 2), and the Methodology for the specific advantage calculation formulas of ProGPO, understanding how it smoothly transitions between the fallback and standard mechanisms. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 advantage 构造即可；它提醒 RL Agent 的失败组不是噪声，而是会锁死策略的训练信号缺口。
recommendation.en: Read the advantage construction; the useful point is that all-failed groups are not noise but a training-signal hole that can trap the policy.

paper.title: AttriMem: Attribution-Guided Process Feedback for Agent Memory Learning
paper.abstract: Effective memory is crucial for LLM agents, yet constructing it effectively remains challenging. A memory-construction policy decides what information to extract, store, update, compress, or discard as interactions accumulate. Heuristic memory methods rely on subjective, task-specific rules, which can misalign with downstream objectives and limit cross-task adaptability. RL-based methods, by contrast, learn from task feedback but mainly use outcome- or module-level rewards. These coarse signals

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 的记忆构建策略需要在长交互中决定抽取、存储、更新、压缩、丢弃哪些信息。现有 RL 记忆学习方法主要依赖结果级或动作级奖励，无法指出中间记忆内容中哪些具体 token 真正支撑了最终答案，存在细粒度信用分配瓶颈；而人工构造中间过程的 ground truth 又因推理轨迹的不确定性而不可行。
summary.importance: 对 Agent 记忆学习的过程监督设计有参考价值，属于 post-train / Agent 方法范畴，与基座预训练的直接关联较弱。核心启发在于：把最终任务表现通过归因（attribution）转化为对中间记忆输出的 token 级密集奖励，是一种不依赖人工过程标注的细粒度反馈构造方式，思路上与把 outcome reward 反传到中间过程的其他 credit-assignment 技术相通。
summary.technical_approach: AttriMem 在标准 RL 记忆学习流水线之上增加一层归因引导的过程反馈。训练时，策略先产生中间记忆输出，固定的检索-回答接口生成最终答案，结果奖励评估整体任务表现。在此之外，AttriMem 通过遮蔽记忆 token 的不同子集、观测最终答案得分的变化，估计每个记忆 token 对最终答案的贡献度；再把这些 token 级分数映射回产生它们的记忆动作，转化为局部过程奖励，与全局结果奖励结合用于策略优化。这样策略不仅知道任务整体是否成功，也知道每个记忆动作内部哪些内容真正有用。
summary.experiments: 节选内容未给出具体实验设置和数值结果，仅从问题定义和方法动机层面描述了与启发式记忆方法、任务性能 RL、结果重分配奖励（如 Mem-T）、QA 派生动作奖励（如 MemBuilder）的区别。完整论文应包含在长交互记忆基准（如 LoCoMo、LongMemEval 类）上的对比，但具体数字需查阅正文。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–20 分钟。主要看方法部分的归因奖励如何构造（遮蔽策略、贡献度估计、token 级到动作级的聚合方式），以及它与 Mem-T、MemBuilder 等在反馈粒度上的差异。对基座预训练研究者而言，可借鉴其“用输出变化反传中间过程信用”的思路，但不必深挖 Agent 实验细节。

summary_en.core_problem: An LLM agent's memory-construction policy must decide what to extract, store, update, compress, or discard across long interactions. Existing RL-based memory-learning methods rely mainly on outcome- or action-level rewards, which cannot identify which specific tokens in intermediate memory contents actually support the final answer, creating a fine-grained credit-assignment bottleneck. Manually constructing ground-truth process labels is infeasible because the relevant evidence depends on the agent's own reasoning trajectory.
summary_en.importance: Relevant to process-supervision design for agent memory learning; sits in the post-train / agent-method space and is only loosely connected to base-model pretraining. The main useful idea is converting final task performance into dense, token-level rewards over intermediate memory outputs via attribution, providing fine-grained feedback without manual process annotations. This is conceptually related to broader credit-assignment techniques that propagate outcome reward back to intermediate steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: AttriMem adds an attribution-guided process-feedback layer on top of a standard RL memory-learning pipeline. During training, the policy produces intermediate memory outputs, a fixed retrieval-and-answering interface produces the final answer, and an outcome reward scores overall task success. Beyond this global reward, AttriMem masks different subsets of memory tokens and measures the resulting change in the final-answer score to estimate each token's contribution. These token-level scores are mapped back to the memory actions that produced them and converted into local process rewards, which are combined with the global outcome reward to update the policy. The policy thus receives feedback not only on overall success but also on which specific contents inside each memory action are useful.
summary_en.experiments: The excerpt does not include concrete experimental setups or numbers; it motivates the method by contrasting it with heuristic memory, task-performance RL, outcome-redistribution rewards (e.g., Mem-T), and QA-derived action rewards (e.g., MemBuilder). The full paper likely reports results on long-interaction memory benchmarks such as LoCoMo or LongMemEval, but specific figures require the main text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, about 15–20 minutes. Focus on how the attribution reward is constructed—the masking strategy, the contribution estimator, and the aggregation from token-level scores back to action-level rewards—and how its feedback granularity differs from Mem-T and MemBuilder. For pretraining researchers, the transferable idea is the general pattern of inferring intermediate credit from output perturbations; the agent-specific experimental details can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: Agent记忆信用分配的新解法，归因引导过程反馈的思路可迁移到长期记忆训练，重点看§3反馈生成逻辑
recommendation.en: Novel solution for agent memory credit assignment; attribution-guided process feedback transfers to long-term memory training, check §3 for feedback generation logic

paper.title: From Agent Failures to Text Policies: What Works and What Breaks
paper.abstract: TextGrad improves language-model systems by revising text from feedback. Its core thesis is that natural-language feedback can act as a gradient for optimizing text components without changing model weights. Applying it to agents is harder because feedback arrives only after a sequence of actions, making it difficult to identify which decision caused failure. We study this problem by separating the ability to follow a useful policy from the ability to learn that policy from experience. Our main

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究把 TextGrad 式“自然语言反馈当梯度”用于 agent 时，为什么常常学不出有效的文本策略。
summary.importance: 价值主要在负结果和问题拆解：它把“策略文本本身是否有用”和“能否从失败轨迹中学出这种文本”分开，指出 agent 级文本优化的瓶颈不在执行，而在 credit assignment 与候选策略生成/选择。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 TextWorldExpress 环境中，固定两个 7B agent，分别测试三类设置：人工编写策略文本、从 agent 轨迹自动生成策略文本、以及带更丰富轨迹/反事实证据/迭代 GEPA 搜索的改进版本。核心设计是用 frozen agent 隔离“follow policy”能力，再单独考察“learn policy from experience”能力。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是两个冻结的 7B agent，在 TextWorldExpress 上评估任务成功率。结果显示，人工策略可带来约 5 个 success point 提升，证明有用的文本策略确实存在；但从失败轨迹自动归纳出的策略，整体上不能稳定超过固定 prompting，即便加入 richer traces、counterfactual evidence 或 iterative GEPA search 也不稳。论文更像 clean negative result，而不是提出新方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why TextGrad-style natural-language feedback fails to reliably improve agents when feedback is only available after multi-step action sequences.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly diagnostic: it cleanly separates whether useful policy text exists from whether such policy can be learned from trajectories, and argues that the bottleneck is credit assignment plus policy generation/selection rather than policy execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using TextWorldExpress and two frozen 7B agents, the authors compare human-written policy text, trajectory-derived policy text, and stronger variants with richer traces, counterfactual evidence, and iterative GEPA search. Freezing the agent isolates policy-following ability from policy-learning ability.
summary_en.experiments: The setup evaluates task success on TextWorldExpress with two frozen 7B agents. Human-written policies improve success by about 5 points, showing that useful textual policies do exist. In contrast, policies induced from trajectories do not reliably beat fixed prompting, even with richer traces, counterfactual evidence, or iterative search. This is more a clean negative result than a new method paper.

recommendation.zh: 负结果比方法本身更有价值：它提醒你别把“LLM能执行文本策略”误当成“能从轨迹学出文本策略”，看 abstract 和实验表就够了。
recommendation.en: The negative result is the point: do not confuse an agent's ability to follow textual policy with the ability to learn one from trajectories; abstract plus main table is enough.

paper.title: S2T-RLHF: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for Stable Preference-Based RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) with preference-based reward models often exhibits unstable training dynamics. A key contributing factor is that standard RLHF relies on a single sequence-level scalar reward, which is propagated to token-level policy updates and leaves credit assignment within a response inherently ambiguous. Recent work has attempted to address this issue by refining rewards into denser token-level supervision, often relying on the implicit assumption that fine

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作针对 RLHF 里一个很核心但长期没有处理干净的问题：偏好奖励通常只在整段回答级别给一个标量，而策略更新发生在 token 级，导致 credit assignment 含糊、梯度方差大、训练不稳，尤其在长回答上更明显。作者进一步指出，问题不只是“奖励太稀疏”，而是“奖励粒度和语言语义结构不匹配”。如果把一个本来只在 response 级定义、且带噪声的偏好信号，强行细化到 token 级，未必更好，反而可能把 reward model 的局部误差放大，造成长度偏置、奖励集中和 collapse。论文要解决的，是如何在不重训 reward model、也没有 token 级标注的前提下，构造一种更稳定的层次化 credit assignment。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain 主线来说，这不是预训练论文，但它和 pretrain↔posttrain 接口关系很紧。原因有三点。第一，RLHF 的稳定性会反过来影响人们如何理解 base model 的可塑性、长度泛化和 reward hacking 边界。第二，这篇工作提出的“奖励粒度要和语义粒度对齐”这个观点，不只适用于 RLHF，也会影响对 masked LM、diffusion LM、latent reasoning、过程监督等训练信号设计的理解。第三，它把 dense reward 设计从“越细越好”改成“在合适层级上细化”，这对未来把 RL 信号引入 continual pretrain、reasoning post-train、甚至 RL-style pretraining 都有启发。贡献量级上，它更像是对 RLHF credit assignment 设计原则的一次扎实修正，而不是单纯加一个 heuristic。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 S2T-RLHF，核心是两阶段层次化分配：先 sentence-level，再 token-level。作者的出发点很明确：句子通常是人类偏好判断更稳定的语义单元，token 只是句子内部的词法和句法实现。如果直接把 sequence reward 平摊或细分到 token，容易把本来模糊的全局偏好变成高噪声局部监督。因此他们先把整段回答切成句子级单元，在句子层面做结构化 cooperative allocation，再在每个句子内部做有界的 token-level refinement。

从全文描述看，S2T-RLHF 保持 reward model 固定，只使用 sequence-level reward。第一阶段的句子级分配，目标是把全局偏好信号分解到语义上相对完整、可解释的句子单元，而不是任意 token span。这里“structured cooperative allocation”意味着句子不是独立打分，而是作为共同组成整段回答的协作单元来分配总奖励，避免把全局偏好简单地局部化。第二阶段的 token refinement 则是 bounded 的，也就是 token 级修正幅度受控，不允许 token 级信号偏离句子级语义太远。这个约束很关键，因为作者的核心论点就是：过细粒度会放大噪声，所以 token 级只能做局部微调，不能主导奖励结构。

论文还在附录里给出理论讨论，主要围绕三件事：sequence-level reward 如何诱导全局 advantage alignment；长序列上方差如何放大；以及长度依赖的梯度缩放问题。S2T 的两阶段设计对应地缓解了这三类问题：句子级分配缩短了 credit propagation 路径，降低长程方差；token 级 bounded refinement 保留一定局部可塑性，但不至于把噪声扩散到每个 token；层次化结构也更容易抑制长度偏置，因为奖励不再简单按 token 数量传播。

和已有 dense reward / token-level credit 方法相比，差别不在于“更细”，而在于“先在合适语义层级上聚合，再有限地下钻”。这和很多 RLHF 工作默认 finer-grained is better 的思路相反，也是这篇论文最值得注意的地方。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的主结论是：S2T-RLHF 在多个数据集和优化设置下，提高了训练稳定性和鲁棒性，同时保持有竞争力的偏好对齐效果。全文片段没有给出完整表格数字，因此不能编造具体提升幅度，但从引言和方法描述可以明确，作者重点比较了标准 sequence-level RLHF、若干更细粒度的 credit assignment 基线，以及自己的层次化方法。

应重点关注的实验信号包括：1）训练曲线是否更平稳，是否减少 reward collapse 或剧烈震荡；2）长度分布是否更健康，是否缓解了长回答被过度奖励或惩罚的问题；3）在不同 PPO/DPO 类优化设定或不同 preference dataset 上，方法是否保持一致收益；4）句子级分配和 token-level bounded refinement 各自的消融作用。按论文主张，最关键的消融应该是：只做句子级、不做 token refinement；直接 token-level refinement；以及不同 refinement 强度上限。若这些实验成立，就能支持作者的核心判断：稳定性来自语义粒度匹配，而不是单纯增加监督密度。

如果精读全文，建议特别查具体实验设置：基座模型规模、reward model 是否统一、回答平均长度、句子切分方式、以及训练中 KL 系数和 advantage normalization 的处理。因为这类方法的收益往往和序列长度、奖励噪声、以及 policy update 强度强相关。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇虽然被标成 skim，但如果你关心 RLHF 稳定性，值得比普通 skim 多花一点时间。建议先读 Introduction，把作者反对“越细粒度越好”的论证读明白。然后直接看 Method，重点抓住两阶段设计各自解决什么问题：为什么先句子后 token；为什么 token refinement 必须 bounded；它和 reward shaping 或 token-level RM 有什么不同。实验部分优先看训练稳定性曲线、长度相关分析、主结果表和消融。附录里关于 variance amplification 和 length-dependent gradient scaling 的理论讨论也值得扫一遍，因为它解释了为什么长回答 RLHF 特别容易出问题。预计 45-60 分钟可以读完主线；如果要判断是否可用于自己的训练栈，消融和附录需要再多看一轮。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a central RLHF issue: preference rewards are usually defined at the whole-response level, while policy optimization happens at the token level. That creates ambiguous credit assignment, high-variance gradients, and unstable learning, especially for long generations. The authors make a sharper claim than the usual “reward is too sparse” diagnosis. Their argument is that the granularity of the reward signal is mismatched with the semantic structure of language. If a noisy response-level preference is aggressively refined into token-level supervision, the refinement can amplify uncertainty and local reward-model artifacts instead of improving optimization. The problem, then, is how to derive denser but more stable credit signals without retraining the reward model or requiring token-level annotations.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it speaks directly to the pretrain–posttrain interface. Stable RLHF changes how we think about model plasticity, long-horizon optimization, and reward hacking. More importantly, the paper proposes a useful design principle: reward granularity should align with semantic granularity. That idea extends beyond RLHF and is relevant to process supervision, latent reasoning, non-AR objectives, and any setting where training signals are projected onto finer units than the original supervision naturally supports. The contribution is less about adding another heuristic and more about correcting a common assumption in dense reward design: finer is not always better.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, S2T-RLHF, uses a two-stage hierarchical credit assignment scheme: sentence level first, token level second. The motivation is simple and well argued. Human preferences are often expressed over semantically coherent units such as claims, instructions, refusals, or stylistic choices, and sentences are a much better proxy for those units than individual tokens. Tokens mostly realize sentence meaning through lexical and syntactic choices. So instead of directly decomposing a sequence-level reward into token-level rewards, the method first allocates reward across sentence-level units and only then performs bounded token-level refinement within each sentence.

A key design choice is that the reward model remains fixed and only sequence-level preference rewards are used. In the first stage, the global reward is distributed over sentence units through a structured cooperative allocation mechanism. The wording suggests that sentences are treated as jointly contributing parts of the response, rather than independently scored fragments. That matters because a response-level preference often depends on interactions across sentences, not just local quality. In the second stage, token-level refinement is explicitly bounded. This is crucial: the paper’s main thesis is that unconstrained fine-grained refinement can inject instability, so token-level signals are allowed only as local adjustments around a sentence-level semantic anchor.

The appendices reportedly provide theoretical discussion around three issues: how sequence-level rewards induce global advantage alignment, how variance amplifies over long horizons, and how gradients scale with response length. The S2T design addresses these by shortening the effective credit-assignment path through sentence-level decomposition, while preserving limited local flexibility through bounded token refinement. Compared with prior dense-reward or token-level credit methods, the novelty is not “more granularity” but “the right granularity first, then controlled refinement.”
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical claim is that S2T-RLHF improves training stability and robustness across multiple datasets and optimization settings while maintaining competitive preference alignment performance. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains should not be fabricated. Still, the experimental intent is clear: compare standard sequence-level RLHF, finer-grained credit-assignment baselines, and the proposed hierarchical method.

The most important signals to inspect are: whether training curves are smoother; whether reward collapse or severe oscillation is reduced; whether response-length behavior becomes healthier; whether the method remains effective across different optimization setups; and whether the gains come specifically from the sentence-first hierarchy rather than from simply adding denser supervision. The critical ablations should include sentence-level allocation alone, direct token-level refinement, and different bounds on token refinement strength. If those ablations are convincing, they support the paper’s central claim that stability comes from semantic alignment of reward granularity, not from maximizing reward density.
summary_en.reading_guide: Although labeled skim, this one deserves more attention if RLHF stability is part of your work. Start with the introduction and make sure the paper’s argument against “finer is always better” is clear. Then read the method section with two questions in mind: why sentence-level units are the right intermediate granularity, and why token-level refinement must be bounded. In the experiments, prioritize training-stability plots, length-related analyses, the main comparison table, and the ablations. The appendix discussion on variance amplification and length-dependent gradient scaling is also worth scanning because it explains why long-form RLHF is particularly fragile. Around 45–60 minutes should be enough for the main thread; more time is needed if you want to judge whether the method would transfer to your own RLHF stack.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法动机和稳定性实验；若结果扎实，应复现“句子粒度优于 token 粒度”这个 RLHF 信号设计 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the motivation and stability ablations; if the evidence is clean, the sentence-level-over-token-level credit prior is worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: H$^2$SD: Hybrid Hindsight Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models on tasks such as mathematical reasoning and code generation. However, most RLVR methods assign a scalar outcome reward to an entire trajectory, resulting in sparse supervision and limited token-level credit assignment. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides denser supervision by distilling token-level distributions from a stronger teacher model, but requires an addi

summary.core_problem: RLVR 奖励稀疏、token 级信用分配弱；现有 on-policy 自蒸馏直接匹配教师分布易信息泄漏且优化不稳，RLSD 只调制更新幅度不提供纠偏方向。
summary.importance: 提出混合事后自蒸馏 H²SD，在 token 级融合 reward 信号与自蒸馏方向，试图兼顾信用分配密度与优化稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 在 OPSD 框架下，利用特权信息构造同模型教师，结合类似 RLSD 的幅度调制与显式分布纠偏方向（摘要截断，具体融合机制未展开），避免直接全分布匹配带来的泄漏。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体参数量/数据集/基线对比数值（仅方法动机描述）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哈工大（秦兵、冯骁骋、桂韬团队）等，偏后训练方法方向；无顶级机构署名。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR suffers from sparse outcome rewards and weak token-level credit assignment; on-policy self-distillation leaks information and is unstable, while RLSD modulates update magnitudes but provides no corrective direction.
summary_en.importance: Proposes Hybrid Hindsight Self-Distillation (H²SD) that blends token-level reward shaping with self-distillation directions to densify credit assignment without destabilizing optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds on OPSD by constructing a same-model teacher via privileged information, then combines RLSD-style magnitude modulation with an explicit corrective direction, avoiding full teacher-distribution matching that causes leakage (abstract truncated).
summary_en.experiments: Abstract provides no concrete model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative results; method-motivation only in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: RLVR+自蒸馏的常规增量，思路合理但缺关键实验；可作post_train文献备查，不必细读。
recommendation.en: An incremental RLVR + self-distillation combo; read only if you work on credit assignment, otherwise skip given missing experiments in the abstract.

paper.title: Semantic Cooperative Games for Contribution Attribution in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Contribution attribution has become a central problem in LLM-based multi-agent systems, where final outputs are produced through multiple agents, message exchanges, and ordered workflow dependencies. Existing attribution methods often rely on counterfactual valuation, such as removing agents or comparing score changes across altered agent subsets. In language-mediated workflows, these methods require repeated model calls, introduce high variance, and do not explicitly capture the intermediate se

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 多 Agent 工作流中如何低成本、低方差地归因各 Agent 对最终输出贡献的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多 Agent 系统的 attribution 方法。它不直接服务预训练，但对 agentic training data、trajectory credit assignment 和多 Agent workflow 诊断有旁路价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Semantic Cooperative Games，把一次实际语言流表示为 semantic generation hypergraph，并在该结构上定义 agent-level semantic value function。进一步定义 Semantic Shapley Value，用语义支撑逻辑分配贡献；SLIC 算法从单条 trajectory 构造语义超图并恢复最小语义支撑，而不是反复移除 Agent 做 counterfactual valuation。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出任务集、模型、baseline 或数值结果。预期实验会比较 SSV/SLIC 与传统 counterfactual Shapley 或 ablation-based attribution，在调用成本、方差和归因一致性上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles contribution attribution in LLM-based multi-agent workflows, where final answers arise from multiple agents, messages, and ordered dependencies.
summary_en.importance: This is a multi-agent attribution method. It is not directly about pretraining, but it can inform agentic training-data analysis, trajectory credit assignment, and workflow debugging.
summary_en.technical_approach: Semantic Cooperative Games represents a realized language flow as a semantic generation hypergraph and defines an agent-level semantic value function over that structure. It introduces the Semantic Shapley Value to allocate contribution through semantic support logic, and SLIC constructs the hypergraph and recovers minimal semantic supports from a single trajectory rather than repeatedly running counterfactual agent removals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose tasks, models, baselines, or numerical results. The expected experiments would compare SSV/SLIC with counterfactual Shapley or ablation-based attribution on call cost, variance, and attribution consistency.

recommendation.zh: 读定义即可，不必追实验；若你在做 agent trajectory 训练，semantic credit assignment 可能比删 Agent 更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the definitions, not the experiments; for agent-trajectory training, semantic credit assignment may be cleaner than agent deletion.

paper.title: Distilled Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-training
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) post-training is essential for improving reasoning, adaptation, and alignment. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, RL relies on coarse-grained outcome supervision, resulting in difficult credit assignment and limited capability to acquire new knowledge. OPD, meanwhile, unconditionally matches teacher logits through KL divergence, which creates a dilemma: similar teachers provide little new

summary.core_problem: LLM后训练中RL存在信用分配难、难以吸收新知识的问题，而策略内蒸馏（OPD）无条件模仿教师logits，跨家族教师常导致训练失效。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次将教师监督以选择性方式融入RL目标，统一解决RL粗粒度监督和OPD无条件模仿的双重缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Distilled RL，包含三个核心组件：带裁剪的反向重要性采样以稳定离策略教师信号、负样本重置避免错误知识迁移、序列级几何噪声注入提升泛化；在RL奖励项外引入教师条件KL项实现选择性知识迁移。
summary.experiments: 在推理、对齐和知识获取三类后训练任务上对比纯RL、OPD及混合基线；在跨家族教师场景下显著优于OPD，同时保留RL的结果监督优势，在多个基准上获得稳定提升。

summary_en.core_problem: In LLM post-training, RL suffers from coarse outcome supervision and poor credit assignment, while on-policy distillation (OPD) unconditionally matches teacher logits and fails with substantially different cross-family teachers.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first framework that selectively integrates teacher supervision into the RL objective, jointly addressing the limitations of both coarse RL and unconditional OPD imitation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Distilled RL with three components: clipped reverse importance sampling to stabilize off-policy teacher signals, negative sample reset to avoid erroneous knowledge transfer, and sequence-level geometric noise injection for better generalization; adds a teacher-conditioned KL term alongside RL reward for selective knowledge transfer.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against pure RL, OPD, and hybrid baselines on reasoning, alignment, and knowledge-acquisition post-training tasks; outperforms OPD significantly in cross-family teacher settings while retaining RL's outcome-supervision advantages, delivering consistent gains across benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 做后训练的人应立刻在内部ablation复现反向重要性采样和负样本重置两个组件，跨家族教师蒸馏终于有了比硬KL更稳的配方。
recommendation.en: Post-training researchers should immediately reproduce the clipped reverse-importance-sampling and negative-sample-reset components in internal ablations — this gives a more stable recipe than vanilla KL for cross-family teacher distillation.

paper.title: Enhancing Rubric-based RL via Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Rubric-based RL has recently shown promise in improving LLMs on open-ended tasks. A widely recognized limitation of rubric-based RL is limited exploration: criteria that no rollout manages to satisfy (Unexplored Criteria, UC) receive no optimization signal. Recent methods address this by incorporating rubric information as external guidance during rollout, yet they introduce a train-inference mismatch: the policy is optimized on rollouts produced under external guidance while this guidance is ab

summary.core_problem: Rubric-based RL 在开放式任务中容易丢失细粒度 rubric 信号：未探索到的 criteria 没有奖励，已满足的 criteria 也可能被标量 reward 聚合压成非正 advantage。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练信号分析与方法改进。它指出 rubric RL 不只有 exploration failure，还有 Suppressed Criteria 这种 reward aggregation failure；这对预训练研究员有价值，因为它直接关系到 RL 信号质量、credit assignment 和用 scalar reward 训练生成模型时的偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 提出通过 self-distillation 增强 rubric-based RL。摘要显示方法重点是避免 rollout 阶段依赖外部 rubric guidance 导致的 train-inference mismatch，并把 criteria-level 的满足情况转化为更稳定的优化信号，减少 scalar reward aggregation 把有效 criteria 信号压掉的问题。具体算法细节和损失形式需要看正文确认。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出一个关键分析数字：超过 57% 的样本出现 Suppressed Criteria，即某些 rollout 已满足 criteria，但在标量 reward 聚合后对应学习信号丢失。摘要未披露模型规模、任务集、baseline、最终指标提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Rubric-based RL for open-ended tasks loses fine-grained rubric signals: unexplored criteria provide no reward, and even satisfied criteria can be suppressed by scalar reward aggregation.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training signal-analysis and method paper. Its useful point is that rubric RL suffers not only from exploration failure but also from a reward-aggregation failure called Suppressed Criteria, which matters for credit assignment and the quality of RL signals for generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a self-distillation approach for rubric-based RL. From the abstract, the method aims to avoid train-inference mismatch caused by externally guided rollouts and to preserve criterion-level satisfaction signals before they are washed out by scalar reward aggregation. The exact loss and algorithmic details require reading the full method section.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports one central diagnostic: more than 57% of samples exhibit Suppressed Criteria, where some rollouts satisfy a criterion but the scalar aggregate advantage gives no positive learning signal. Model scale, task suite, baselines, and final performance deltas are not available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 值得看失败模式定义和 57% 统计；若 setup 干净，应把 SC 诊断加进内部 RL 日志。
recommendation.en: Read the failure-mode definition and the 57% statistic; if the setup is clean, add SC diagnostics to internal RL logging.

paper.title: ToolVerse: Unlocking Massive Environments and Long-Horizon Tasks for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: While LLM agents demonstrate strong reasoning abilities in compact and well-defined scenarios, they struggle to maintain robustness and effectiveness when faced with large-scale, diverse, and dynamic real-world environments that demand seamless tool integration. To address this gap, we introduce ToolVerse, a comprehensive framework that scales up agentic RL environments and enables agents to perform complex long-horizon reasoning in Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) tasks. First, ToolVerse automat

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 agentic RL 缺少大规模、可执行、多工具、长链路训练环境的问题，同时处理长轨迹下稀疏奖励带来的 credit assignment 噪声。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在 post-train 与 RL 环境构造接口。它不是基座预训练方法论文，但对“如何把工具使用能力变成可扩展训练信号”有参考意义。关键点在于三件事：把真实 MCP tool schema 自动转成可执行环境；用工具依赖图生成多步任务，而不是随机拼接工具调用；在长轨迹 RL 中引入 turn-aware 的相对优势估计，减少只靠终局奖励训练带来的高方差。
summary.technical_approach: ToolVerse 包含三层设计。第一层是环境合成：从约 422 个真实 MCP 环境出发，重构 tool schema，清理函数签名和文本噪声，为每个工具构造领域状态字典数据库，再生成可执行 Python/MCP 函数，并用自动生成的单元测试筛掉不可运行工具集，最终形成约 4438 个工具的可执行 agent 环境。第二层是任务生成：为每个场景构建 Tool Dependency Graph，节点是工具，边表示前一个工具输出可作为后一个工具输入；再清理循环依赖和不可执行依赖，用 Dynamic Unlocking Sampling Algorithm 采样长链任务，使任务天然需要跨工具传递中间状态。第三层是训练信号：用 Turn-Aware Relative Advantage Estimation 处理长轨迹 credit assignment，把反馈拆到 turn 级别，避免所有动作共享同一个稀疏终局奖励。相比只做单工具环境或人工设计任务的 agent RL 工作，这里的核心差异是把环境、任务和优势估计一起做成可扩展管线。
summary.experiments: 可见内容给出的硬数字主要是环境规模：约 422 个真实 MCP environments，约 4438 个 tools，并产出 GUST 数据集用于 agentic RL 训练。摘要和正文片段声称该方法提升 tool-integrated reasoning benchmark 上的训练稳定性和表现，但提供材料未包含完整实验表格、模型规模、训练步数、baseline 数字、胜率或消融结果。可靠结论应限制在框架设计和环境规模；性能幅度需要读完整实验部分确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 3.1 的 executable MCP environment synthesis，确认 schema refactoring、状态数据库和单元测试过滤是否能稳定扩展；再看 3.2 的 Tool Dependency Graph 与 Dynamic Unlocking Sampling Algorithm，判断任务是不是由真实工具依赖驱动，而不是表面拉长轨迹；最后看 3.3 的 Turn-Aware Relative Advantage Estimation，重点检查 advantage 如何按 turn 分配、是否依赖额外 reward model、和 GRPO/PPO 类方法的关系。若要复现或借鉴，Appendix B.1/B.2 比主文更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in agentic RL: existing environments are too small, too narrow, and too weakly structured for training long-horizon tool use, while sparse terminal rewards make credit assignment noisy over multi-turn trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but useful. The paper is not about base-model pretraining, yet it studies how to turn tool use into scalable RL training signal. The main contribution is an environment-and-task generation pipeline, plus a turn-level advantage estimator for long-horizon interaction. This is relevant for post-training recipes where tool use, planning, and sequential decision making need executable supervision rather than static instruction data.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolVerse has three components. First, it converts real MCP tool definitions into executable environments. The pipeline refactors tool schemas, removes noisy signatures and descriptions, builds a domain-specific state dictionary for each environment, generates Python/MCP functions that read or update that state, and keeps only toolsets passing syntax and unit tests. Second, it builds a Tool Dependency Graph for each scenario. Tools are graph nodes, and edges encode whether the output of one tool can feed another. After removing cycles and non-executable dependencies, the Dynamic Unlocking Sampling Algorithm samples coherent long-horizon tasks from this graph. Third, it introduces Turn-Aware Relative Advantage Estimation, which assigns more granular feedback across turns instead of treating the full trajectory as receiving only one sparse terminal reward. The main distinction from earlier agent RL environments is that environment synthesis, task composition, and credit assignment are designed together.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports the environment scale: roughly 422 real-world MCP environments and about 4,438 tools, with a generated GUST dataset for agentic RL training. The paper claims improved stability and tool-integrated reasoning performance on agent benchmarks, but the supplied content does not include the experimental tables, model sizes, training budgets, baseline numbers, or ablation values. Any quantitative performance claim should be checked against the full experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Read Section 3.1 to assess whether the executable MCP conversion pipeline is robust enough to scale. Read Section 3.2 for the dependency-graph task generation, since this is where long-horizon structure is introduced. Read Section 3.3 to inspect the turn-aware advantage estimator and how it differs from standard sparse-reward GRPO/PPO-style training. Appendix B.1 and B.2 are likely the most useful parts for implementation details.

recommendation.zh: Agent RL的环境规模上到4500工具是有意义的，但缺实验数字；只看环境构造和TARA advantage设计即可。
recommendation.en: Scaling the agent RL environment to 4500 tools is meaningful, but no experimental numbers are given; read only the environment construction and TARA advantage design.

paper.title: LAPO: Leave-One-Turn Attribution for Self-Generated Process Rewards in Multi-Turn Search Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for multi-turn search reasoning typically relies on terminal outcome rewards, which cannot distinguish useful, redundant, and harmful intermediate interactions. We propose LAPO, a self-generated process-supervision method based on backward leave-one-turn attribution. For each search turn, LAPO replaces the turn and its retrieval observation with a fixed [DELETE] placeholder and measures the resulting change in the current policy's mean log-likelihood of the gold answer. Th

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决多轮搜索推理 RL 中的轨迹内 credit assignment 问题。只用最终答案对错作为 reward，会把同一条轨迹中的所有搜索动作一起奖励或惩罚，无法区分有用检索、冗余检索和误导检索。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不在基座预训练本身，而在 post-train 信号构造。它提供了一个值得借鉴的思路：过程监督不一定要来自外部 reward model、teacher 或 verifier，也可以从当前 policy 对 gold answer 的条件似然变化中构造。这个设计对 RL 训练中的信号质量、过程奖励自举、以及搜索增强推理的训练稳定性有启发。贡献量级是一个具体 RL recipe，适合泛读，不属于通用预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: LOTAPO 使用 backward leave-one-turn attribution 构造自生成过程奖励。给定完整多轮搜索轨迹，每个有效搜索 turn 包含模型生成的 search action 和环境返回的 observation。方法依次把某个 search turn 及其 observation 替换成固定的 [DELETE] 占位符，然后在保留下游交互不变的条件下，计算当前 policy 对 gold answer 的平均 log-likelihood 变化。若删除某个 turn 后 gold answer 似然下降，说明该 turn 对最终回答有正贡献；若似然上升，则说明该 turn 可能冗余或有害。这个 Answer-Likelihood Gain 被用作 turn-level attribution。为降低噪声，方法还做 robust scaling、tanh 有界变换、group normalization，并加入 sign-consistency gating：只有归一化后的 advantage 与原始 likelihood gain 在方向上一致时，才保留该过程信号。最终，搜索 turn 的 policy tokens 同时接收 GRPO 的终局 advantage 和 LOTAPO 的过程 advantage；最终答案 turn 仍只使用终局 reward。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖七个知识密集型问答数据集，评估多轮搜索推理场景下的 RL 训练效果。摘要和正文片段表明，LOTAPO 相比只用 outcome reward 的训练能提供更细粒度的中间步骤反馈，并且不需要额外训练过程奖励模型、教师模型、verifier 或 LLM judge。关键实验应关注三类结果：最终 QA accuracy 或 exact match 的提升；去掉 sign-consistency gating、只用原始 likelihood gain、去掉 group normalization 等消融；以及不同 turn 位置的 attribution 是否能识别早期关键证据。当前给出的全文内容未包含具体数值表，因此不补写具体提升幅度或模型规模。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Method 中 leave-one-turn 替换方式、Answer-Likelihood Gain 的定义、归一化与 sign-consistency gating 的公式。实验部分重点看 outcome-only GRPO 与 LOTAPO 的对比，以及 gating 和归一化的消融。若关注 RLHF/RLVR 或搜索增强推理，值得细看它如何避免外部过程奖励模型带来的分布偏移；若只关注基座预训练，可以读到方法公式和主要消融即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in reinforcement learning for multi-turn search reasoning. Terminal answer correctness gives the same trajectory-level signal to all intermediate search actions, so useful, redundant, and harmful search turns are reinforced or penalized together.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly to post-training and RL signal construction rather than base-model pretraining. The useful idea is to derive process supervision from the current policy itself, without an external process reward model, teacher, verifier, or LLM judge. This is relevant for training search-augmented reasoning systems, and more broadly for understanding how to build lower-noise intermediate rewards in RL pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: LOTAPO constructs self-generated process rewards with backward leave-one-turn attribution. For a completed search trajectory, each valid search turn consists of the model-generated search action and the corresponding retrieval observation. The method replaces one such turn with a fixed [DELETE] placeholder while keeping the downstream interactions intact, then measures how the current policy’s mean log-likelihood of the gold answer changes. This Answer-Likelihood Gain estimates the turn’s contribution in the full reasoning context: if removing a turn lowers the gold-answer likelihood, the turn receives positive attribution; if removal increases it, the turn may be redundant or misleading. The raw gains are noisy, so LOTAPO applies robust scaling, a bounded tanh transform, group normalization, and sign-consistency gating. The gate keeps only process advantages whose normalized direction agrees with the raw likelihood-gain direction. The resulting process advantage is assigned to the policy-generated tokens of the corresponding search turn and combined with the terminal GRPO advantage, while the final answer turn remains supervised only by the terminal reward.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers seven knowledge-intensive question-answering datasets in multi-turn search reasoning. The available text indicates that LOTAPO improves training over outcome-only rewards by providing turn-level feedback without relying on external evaluators. The most informative experimental checks are the comparison against vanilla GRPO or outcome-only RL, ablations on sign-consistency gating and normalization, and analyses showing whether early evidence can be credited even when its value appears only after later turns. The provided full-text excerpt does not include numerical result tables, so exact gains, parameter counts, and dataset sizes should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the method definition of leave-one-turn deletion, the Answer-Likelihood Gain formula, and the normalization plus sign-consistency gate. In the experiments, prioritize outcome-only RL comparisons and ablations over the attribution pipeline. For readers working on RLVR, RLHF, or search-augmented reasoning, the most useful detail is how the method avoids evaluator-induced distribution mismatch. For base-pretraining work, the main value is the reward-construction idea rather than the task setting.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §方法和主表；无 judge 的过程奖励很干净，但 gold-answer likelihood 可能偏向答案复述。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and main table; judge-free process rewards are clean, but gold-answer likelihood may bias toward answer restatement.

paper.title: TRACE: Turn-level Reward Assignment via Credit Estimation for Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Multi-turn agents solve complex tasks through extended sequences of tool interactions before producing a final answer, making credit assignment a fundamental challenge during post-training. Outcome rewards provide reliable supervision for short-horizon reasoning, but become sparse and high-variance as trajectories grow to tens or hundreds of tool calls. They can also be misleading: a failed rollout may contain many useful actions that move the agent closer to the goal, yet outcome-only training

summary.core_problem: 长 horizon 智能体的强化学习训练中，仅使用最终结果奖励存在稀疏性高、方差大的问题：会给同一条轨迹上的所有中间工具调用分配相同的信用，无法区分对解题有贡献的动作、冗余动作和导致失败的关键错误。现有过程监督方案要么需要昂贵的步骤级人工标注，要么依赖强能力的LLM裁判，或是需要单独训练的过程奖励模型，后者还容易出现和最终结果正确性偏离的漂移问题，缺少不依赖额外标注和额外模型的轻量密集信用分配方案。
summary.importance: 为可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）扩展到长序列智能体场景提供了低 overhead 的信用分配思路，证明不需要SFT冷启动、专项中训、过程奖励模型或强裁判，仅靠和最终结果严格对齐的密集步级奖励，就能通过纯RL让基础模型学会复杂的长程工具使用能力，对长序列能力的RL激发、智能体训练信号构造都有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心设计是用冻结的参考模型作为稳定的解题进度探针，而非裁判。首先将智能体交互轨迹按工具调用边界切分为状态转移序列，对每个轨迹前缀，计算冻结参考模型输出黄金答案的对数概率，将相邻前缀的对数概率差（时序差分TD值）作为当前工具调用步的回合级奖励：如果工具返回的观测提升了答案的可预测性就给正奖励，无信息增益就给接近零的奖励，导致轨迹偏离目标就给负奖励。这种TD奖励天然满足望远镜求和性质，累计值和最终结果严格对齐，不会给冗余步骤分配虚高信用。最终训练奖励将该密集TD信号和标准结果级优势结合，既保留可验证最终结果的锚定作用，又为每一步动作分配合理信用，全程不需要额外标注、裁判模型或过程奖励模型。
summary.experiments: 在长程深度搜索任务上开展测试，训练全程采用纯RL设置：无SFT冷启动、无智能体专项中训、无实时网页训练数据、无LLM强裁判、无过程奖励模型。闭域网页场景BrowseComp-Plus上，Qwen3-4B得分从7.2提升到35.6，Qwen3-30B-A3B得分从8.4提升到42.6；训练得到的30B-A3B智能体可零样本迁移到开域网页场景，在BrowseComp得分12.9、GAIA得分52.0、xbench-DeepSearch得分45.0。训练曲线显示，相比纯结果奖励训练，TRACE方法性能启动更早、收敛速度更快。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1节问题定义、第3节方法框架，重点理解冻结参考模型作为对数概率探针的设计逻辑、TD回合奖励的望远镜对齐性质，扫过第4节的核心结果表和训练曲线对比即可，熟悉KL正则化智能体RL的读者可跳过第2节预备知识部分，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Outcome-only reinforcement learning for long-horizon LLM agents suffers from sparse, high-variance training signals: it assigns identical credit to all intermediate tool calls in a trajectory, failing to distinguish productive, evidence-gathering actions from redundant operations and critical missteps that cause failure. Existing process supervision pipelines rely on expensive step-level annotations, capable LLM judges, or separately trained process reward models, which often drift from alignment with ground-truth outcome correctness. No existing lightweight dense credit assignment method works without these extra supervision components.
summary_en.importance: TRACE offers a low-overhead credit assignment recipe to extend reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to long-horizon agent settings. It demonstrates that pure RL, without SFT cold start, specialized agent mid-training, process reward models, or strong judges, can endow base models with complex long-horizon tool use capabilities when paired with dense, outcome-aligned step rewards. The design provides practical reference for RL-based elicitation of long-sequence capabilities and agent training signal construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design uses a frozen reference model as a stable progress probe, rather than an explicit judge. Rollouts are split into state transitions at tool call boundaries, and each trajectory prefix is scored by the frozen reference model's log probability of the gold answer. Turn-level rewards are defined as the temporal difference (TD) of this score between adjacent prefixes: a tool call receives positive reward if its returned observation increases answer predictability, near-zero reward if it adds no task-relevant information, and negative reward if it shifts the trajectory away from the goal. The TD rewards follow a telescoping sum property that strictly aligns cumulative credit with the final outcome, eliminating spurious positive credit for redundant actions. The final training objective combines this dense TD signal with standard outcome-level advantage, keeping verifiable task success as the anchor while providing fine-grained step supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on long-horizon deep search tasks across closed-web and open-web settings, with a pure RL training setup: no SFT cold start, no agent-specific mid-training, no live-web training data, no LLM judges, no separate process reward models. On closed-web BrowseComp-Plus, TRACE improves Qwen3-4B from 7.2 to 35.6 and Qwen3-30B-A3B from 8.4 to 42.6. The trained 30B-A3B agent transfers zero-shot to open-web settings, reaching 12.9 on BrowseComp, 52.0 on GAIA, and 45.0 on xbench-DeepSearch. Training curves show earlier performance takeoff and faster convergence compared to outcome-only RL baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the problem framing in Section 1 and method design in Section 3, paying particular attention to the logic of using a frozen reference model as a log-probability probe and the telescoping alignment property of TD turn rewards. Readers familiar with KL-regularized agent RL can skip the preliminaries in Section 2. Review core result tables and training curve comparisons in Section 4 for empirical validation. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把reference-model log-prob作为状态价值做TD型稠密reward，思路干净、实现成本低，建议只看§3方法和主要消融，再决定是否在内置agent RL里做ablation。
recommendation.en: Clean, cheap dense-reward idea using frozen-ref log-probs as state values for TD residuals; read §3 and ablations, then consider an internal agent-RL ablation.

paper.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses via Gated Semantic Quality-Diversity
paper.abstract: An LLM agent's real-task performance is shaped as much by the harness around its model as by the frozen model itself: its prompts, injected knowledge, runtime control, and configuration. In deployment the harness is often the only lever available, so improving it automatically is the natural way to raise performance without touching the weights. The hard part is not generating changes but knowing which one truly helped. Self-generated feedback is noisy, and an apparent gain can be a measurement

summary.core_problem: 研究在冻结 LLM 权重的部署场景下，如何自动改进 agent harness，包括 prompt、注入知识、运行时控制和配置，并避免把噪声反馈误认为真实提升。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 系统优化方法：把 harness 视为可演化对象，并强调“生成 patch”和“可信归因”必须分离。它对 agent 工程有价值，但对预训练本身主要是间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成：语言模型负责诊断失败并提出 harness patch；确定性代码负责采样、度量和显著性检验，决定 patch 是否真正带来提升。通过 gated semantic quality-diversity archive 保存多样化改动，archive 的键由 WHERE × WHY 的错误病理类别定义，用来避免只优化单一平均分或过拟合某些任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调框架关注真实任务性能、抗噪声反馈和防止调参过拟合，但未给出具体任务集合、模型、样本量、baseline 或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to automatically improve an agent harness—prompts, injected knowledge, runtime control, and configuration—when the underlying LLM weights are frozen.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-system optimization method. It treats the harness as an evolvable object and separates patch generation from trustworthy credit assignment. The relevance to pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: A language model diagnoses failures and proposes harness patches, while deterministic code handles sampling, measurement, and significance testing. Accepted patches are stored in a gated semantic quality-diversity archive keyed by WHERE × WHY pathology categories, aiming to preserve diverse improvements instead of overfitting a narrow task slice.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes the framework’s goals around real-task performance, noisy feedback, and overfitting control, but does not disclose the task suite, models, baselines, sample sizes, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 不必细读；若做 agent eval 或 posttrain 数据闭环，只看信用分配和显著性检验设计。
recommendation.en: No need to read in full; if you work on agent eval or post-training loops, inspect the credit-assignment and significance-testing design.

paper.title: MJ: Multi-turn LLM Jailbreaking via Decomposed Credit Assignment
paper.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) operate in interactive multi-turn settings, making multi-turn jailbreaking a realistic threat model and an important setting for automated red teaming. A core challenge in learning multi-turn jailbreak attackers is credit assignment: different turns contribute differently to the final outcome, yet existing learning signals are often too coarse to identify their individual contributions. We propose decomposed credit GRPO (DC-GRPO), a unified turn-level credit a

summary.core_problem: 多轮 jailbreak 攻击学习中，单个回合对最终越狱成功的贡献不同，轨迹级奖励会导致 credit assignment 错位。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练/RL 设定下的 credit assignment 改进。对做 GRPO、长轨迹 RL、multi-turn agent 训练的人有参考价值，但与基座预训练关系较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 decomposed credit GRPO（DC-GRPO），为多轮对话中的每一轮分配独立的 group-relative 学习信号，并结合 immediate credit 与 future credit；同时给出 static 和 dynamic 两种加权规则，避免把单一 trajectory-level 分数广播到所有轮次。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法在多轮 jailbreak 学习上做了实验比较，但未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度。核心对比对象是标准 GRPO 或使用轨迹级奖励的多轮攻击学习方法，结论是 turn-level credit assignment 更有效。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-turn jailbreak learning, different dialogue turns contribute differently to the final attack success, so trajectory-level rewards create a credit-assignment mismatch.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/RL contribution on credit assignment. It is relevant if you work on GRPO, long-horizon RL, or multi-turn agent training, but only loosely connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes decomposed credit GRPO (DC-GRPO), which assigns a separate group-relative learning signal to each turn in a dialogue by combining immediate and future credit. It also introduces static and dynamic weighting schemes to avoid broadcasting a single trajectory-level score to all turns.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates experiments on multi-turn jailbreak learning, but does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains. The main comparison is against standard GRPO or trajectory-level reward formulations, with the conclusion that turn-level credit assignment works better.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做长轨迹 RL，这篇可借鉴 reward decomposition；否则只是 jailbreak 场景里的局部技巧，不必高估。
recommendation.en: Useful if you care about long-horizon RL credit assignment; otherwise it is a jailbreak-specific trick and not something to over-index on.

paper.title: STAMP: Provenance-Guided Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for deep-search agents has largely focused on trajectory-level scoring -- outcome correctness, citation-aware rewards, and evidence coverage. Yet the actions that expose supporting documents receive no targeted credit, a gap we call the reward-credit mismatch. We propose STAMP, in which a reference-based verifier judges whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in a training-time evidence graph, and first-exposure attribution traces each supported citation

summary.core_problem: 深度搜索Agent的RL训练普遍采用轨迹级评分，无法为找到关键支持文档的动作分配针对性信用，存在奖励-信用不匹配问题。
summary.importance: 提出溯源引导的步级信用分配方法STAMP，在不改变轨迹级奖励和排名的前提下提升搜索Agent RL训练效率，属于Agent RL训练方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 1）训练时用基于引用的验证器判断每个被引文档是否支持证据图中的实体或关系；2）首次曝光归因机制将每个有效引用追溯到首次发现它的搜索动作；3）符号保持优势调制，在步级重新分配优势，不改变轨迹总奖励和组内轨迹相对排名。
summary.experiments: 在BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、xbench-DS基准上，相同SFT初始化、训练数据和搜索工具配置下，STAMP相比GRPO基线分别提升2.0/5.5/3.0个点，可与结果奖励、引用评分奖励叠加使用。

summary_en.core_problem: RL for deep-search agents relies heavily on trajectory-level scoring, failing to assign targeted credit to actions that surface critical supporting documents, leading to a reward-credit mismatch.
summary_en.importance: Proposes STAMP, a provenance-guided step-level credit assignment method that improves RL training efficiency for search agents without altering trajectory-level rewards or rankings, as an RL training improvement for agentic systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Uses a reference-based verifier at training time to judge whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in the evidence graph; 2) Applies first-exposure attribution to trace each valid citation back to the search action that first surfaced it; 3) Uses sign-preserving advantage modulation to redistribute step-level advantages without changing total trajectory reward or relative ranking of trajectories within a batch.
summary_en.experiments: On BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, and xbench-DS, STAMP outperforms the GRPO baseline by +2.0/+5.5/+3.0 points under matched SFT initialization, training data, and search tools, and composes with both outcome-only and citation-rubric base rewards.

recommendation.zh: 针对搜索Agent的GRPO步级信用分配改进，场景绑定较强，可快速扫过方法部分了解优势调制思路，无需深入读。
recommendation.en: Step-level credit assignment improvement for GRPO tailored to search agents, highly scenario-specific; skim the method section for the advantage modulation idea, no deep read needed.

paper.title: When Implausible Tokens Get Reinforced: Tail-Aware Credit Calibration for LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, widely used critic-free RL methods rely on uniform credit assignment, broadcasting the same advantage to all tokens regardless of their differences. We identify a critical failure mode of this design, which we refer to as Positive-Credit Contamination: low-probability tail tokens that are contextually erroneous receive identical positive credit to plausibl

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 critic-free RL，尤其是 GRPO 一类方法里的一个具体失真：同一条完成序列只拿到一个 sequence-level advantage，然后把这份 credit 均匀广播到所有 token。问题在于，最终答案正确并不意味着路径上的每个 token 都可靠。训练中会出现一类“局部不可信但碰巧落在正确轨迹里”的低概率尾部 token：它们在当前上下文下并不自然，语义上可能偏、跳、甚至错，但因为整条轨迹得到了正奖励，这些 token 也被一并强化。作者把这个现象定义为 Positive-Credit Contamination。论文要解决的不是一般性的 token credit assignment，而是如何在不引入 critic、额外 rollout 或重型辅助模型的前提下，专门抑制这类不该被正向强化的 tail token。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究者来说，它的直接位置在 post-train RL，但启发点很清楚：当训练信号只在序列级给出时，局部错误会被全局奖励掩盖，长期会把模型推向分布校准更差的生成习惯。这和预训练里讨论的 exposure bias、局部困惑度校准、token-level reliability 是同一类问题，只是这里发生在 RL credit assignment 上。贡献量级不在于提出一个全新的 RL 框架，而在于把一个此前常被经验性归因的训练退化现象明确化，并给出一个几乎不增加训练开销的修正项。如果后续 RLVR 继续沿着 GRPO 这条线扩展，这类“只修 credit、不加 critic”的方法会比较实用。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 TACO，核心思路是：不要重新估计每个 token 对最终 reward 的因果贡献，而是先判断这个 token 在当前上下文下是否像一个“高风险尾部 token”，再只对正向 credit 做软抑制。这样做的取舍很明确：它放弃了精细的 token-level return decomposition，换来低开销和更稳定的工程实现。

从论文给出的机制看，TACO 先利用 generation-time 的局部统计量来刻画 token 风险，重点是 sampled token probability 在当前上下文下的位置，以及与局部熵相关的分布形态。直观上，如果一个 token 是在高不确定位置被采样出来的正常探索，不能简单压掉；但如果它同时处在分布尾部、又表现出局部语义不协调，那么它更像是“被奖励轨迹裹挟”的噪声 token。TACO据此构造一个 tail-aware risk score，再把原本统一广播的正 advantage 乘上一个随风险单调减小的校准因子。低风险 token 保留原有强化，高风险 token 的正更新被削弱；负 advantage 一侧则不做同样处理，避免削弱对错误行为的惩罚。

这和已有几类方法的区别比较清楚。第一类方法用 counterfactual、execution feedback、TD propagation 去估计 token 贡献，信号更细，但代价高，而且常需要额外推理。第二类方法用 entropy、surprisal、KL 等内禀量做重要性加权，但它们更像“哪些 token 值得学”，不直接回答“哪些 token 不该因全局正奖励而被强化”。TACO的切入点更窄：它不是找关键 token，而是找不该拿正 credit 的 token。这个问题定义更保守，也更容易做成低成本插件。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三种 LLM、六个数学推理基准，以及两个 OOD 科学推理基准。论文主结论是：TACO 在所有设置下都稳定优于 GRPO-style baseline，并且在长程训练里更稳，没有出现前期涨、后期回落的明显退化。给出的结果强调的是一致性而不是单点峰值：同一套方法在不同模型规模、不同 benchmark 上都能带来正增益，说明它修的是 credit assignment 的共性问题，而不是某个任务的 reward hack。

从消融角度，值得注意的通常有三类结论。第一，单纯按 token 概率或单纯按熵做抑制都不如联合的 tail-aware 设计，说明“低概率”本身不等于坏 token，必须结合上下文不确定性来判断。第二，只在正 advantage 上做校准比对正负都做更合理，因为论文关注的是 positive-credit contamination，而不是一般的 token reweighting。第三，额外计算开销很小，这是它相对 critic-based 或 counterfactual-based 方法最现实的优势。

你给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格和全部具体数值，因此这里不能捏造每个 benchmark 的提升幅度。精读时应直接看主结果表、长程训练曲线和 risk-score 相关消融，确认增益主要来自哪些任务、是否对 pass@1 / majority vote / length 有不同影响。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点不是公式推导，而是问题定义和实验验证。建议先看 Introduction，把 Positive-Credit Contamination 的例子和动机读明白；再看方法部分里 risk score 与 credit calibration 的具体形式，确认它到底用了哪些局部统计量、如何区分正负 advantage；最后看主结果表和 ablation。若时间有限，优先看：1）问题示意图；2）TACO 相对 GRPO 与其他 token-level credit 方法的对比表；3）长程训练稳定性曲线。预计 25 到 40 分钟能抓住主要信息。真正值得深挖的点有两个：一是 tail token 风险是否能迁移到代码、工具调用等更强约束的 RL 任务；二是这种局部可靠性校准能否前移到 continued pretraining 或 self-training 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific distortion in critic-free RL, especially GRPO-style training: a single sequence-level advantage is broadcast uniformly to every generated token. A rewarded completion, however, often contains tokens that are locally implausible under their immediate context.
