These low-probability tail tokens may be semantically off, yet they still receive the same positive credit as genuinely good reasoning steps if the final answer is correct. The paper names this failure mode Positive-Credit Contamination and asks how to suppress such undesired positive updates without adding a critic, extra rollouts, or expensive auxiliary models.
summary_en.importance: Its direct setting is post-training RL, but the lesson is broader for foundation-model training: sequence-level supervision can hide local errors, and repeated reinforcement of those errors can gradually damage calibration and reasoning style. That is closely related to concerns in pretraining about token-level reliability, local likelihood calibration, and noisy supervision. The contribution is not a new RL paradigm. It is a precise diagnosis of a common failure mode in GRPO-like training, plus a lightweight correction that is practical enough to matter if critic-free RL remains a standard recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TACO calibrates token-level positive credit through a local semantic reliability lens. Instead of estimating each token’s causal contribution to the final reward, it first asks whether the sampled token looks like a risky tail token under its generation context, then softly suppresses positive updates for such tokens.

Concretely, the method uses generation-time local statistics, centered on the sampled token probability and the shape of the local predictive distribution, including entropy-related signals. The design intuition is careful: a low-probability token is not automatically bad, because difficult reasoning steps can also have high uncertainty. What matters is whether the token appears both tail-like and locally unreliable under context. TACO converts this into a risk score, then multiplies the original positive advantage by a monotone calibration factor. Low-risk tokens keep most or all of the positive reinforcement; high-risk tokens get attenuated. Negative advantages are not treated symmetrically, which matches the paper’s goal: prevent contamination of positive credit rather than generally reweight all updates.

This differs from prior token-credit methods in a useful way. Counterfactual, execution-feedback, or TD-style methods try to estimate token contribution more directly, but they are heavier and often require extra inference. Entropy-, surprisal-, or divergence-based weighting methods identify important tokens, but importance is not the same as reliability. TACO solves a narrower problem: not which tokens matter most, but which tokens should not inherit positive credit from a globally rewarded trajectory. That narrower target is why it can stay lightweight.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans three LLMs, six math reasoning benchmarks, and two out-of-distribution scientific reasoning benchmarks. The main empirical claim is consistency: TACO improves over GRPO-style baselines across all tested settings and remains stable under long-horizon training. The paper emphasizes robustness of gains rather than a single standout number, which supports the claim that it is fixing a general credit-assignment issue rather than exploiting a benchmark-specific artifact.

The ablations appear to support three points. First, probability-only or entropy-only suppression is weaker than the tail-aware combination, suggesting that low probability alone is too crude a proxy. Second, calibrating only positive credit is more sensible than symmetrically modifying both positive and negative updates, because the identified pathology is specifically positive-credit contamination. Third, the added compute cost is negligible, which is the main practical advantage over critic-based or counterfactual alternatives.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so I will not invent benchmark-by-benchmark gains. For a careful read, inspect the main result tables, the long-training curves, and the risk-score ablations to see where the improvements concentrate and whether they interact with response length or pass@1 behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. The value is in the problem framing and the lightweight fix, not in heavy derivation. Start with the introduction and make sure the Positive-Credit Contamination examples are clear. Then read the method section closely enough to understand which local statistics define the risk score and how the calibration is applied only to positive advantages. Finish with the main results and ablations. If time is limited, prioritize: the motivating figure, the method box, the comparison against GRPO and other token-credit baselines, and the long-horizon stability plots. Around 25–40 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. The deeper follow-up question is whether this notion of local reliability can transfer to code RL, tool-use RL, or even continued pretraining with noisy self-generated data.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是它把“好轨迹里坏 token 也被奖励”说清了；先看 token-level ablation，若证据干净，可直接改你们的 RL credit 设计。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the clean articulation of a real RL pathology—bad tokens getting rewarded inside good trajectories; read the token-level ablations first, and if they hold, revisit your credit design.

institutions: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

paper.title: Selective Timestep Weighting and Advantage-Based Replay for Sample-Efficient Diffusion RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for aligning generative models with human preferences. However, applying RLHF to diffusion models remains highly feedback inefficient, as existing approaches typically require large amounts of human or reward model evaluations. This limitation reduces the practicality of diffusion RLHF in realworld settings where feedback is the primary bottleneck. In this paper, we propose two complementary strategies that subs

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散模型 RLHF 中反馈样本效率低、需要大量人工或 reward model 评估的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向扩散生成模型后训练的反馈效率改进。它不直接研究 LLM 预训练，但“轨迹中不同 step 的 reward 信息量不均匀”这个观察，对 diffusion LM、离散扩散语言模型和 RLVR 中的 credit assignment 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出两类互补策略：选择性 timestep weighting，对去噪过程中的不同时间步按信息量重新加权；advantage-based replay，优先复用高价值或高优势的轨迹样本。核心思想是避免把 reward 信号均匀分配到所有 denoising steps 和所有轨迹上。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体生成任务、模型规模、reward model、人工反馈规模、baseline 和提升幅度。能确认的是目标是在保持 unseen prompts 泛化的同时减少反馈评估次数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve feedback efficiency in RLHF for diffusion models, where reward or human evaluations are expensive.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for diffusion generative models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the observation that reward information is unevenly distributed across trajectory steps is relevant to diffusion LMs, discrete denoising language models, and RL-style credit assignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines selective timestep weighting, which reweights denoising steps by their learning utility, with advantage-based replay, which prioritizes informative trajectories. The main idea is to avoid assigning reward signal uniformly across all denoising steps and samples.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the exact generation tasks, model sizes, reward models, feedback budget, baselines, or quantitative gains. It claims improved feedback efficiency while preserving generalization to unseen prompts.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和方法公式就够；若做 diffusion LM 的 RL credit assignment，可把 timestep weighting 当候选 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and the weighting equations; for diffusion-LM RL credit assignment, timestep weighting is worth one ablation.

paper.title: ACPO: Adaptive Credit Policy Optimization via Fine-Grained Surrogate Entropy
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), but sparse outcome rewards still make token-level credit assignment difficult. Existing scalable RL methods typically assign trajectory-level rewards uniformly across tokens, while recent entropy-aware approaches either rely on coarse detached heuristics or directly optimize true entropy, which can introduce non-local gradient components misaligned with sampled-token policy updates. We p

summary.core_problem: 在基于结果奖励的强化学习（如 GRPO）中，稀疏的标量奖励导致 token 级别的信用分配（credit assignment）困难，而现有的基于熵的分配方法要么依赖粗糙的启发式规则，要么直接优化真实熵，这会引入与采样 token 策略更新不一致的梯度噪声。
summary.importance: 提出了一种细粒度的自适应信用分配框架 ACPO，在不依赖昂贵的过程奖励模型（PRM）的情况下，通过代理熵有效地解决了稀疏奖励下的信用分配问题，提升了 RL 在推理任务中的训练稳定性和性能。
summary.technical_approach: ACPO 引入了基于“局部模式代理熵”（mode-local surrogate entropy）的 token 级权重方案，动态调节优势估计（advantage estimates）。核心机制是不对称处理：在成功的轨迹中，放大高不确定性（高熵）决策的权重，认为这些是关键的推理分叉点；在失败的轨迹中，惩罚过度自信（低熵）的错误 token。通过使用代理熵，ACPO 避免了直接优化真实熵带来的全分布梯度噪声，确保了策略梯度的方向一致性。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 三个基座模型上进行了实验。在多个推理基准测试中，ACPO 稳定超越了 GRPO、DAPO 和 SAPO 等强 RL 基线，证明了在稀疏结果监督下，基于代理熵的信用分配的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 4.3 对真实熵梯度不一致性的理论分析，以及代理熵的数学推导。实验部分关注 ACPO 与 GRPO 在不同模型规模下的性能对比。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In outcome-based reinforcement learning (e.g., GRPO), sparse scalar rewards make token-level credit assignment difficult. Existing entropy-based methods either rely on coarse heuristics or directly optimize true entropy, introducing gradient noise misaligned with sampled-token policy updates.
summary_en.importance: Proposes ACPO, a fine-grained adaptive credit assignment framework that effectively solves the credit assignment problem under sparse rewards without relying on expensive Process Reward Models (PRMs), improving RL training stability and performance in reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: ACPO introduces a token-level weighting scheme based on a 'mode-local surrogate entropy' to dynamically modulate advantage estimates. The core mechanism is asymmetric: in successful trajectories, it emphasizes highly uncertain (high-entropy) decisions, treating them as critical reasoning forks; in failed trajectories, it penalizes overconfident (low-entropy) incorrect tokens. By using surrogate entropy, ACPO avoids the full-distribution gradient noise of true entropy, preserving the intended policy-gradient direction.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill, and Qwen3-8B-Base. ACPO consistently outperformed strong RL baselines like GRPO, DAPO, and SAPO across multiple reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of surrogate-entropy-based credit assignment under sparse outcome supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4.3 for the theoretical analysis of true entropy gradient misalignment and the derivation of surrogate entropy. In the experiments, compare ACPO's performance with GRPO across different model scales. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和消融即可；它抓住了 RLVR 的真问题，但 surrogate entropy 的假设要等完整实验验证。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations only; it targets a real RLVR bottleneck, but the surrogate-entropy assumptions need cleaner empirical support.

paper.title: TRIAGE: Role-Typed Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning requires assigning credit to environment-facing actions such as searches, clicks, edits, navigation commands, and object interactions. Standard GRPO uses the final verifier outcome as a uniform advantage over all action tokens. This outcome signal is useful but structurally incomplete: it punishes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts. We propose TRIAGE, a role-typed credit assignment framework t

summary.core_problem: TRIAGE 处理的是 agentic RL 里的 credit assignment：最终 verifier 只告诉一条轨迹成败，但 GRPO 会把同一个 outcome advantage 均匀分给所有动作 token 或动作片段。这会压制失败轨迹中的有效探索，也会奖励成功轨迹中的冗余动作或退步动作。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不直接改预训练目标，但对 LLM post-train 的训练信号质量有启发。它把 agent 轨迹中的环境交互动作当作基本决策单元，而不是普通 token span。这个视角对工具调用、搜索、代码编辑、网页导航类 RL 很关键：训练信号不能只按最终结果分配，还要区分动作在局部过程中的角色。贡献更偏方法设计和诊断框架，适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是给每个 environment-facing segment 增加一个语义角色轴。TRIAGE 用结构化 LLM judge 对局部上下文中的动作片段分类，角色包括 decisive progress、useful exploration、no-progress infrastructure、regression。分类器不直接替代 verifier，也不输出自由形式 reward；它只做局部语义诊断。随后用固定的 role-conditioned rule 把角色映射为有界的 segment-level process reward：决定性进展继承较强 outcome-aligned credit，有用探索给有限正向 credit，无进展基础操作压到接近 0，退步动作即使出现在成功轨迹中也被抑制。这样保留 GRPO 的最终 outcome advantage 作为主方向，同时用角色标签修正局部 credit。论文还给出一个理论解释：如果只能观测角色标签，role-conditioned correction 是均方误差意义下的最优片段校正；当固定角色常数与该最优校正对齐时，可以降低 advantage estimation error，并对应更低方差的 policy gradient。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebShop、Search-QA、ALFWorld 这类需要搜索、点击、导航、对象交互的 agentic 任务。对比项包括标准 GRPO、使用同一 judge 和上下文窗口的标量 LLM process-reward baseline，以及 outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline。论文声称 TRIAGE 在这些任务上相对上述基线有稳定收益，并用人工标注片段和角色诊断解释收益来源：失败轨迹中的 useful exploration 不再被全量惩罚，成功轨迹中的 regression 不再被 outcome reward 掩盖。给出的材料没有包含具体提升幅度和完整表格数字，因此不宜外推其规模。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20 到 30 分钟泛读。重点看 Introduction 对 outcome-only credit 两个盲点的定义，以及方法部分中四类 role 的边界。理论部分只需抓住 MSE-optimal correction 和 advantage variance 的直觉，不必深究每一步推导。实验部分优先看与 scalar process reward baseline 的对比，因为这个对比回答的是“角色标签是否比普通 dense reward 多提供信息”。如果关注 agent RL recipe，可进一步看人工标注诊断，判断角色分类是否稳定、是否依赖 judge 偏好。

summary_en.core_problem: TRIAGE addresses credit assignment in agentic RL. A final verifier can judge whether a trajectory succeeds, but vanilla GRPO assigns the same outcome advantage to all action tokens or segments. This penalizes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to RL post-training than to base pretraining, but it is useful for understanding training-signal quality in tool-use and environment-interaction settings. Its main contribution is to treat environment-facing segments, such as searches, clicks, edits, and object interactions, as the credit-assignment unit. This matters because outcome-only supervision is too coarse for long agent trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRIAGE adds a semantic role axis on top of the outcome axis. A structured LLM judge classifies each local segment into one of four roles: decisive progress, useful exploration, no-progress infrastructure, or regression. The judge is used as a role classifier, not as an unconstrained reward model. A fixed role-conditioned rule then maps labels to bounded process rewards or penalties. Decisive progress receives strong outcome-aligned credit; useful exploration receives bounded positive credit; infrastructure is damped toward zero; regression is suppressed even when the trajectory eventually succeeds. The final verifier outcome remains the primary optimization direction under GRPO. The paper also gives a theoretical justification: role-conditioned correction is the MSE-optimal segment correction measurable from role labels alone, and aligned role constants can reduce advantage-estimation error.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers WebShop, Search-QA, and ALFWorld. Baselines include standard GRPO, a scalar LLM-derived process-reward baseline using the same judge and context window, and an outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline. TRIAGE is reported to improve consistently over these baselines. Manual segment labels and role diagnostics are used to explain where the gains come from: preserving useful exploration in failed trajectories and suppressing regressive actions inside successful ones. The provided text does not include exact improvement numbers, so the magnitude should be read from the full tables before drawing strong conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the two failure modes of outcome-only credit, then inspect the method section for the four-role taxonomy and the fixed role-to-reward mapping. The most informative experimental comparison is against the scalar process-reward baseline, because it tests whether role typing adds information beyond dense reward scoring. The theory section is worth a light pass for the MSE-optimal correction argument, but the practical value depends more on judge reliability and role-label stability.

recommendation.zh: GRPO信用分配的关键改进，角色分段奖励的思路可直接复现用于R1-style推理RL训练，重点看§3的规则设计和正确性证明
recommendation.en: Key improvement to GRPO credit assignment; role-based segment reward design is directly reproducible for R1-style reasoning RL training, focus on §3 rule design and correctness proof

paper.title: ECHO: Prune to act, trace to learn with selective turn memory in agentic RL
paper.abstract: Long-horizon language agents must repeatedly interact with tools, accumulate evidence, and make decisions under bounded context windows. Existing context-management methods make such rollouts feasible by truncating distant history, folding past turns into summaries, or selecting compact memory states. However, these breakthroughs introduce two coupled limitations. First, as the number of turns grows, historical observations are progressively removed or collapsed into compressed states, making it

summary.core_problem: ECHO 解决长程工具调用 agent 在有限上下文下的两个耦合问题：行动时需要压缩历史，训练时又需要知道最终奖励应该回传到哪些早期证据 turn。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 agentic RL 和 post-train 训练信号设计有启发。它强调 context management 不能只看推理时能否塞进窗口，还要保留 provenance，也就是被压缩信息来自哪个原始环境 turn。这个视角对长程 RL、deep research agent、tool-use 数据构造都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
ECHO 把历史管理拆成三个部分：history state、bounded-context reconstruction 和 source-level traceability。每个工具调用 turn 完成后，系统写入一条 compact memory record，包含局部 finding 和 source-turn pointer。远端历史不是被滚动摘要折叠成一个不可追踪状态，而是保留为一组带来源指针的 memory records。当上下文预算紧张时，策略选择有用 memory，再把这些 memory 与近期交互一起重建成下一步的 policy context。

训练上，ECHO 不把 final-outcome advantage 均匀或密集地分配到整条轨迹的所有生成 token，而是利用 memory selection 中保留的 source indices，把正向 credit 路由到 final answer、被选中的历史 evidence turns、对应 memory findings，以及执行 memory selection 的动作。它和 rolling summary 的区别在于：summary 可以延长 rollout，但原始证据来源容易丢失；ECHO 牺牲一部分自由压缩能力，换取训练时可追踪的证据路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 BrowseComp-Plus 和一组 zero-shot benchmarks，并在 dense 与 MoE backbones 上报告结果。提供内容中的主要结论是：相比 rolling-summary training，ECHO 提高准确率，同时减少 turn proliferation 和 trajectory volume，训练更集中于有用证据链。具体数值在给定内容中未完整展示，因此不宜过度解读幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和方法定义部分，重点看 context-managed multi-turn RL interface、selective turn memory、provenance-guided token-level credit assignment。实验部分主要看和 rolling summary 的对比，以及 turn 数、trajectory volume、accuracy 三者之间的关系。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以把核心思想读完；若关心 agent RL 训练实现，再细看 GRPO 形式下 advantage 如何按 source indices 分配。

summary_en.core_problem: ECHO addresses a long-horizon agent training problem: context managers help agents act under bounded windows, but collapsed or summarized history makes it hard to assign final-outcome credit back to the original evidence turns.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly relevant to agentic RL and post-training rather than base pretraining. The useful idea is that context compression should preserve provenance. A long-rollout agent needs not only a compact context for acting, but also a trace that tells the learner which earlier observations supported the successful answer. That distinction matters for tool-use RL, deep-research agents, and synthetic trajectory generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper formalizes context-managed multi-turn RL with separate notions of history state, bounded-context reconstruction, and source-level traceability. ECHO writes a compact memory record after each completed tool-use turn. Each record contains a local finding and a pointer to the original source turn. Distant history is kept as a non-collapsing set of such records. When the context budget becomes tight, the policy selects useful memory records and reconstructs the next context from those records plus recent interactions.

The learning rule uses the same source indices. Instead of applying a trajectory-level positive advantage broadly across all generated spans, ECHO routes credit to the final answer, selected historical evidence turns, their memory findings, and the memory-selection actions that built the reconstructed context. Compared with rolling summaries, the method gives up fully collapsed state compression in exchange for evidence addressability during RL.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are reported on BrowseComp-Plus and several zero-shot benchmarks, with both dense and MoE backbones. The stated result is that ECHO improves accuracy relative to rolling-summary training while reducing excessive turns and total trajectory volume. The provided text does not include the detailed tables or exact numerical gains, so the safest reading is that the contribution is the traceable-memory training interface and its empirical validation against summary-based context management.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the motivation, then read the formal interface for context-managed multi-turn RL and the sections on selective turn memory and provenance-guided credit assignment. The experiments are most useful for checking whether accuracy gains come with fewer turns and smaller trajectory volume, rather than merely longer rollouts. A 20–30 minute pass is enough for the main idea; implementation details are worth reading only if building RL pipelines for tool-using agents.

recommendation.zh: 做agentic RL或长上下文预训练的看方法部分即可，源索引记忆绑定RL信用分配的思路可以迁移到预训练的记忆机制设计中
recommendation.en: Check the method section if working on agentic RL or long-context pretraining; the source-indexed memory tied to RL credit assignment is transferable to pretraining memory mechanism design

paper.title: CRAFT: Counterfactual Credit Assignment from Free Sibling Rollouts for Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Self-distilled agentic reinforcement learning augments trajectory-level reward with a token-level distillation loss, using as its teacher the same policy conditioned on privileged context. The prevailing recipe gates this loss by a single scalar, the teacher-student log-probability gap. This signal is doubly limited: it is retrospective, scoring only the realised rollout and never the counterfactual ones, and it is sign-blind, never signalling when a teacher-preferred action would have harmed th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 self-distilled agentic RL 里的 token-level credit assignment 过于粗糙的问题。现有 SDAR 做法把“同一个策略在 privileged context 下的 teacher 分布”和普通 student 分布之间的 log-prob gap Δt，当成一个单标量门控信号去加权蒸馏损失。但这个信号有两个结构性缺陷：第一，它只看已经发生的 rollout，是 retrospective 的，无法回答“如果在第 t 步跟随 teacher 偏好的动作，后续回报会更好还是更差”；第二，它是 sign-blind 的，即便 teacher 偏好的动作其实会伤害整条轨迹，loss 也不会明确告诉模型要远离它。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在不额外大幅增加采样成本的前提下，把 sequence-level reward、teacher-student gap 和 token-level counterfactual effect 结合起来，得到更合理的逐 token 信用分配。
summary.importance: 虽然论文场景是 agentic RL，不是传统预训练，但它对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有现实意义。原因在于：当前很多 reasoning / tool-use 模型的能力提升越来越依赖 RL 或 self-improvement，而这些方法最终都受限于训练信号的颗粒度和质量。CRAFT 的贡献不是再换一个 PPO 变体，而是把“teacher 更偏好某 token”与“这个偏好是否真的提升最终回报”区分开来。这个区分对任何把 token-level imitation 和 trajectory-level reward 混合训练的系统都重要，包括 reasoning RL、verifier-guided distillation、甚至某些 continual post-training 设定。贡献量级属于较扎实的算法改进：它没有改环境，也没有依赖更强 teacher，而是重新设计 credit signal，并且强调与现有 GRPO 采样预算兼容。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名 CRAFT，包含三个支柱。第一支柱是 Counterfactual Token Importance, CTI。作者观察到 GRPO 本来就会对同一 prompt 采样 G 条 sibling rollouts，这些 rollout 可以被视为近似的 counterfactual 样本。于是他们用 teacher-student gap Δt 对 sibling rollouts 做 importance weighting，估计“如果在第 t 个 token 处更接近 teacher 的选择，group-level advantage 会如何变化”。得到的 per-token credit ct 是有符号的，范围在 (-1,1)，因此既能表达“应当更像 teacher”，也能表达“teacher 在这里会带偏”。文中给出一致性和方差界的命题，说明这个估计器在 G 增大时是可收敛的，且额外代价主要只是 group-wise softmax。第二支柱是双变量控制器。不同于只调一个 KL 系数，CRAFT 同时调节 CTI loss 权重 λ(t) 和 reference-KL 权重 μ(t)，并让两者沿 gate-active EMA 反向变化。直觉上，当 token-level credit 信号活跃且可信时，可以更依赖 CTI；当其不稳定时，则用 reference KL 稳住策略更新。作者还分析了固定点性质。第三支柱是 signed per-token KL penalty。KL 的方向不再固定为单向模仿 teacher，而是由 sign(ct) 决定：当 ct 为正时，采用更 mode-seeking 的方向去靠近 teacher；当 ct 为负时，采用相反方向，避免把有害 teacher 偏好蒸馏进 student。作者强调这与 credit sign 在结构上是一致的，并给出其作为有效 policy-gradient surrogate 的论证。另一个工程上很重要的点是 bit-exact reproducibility：把所有开关关掉后，loss 和 gradient 与 baseline 字节级一致，这样实验增益可以更干净地归因于算法变化，而不是实现漂移。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个 agentic environment、四个模型规模、四个 baseline，并包含 OOD 评测和多组消融。给出的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但能确认几类关键结果。第一，CRAFT 相比单门控 SDAR baseline 在多环境上更稳，说明 signed counterfactual credit 比单纯 Δt 门控更有效。第二，作者设置了一个更强的 Adaptive-CRINGE 对照，它共享第二支柱的控制器，用来隔离“收益到底来自动态系数调节，还是来自 CTI + signed KL 本身”。这类对照设计是合理的，因为它避免把所有改动打包在一起。第三，消融是按三根支柱独立开关做的，便于判断每一部分的边际贡献。第四，论文还强调 OOD evaluation，说明方法不是只在训练分布内靠更强 imitation 获益，而是希望改善真正的决策 credit assignment。由于当前提供的全文片段没有精确数值、模型参数量和环境名称，不能编造具体提升幅度；但从实验组织方式看，作者很重视把“counterfactual credit”与“普通蒸馏门控”严格区分开，并证明收益不是来自额外采样或实现细节。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合按“问题拆解—估计器—控制器—对照实验”四步来读。先看 Introduction，抓住作者对 baseline 的两点批评：retrospective 和 sign-blind。然后直接读 Section 3.1 的 CTI 推导，这是整篇最关键的部分，重点看 sibling rollout 如何被重用为 counterfactual estimator，importance weighting 的形式是什么，命题里的一致性和 O(1/G) 方差界依赖哪些假设。接着看双变量控制器和 signed KL，理解为什么作者没有简单采用 unlikelihood 或 CRINGE，而是让 KL 方向跟着 credit sign 走。实验部分优先看与 SDAR、RLSD、Adaptive-CRINGE 的对比，以及三支柱消融。若时间有限，读完方法主节、理论命题和主结果表，大约 40 分钟能把核心吃透。值得深挖的点有三个：其一，CTI 对 sibling rollout 质量和组内多样性的依赖有多强；其二，importance weighting 在长轨迹上是否会带来高方差或偏差累积；其三，这套 signed token credit 能否迁移到 reasoning RL、verifier-guided SFT 或 offline preference optimization 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in self-distilled agentic RL: token-level credit assignment is too crude. In the standard SDAR recipe, the teacher is the same policy evaluated under privileged context, and the teacher–student log-probability gap Δ_t is used as a single scalar gate on a distillation loss. The authors argue that this signal is structurally inadequate for two reasons. First, it is retrospective: it only scores the realized rollout and says nothing about what would have happened if the policy had followed the teacher’s preference at step t. Second, it is sign-blind: even when the teacher-preferred action would have harmed the trajectory, the loss does not explicitly push the student away from it. The core problem is therefore how to combine sequence-level reward, teacher–student preference, and token-level counterfactual effect into a better per-token credit signal without paying a large extra sampling cost.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. Many current gains in reasoning and tool-use systems come from RL or self-improvement loops, and those loops are often bottlenecked by the quality and granularity of the training signal. CRAFT’s main contribution is to separate two notions that are often conflated: the teacher prefers a token, versus following that preference actually improves return. That distinction is relevant beyond agentic environments. It applies to any setup that mixes token-level imitation with trajectory-level reward, including reasoning RL, verifier-guided distillation, and some continual post-training regimes. The contribution is a solid algorithmic refinement rather than a new environment or a stronger teacher: it redesigns the credit signal while staying compatible with the existing GRPO sampling budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: CRAFT has three pillars. Pillar 1 is Counterfactual Token Importance (CTI). The key observation is that GRPO already samples G sibling rollouts for the same prompt, so the G−1 non-realized siblings can be reused as approximate counterfactuals. The method importance-weights these sibling rollouts using the teacher–student gap Δ_t to estimate how the group-level advantage would change if the policy had moved toward the teacher at token t. This yields a signed per-token credit c_t in (-1, 1), which can express both “move toward the teacher here” and “the teacher would be harmful here.” The paper states consistency and variance results for this estimator, with variance scaling as O(1/G), and the extra computational cost is essentially a group-wise softmax rather than new rollouts. Pillar 2 is a bivariate controller. Instead of tuning a single KL coefficient, CRAFT jointly adjusts the CTI weight λ(t) and the reference-KL weight μ(t), driving them in opposite directions according to an EMA over gate activity. Intuitively, when token-level counterfactual credit is active and trustworthy, the update can rely more on CTI; when it is weak or noisy, the KL term provides stabilization. The paper also analyzes the controller’s fixed point. Pillar 3 is a signed per-token KL penalty. The KL direction is no longer fixed as one-way imitation of the teacher. It is chosen according to sign(c_t): when c_t is positive, the update is teacher-seeking; when c_t is negative, the update goes in the opposite direction to avoid distilling harmful teacher preferences. The authors argue that this is structurally aligned with the credit signal and still forms a valid policy-gradient surrogate. An important engineering detail is bit-exact reproducibility: with all switches disabled, the loss and gradients are byte-identical to the baseline, which makes the empirical gains easier to attribute to the algorithm rather than implementation drift.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans three agentic environments, four model sizes, four baselines, out-of-distribution tests, and clean ablations. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact numbers should not be fabricated, but several conclusions are clear. First, CRAFT improves over the standard single-gate SDAR baseline across multiple environments, suggesting that signed counterfactual credit is more informative than a plain Δ_t gate. Second, the paper includes a stronger comparator, Adaptive-CRINGE, which shares Pillar 2 with CRAFT. This is a good control because it isolates whether gains come merely from adaptive coefficient tuning or from CTI plus signed KL specifically. Third, the ablations are factorized by the three pillars, allowing the marginal contribution of each component to be inspected cleanly. Fourth, the inclusion of OOD evaluation indicates that the method is not only exploiting in-distribution imitation effects; it is intended to improve actual decision credit assignment. Even without exact metrics in the excerpt, the experimental design is careful and aligned with the paper’s claim: the benefit comes from better counterfactual token credit, not from extra sampling or loose implementation changes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this paper in four passes: problem diagnosis, estimator, controller, and controlled comparisons. Start with the introduction and make sure the two criticisms of the baseline are clear: retrospective credit and sign-blind gating. Then go directly to the CTI derivation in Section 3.1, which is the conceptual center of the paper. Focus on how sibling rollouts are reused as a counterfactual estimator, what the importance weights look like, and what assumptions underlie the consistency and O(1/G) variance claims. After that, read the bivariate controller and the signed KL section to understand why the authors did not simply adopt unlikelihood or CRINGE-style penalties. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against SDAR, RLSD, and Adaptive-CRINGE, then inspect the three-pillar ablations. If time is limited, the main method section, the propositions, and the primary result tables should be enough in about 40 minutes. Three follow-up questions are worth probing: how sensitive CTI is to sibling-rollout diversity and quality, whether importance weighting becomes high-variance on long trajectories, and whether the same signed token credit idea can transfer to reasoning RL, verifier-guided SFT, or offline preference optimization.

recommendation.zh: 想法比证据更强：如果你在看 GRPO/RLVR 如何把轨迹奖励压到 token 上，值得读 credit 设计；但在大规模复现前别急着改训练栈。
recommendation.en: The idea is stronger than the evidence: read it if you care about mapping trajectory reward to token updates in GRPO/RLVR, but do not rewrite your stack before seeing cleaner large-scale validation.

paper.title: On the Policy Gradient Foundations of Group Relative Policy Optimization: Credit Assignment, Gradient Sparsity, and Rank Collapse
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) eliminates the learned critic in PPO by using the mean reward of grouped rollouts as a baseline. We provide a rigorous derivation of GRPO from first principles of the policy gradient theorem, revealing a fundamental credit assignment failure: under output-only reward, every token in a rollout receives identical advantage, collapsing token-level credit to a single scalar. We prove this induces gradient sparsity that intensifies over training, and demonstr

summary.core_problem: GRPO作为PPO的无critic替代方案已被广泛用于推理增强类对齐训练（如DeepSeek-R1），但现有工作缺乏对其理论基础、信用分配机制与梯度结构特性的严格第一性原理推导，尤其是分组均值基线引入的结构性影响尚不明确。
summary.importance: 从策略梯度定理出发严格推导了GRPO的形式化表达，揭示了其在输出奖励场景下的固有缺陷：全序列token信用分配均一化导致的梯度稀疏与秩坍缩，为后续RL对齐算法的改进（如token级细粒度信用分配、更优baseline设计）提供了明确的理论依据和实证观测，对RL预训练与后训练的优化设计有直接指导价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）从策略梯度定理逐步推导，证明GRPO是带分组均值基线的REINFORCE估计器的特例，明确其两个核心假设：仅输出端奖励（ORM）、分组样本均值替代可学习critic；2）证明在仅输出奖励且折扣因子γ=1的条件下，同一条轨迹内所有token的优势函数会坍缩为同一个标量，即关键推理步与填充token会获得完全相同的信用分配；3）证明该均一化特性结合分组内优势的零和约束，会导致梯度矩阵呈现固有秩-2结构，且训练过程中梯度稀疏性会持续加剧；4）进一步解释了GRPO在多轮对话场景下表现受限的理论来源。分析过程刻意排除了裁剪、KL正则等优化步的干扰，仅聚焦梯度信号的本质结构。
summary.experiments: 在Nemotron-4B模型、GSM8K推理任务上开展梯度SVD分析，结果显示无论分组大小R取{2,4,8}中的任意值，GRPO的梯度矩阵有效秩始终稳定在约2，与理论推导结论完全一致，验证了秩坍缩现象的普遍性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第2节GRPO从策略梯度定理的完整推导过程、第3节信用分配坍缩与梯度稀疏的形式化证明、第7节的SVD实证验证结果；从事RL对齐研究的人员可深入阅读核心证明推导。预计阅读时间40-50分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: GRPO, a critic-free alternative to PPO widely adopted in reasoning-enhanced alignment training (e.g., DeepSeek-R1), lacks rigorous first-principle derivation of its theoretical foundations, credit assignment mechanism, and gradient structural properties — especially the structural impacts introduced by the group-mean baseline remain underexplored.
summary_en.importance: Provides a formal derivation of GRPO from the policy gradient theorem and reveals its inherent limitations under output-only rewards: uniform cross-token credit assignment leading to gradient sparsity and rank collapse. The findings offer explicit theoretical guidance and empirical observations for improving RL alignment algorithms, such as fine-grained token-level credit assignment and better baseline design, with direct implications for RL pretraining and post-training optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Derives step-by-step from the policy gradient theorem that GRPO is a special case of the REINFORCE estimator with a group-mean baseline, with two explicit core assumptions: output-only reward (ORM), and group sample mean replacing the learnable critic; 2) Proves that under output-only rewards with discount factor γ=1, the advantage function collapses to a single scalar for all tokens within the same trajectory, meaning critical reasoning steps and filler tokens receive identical credit; 3) Proves that this uniform assignment, combined with the zero-sum constraint on within-group advantages, induces an intrinsic rank-2 structure in the gradient matrix, with gradient sparsity intensifying progressively during training; 4) Further explains the theoretical origin of GRPO's limited performance in multi-turn scenarios. The analysis deliberately excludes confounding factors from clipping and KL regularization, focusing solely on the fundamental structure of the gradient signal.
summary_en.experiments: SVD analysis of GRPO gradients conducted on the Nemotron-4B model with the GSM8K reasoning task shows that regardless of group size R ∈ {2,4,8}, the effective rank of the GRPO gradient matrix remains stable at approximately 2, fully consistent with theoretical predictions and validating the universality of the rank collapse phenomenon.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 2 for the complete derivation of GRPO from the policy gradient theorem, Section 3 for the formal proof of credit assignment collapse and gradient sparsity, and Section 7 for the SVD empirical validation. Researchers working on RL alignment may read the core proof derivations in detail. Estimated reading time: 40-50 minutes.

recommendation.zh: GRPO 的 rank-2 梯度结论会改变对 RLVR 信号密度的先验，建议复现 SVD 诊断再谈 token credit。
recommendation.en: The rank-2 GRPO gradient result should update priors on RLVR signal density; reproduce the SVD diagnostic before debating token credit.

paper.title: PS-PPO: Prefix-Sampling PPO for Critic-Free RLHF
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) for Large Language Models increasingly relies on critic-free methods as a practical alternative to actor--critic training. Despite their simplicity, existing critic-free approaches propagate a trajectory-level learning signal uniformly across all tokens in a trajectory. This requires full-trajectory policy updates for every rollout, leading to substantial optimization cost for long reasoning traces, even though intermediate prefixes often contain

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 critic-free RLHF 在长推理轨迹上的一个实际瓶颈：像 GRPO、RLOO 这类方法虽然省掉了 critic，但通常把同一个 trajectory-level reward 广播到整条输出序列的所有 token 上，导致每次更新都要对完整轨迹做前向和反向，长链路推理时计算和显存开销都很高。作者的核心问题不是重新做 credit assignment，而是问：既然很多任务在中间前缀处就已经基本决定成败，是否可以只更新一段前缀，同时保持对原 critic-free broadcast update 的无偏近似。
summary.importance: 它对 pretrain 的直接关系不强，但对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口、尤其是长推理模型的训练效率有现实意义。对基座研究员，价值主要在两点。第一，它把“长轨迹里后缀 token 的边际学习信号可能很低”这个经验观察，变成了一个可操作的训练算法，而不是停留在直觉层面。第二，它提供了一种不引入 critic、也不增加 rollout 数量的降算方法，适合当前大模型 RLHF 里越来越长的 reasoning trace。若这类方法稳定，实际会影响后训练 compute budget 的分配，也会反过来影响预训练与后训练的最优配比。
summary.technical_approach:
PS-PPO 的核心做法是随机截断更新，而不是完整更新整条序列。标准 critic-free PPO 里，给定一条长度 T 的 completion，通常把同一个 advantage 广播到所有 timestep，再对每个 token 累加 PPO clipped objective。作者的观察是：在数学推理等任务里，prefix-conditioned success rate 往往在序列结束前就趋于饱和，说明前缀已经包含了大部分决定最终 reward 的信息。于是他们为每个 prompt 定义一个 cutoff distribution，从中采样一个截断位置 c，只保留前缀 1..c 参与前向和反向计算，后缀 token 不再进入本次 policy gradient update。

关键难点是，直接截断会引入偏差，因为原始目标是对所有 token 求和。作者因此推导了一个 inclusion-probability reweighting estimator：每个被保留下来的 timestep，会按其被纳入样本的概率做重加权，使得对 cutoff 随机性的期望，能够恢复原来的 full broadcast update。也就是说，PS-PPO 不是在改目标，而是在构造一个更便宜的随机估计器。这个点很重要，因为它解释了为什么方法能在不训练 critic、不增加 rollout 的情况下，尽量保持与原 critic-free PPO 一致的优化方向。

另一个设计点是 cutoff distribution 不是固定的，而是 prompt-conditioned。作者用 prefix uncertainty signal 来决定更可能截在哪。直觉上，如果某个样本在较早前缀处就已经“结果很明显”，就可以更早截断；如果前缀不确定性高，则保留更长前缀，避免过早丢掉后续纠错信息。全文也承认 late recovery 不是完全不存在，因此他们采用随机截断而不是确定性裁掉后缀，这是一种在效率和稳健性之间的折中。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验主要围绕两类结论展开。第一类是现象验证：作者先做 prefix-conditioned success 分析，展示多个任务上成功率随前缀长度增加会提前饱和，支持“后缀存在时间冗余”这个前提。第二类是训练效果：PS-PPO 在数学推理和 RLHF benchmark 上，相比强 critic-free baseline，能够降低训练计算量和峰值显存，同时保持接近的任务准确率或对齐效果。

摘要和给出的正文片段没有列出完整数字，但可以确定作者强调的是三项指标：training-time compute、peak GPU memory、以及最终 accuracy/reward。实验逻辑不是证明 PS-PPO 在最终性能上显著超过 baseline，而是证明它在性能基本不掉的前提下，省掉了长后缀的训练成本。消融上，最值得关注的是 cutoff 分布的构造、不同截断策略与无偏重加权是否必要、以及在存在 self-correction 的样本上过早截断会带来多大损失。作者在附录里还做了 late-recovery analysis，用来说明“后面才纠正前面错误”的轨迹存在，但不是主导模式，这为随机截断提供了经验依据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Figure 1 和相关分析，确认作者不是拍脑袋说前缀足够，而是先证明很多任务的 prefix-conditioned success 会提前饱和。然后看方法推导里 cutoff sampling 和 inclusion-probability reweighting 两步：前者决定怎么省算，后者决定为什么不会把目标改坏。最后看主实验表，重点不是绝对分数，而是 compute / memory / performance 三者的交换关系。

如果时间有限，建议阅读顺序是：Introduction；Method 中 broadcast advantage 到 PS-PPO 的推导；附录里的 late-recovery analysis；主实验和消融。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要思想。更值得细读的点有三个：一是 prompt-conditioned cutoff signal 到底如何定义，是否稳定；二是无偏估计在 PPO clipping 下的实际方差有多大；三是这种前缀更新是否会系统性削弱需要长程自我修正的任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in critic-free RLHF for long reasoning traces. Methods such as GRPO and RLOO avoid training a critic, but they usually broadcast a trajectory-level reward uniformly to every token in the sampled completion. That means each update still requires full-sequence forward and backward passes, which becomes expensive for long chain-of-thought outputs. The paper asks a narrower and more operational question than full credit assignment: if many tasks are already largely determined by an intermediate prefix, can we update only a sampled prefix while still preserving the expected critic-free broadcast update?
summary_en.importance: This is more post-training than pretraining, but it matters for foundation-model training because long-horizon RLHF is becoming a major compute sink. The paper turns an empirical observation—suffix tokens often carry low marginal learning signal—into an explicit optimization method. It is also relevant because it reduces cost without introducing a critic and without requiring extra rollouts. If such methods hold up at scale, they affect how much compute is needed to train reasoning-heavy models and therefore influence the broader pretrain/post-train budget tradeoff.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PS-PPO replaces full-trajectory updates with stochastic prefix updates. In standard critic-free PPO for language models, a completion of length T receives a broadcast advantage, and the PPO objective sums token-level terms across all timesteps. The authors observe that on reasoning tasks, the probability of eventual success conditioned on the current prefix often saturates before the sequence ends. This suggests that much of the suffix may be redundant for learning.

The method therefore defines a prompt-conditioned cutoff distribution and samples a cutoff c for each rollout. Only the prefix up to c is used in the policy-gradient computation; tokens after c are skipped for that update. The main technical issue is bias: naively truncating the sequence would change the objective because the original update sums over all tokens. To fix this, the paper derives an inclusion-probability reweighting estimator. Each retained timestep is weighted by the inverse of its probability of being included under the cutoff distribution, so that the expectation over cutoff sampling recovers the corresponding full broadcast update. In other words, PS-PPO does not redefine the target objective; it constructs a cheaper stochastic estimator of the same critic-free update.

Another important design choice is that the cutoff distribution is prompt-conditioned rather than fixed. It is driven by a prefix uncertainty signal: examples that appear effectively decided early can be truncated more aggressively, while uncertain examples keep longer prefixes. The paper explicitly acknowledges late recovery and self-correction, so it uses stochastic truncation instead of deterministically discarding all suffix tokens. That is the main robustness-efficiency tradeoff in the design.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments support two claims. First, the paper validates the underlying phenomenon by analyzing prefix-conditioned success rates. On the reasoning tasks they study, success often saturates before the end of the completion, which supports the idea that later tokens can be temporally redundant for optimization. Second, on mathematical reasoning and RLHF benchmarks, PS-PPO reduces training-time compute and peak GPU memory while maintaining accuracy relative to strong critic-free baselines.

The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, but the evaluation clearly centers on three metrics: training compute, peak memory, and final task performance. The point is not that PS-PPO dramatically improves final accuracy, but that it preserves most of the baseline performance while avoiding the cost of backpropagating through long suffixes. The most important ablations are likely the construction of the cutoff distribution, the necessity of the inclusion-probability correction, and the degradation on examples that rely on late self-correction. The appendix’s late-recovery analysis is especially relevant because it justifies the stochastic truncation assumption empirically rather than rhetorically.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with Figure 1 and the prefix-conditioned success analysis. That establishes the empirical premise that many trajectories become predictable before they end. Then read the derivation of cutoff sampling and inclusion-probability reweighting: the first explains where the savings come from, and the second explains why the update remains aligned with the original critic-free objective. Finally, inspect the main experiment tables with an eye on the compute-memory-performance tradeoff rather than absolute benchmark scores.

If time is limited, read the introduction, the method section that moves from broadcast advantage to PS-PPO, the appendix discussion of late recovery, and the main ablations. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea. The deeper questions worth checking are: how the prompt-conditioned uncertainty signal is defined in practice, how much variance the reweighted estimator introduces under PPO clipping, and whether prefix-only updates systematically hurt tasks that depend on long-range self-correction.

recommendation.zh: 想做长 CoT 的 RLHF/RLVR，PS-PPO 的“随机截断+无偏校正”值得抄作业；但要盯紧 cutoff 分布是否引入高方差与偏置。
recommendation.en: If you run long-CoT RLHF/RLVR, the stochastic prefix truncation + unbiased correction is worth trying; watch variance/bias from the learned cutoff distribution.

paper.title: UCOB: Learning to Utilize and Evolve Agentic Skills via Credit-Aware On-Policy Bidirectional Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Skill memories can improve agentic reinforcement learning by reusing past experience as textual guidance, but retrieved skills are not oracular: they may help in one state while misleading the same policy in another. This makes the common privileged-teacher assumption fragile, namely that a skill-conditioned prompt can be treated as a fixed teacher for the no-skill prompt. We introduce UCOB, a framework for learning to utilize and evolve agentic skills via credit-aware on-policy bidirectional se

summary.core_problem: 解决技能记忆在 agentic RL 中的“固定教师”问题：检索到的文字技能并不总是有用，同一个策略在同一类任务里，有技能 prompt 可能比无技能 prompt 更差。固定把 skill-conditioned 分支当教师，会把局部错误行为蒸馏进模型。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近 agent 后训练和长程交互 RL 的训练机制。但它给 process-level 信号设计一个有用启发：外部记忆、反思文本、技能库不能天然视为高质量监督源，监督方向需要由局部 credit 决定，而不是由上下文形式决定。这对用合成轨迹、反思数据、工具日志做 SFT/RL 数据筛选也有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: UCOB 把有技能 prompt 和无技能 prompt 看成同一个在线模型的两个 on-policy context views，而不是预设 teacher/student。训练时混合采样 skill/no-skill rollouts，并按任务和 anchor state 分组。对每个局部状态组计算 return-to-go，比较 skill-conditioned 视角和 no-skill 视角的平均回报。回报更高的一侧成为当前局部教师，向另一侧做自蒸馏。这样，有用技能会被内化到无技能上下文里；误导性技能会被无技能分支纠正。论文还把同一个局部回报差用于更新任务级和状态级技能记忆、做 utility-aware retrieval，并训练反思式 skill writer，使策略学习和技能库演化闭环。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 等长程交互任务。诊断实验显示，skill-conditioned 分支并不稳定优于 no-skill 分支；在 WebShop 上，有技能评估长期弱于无技能评估。把 skill-conditioned rollout 也纳入 on-policy RL 后，暴露偏移有所缓解，但仍不能保证有技能分支成为可靠教师。主实验中，UCOB 相比 skill-free RL、技能记忆基线和固定方向自蒸馏方法有更稳定收益。消融验证了局部 teacher routing、记忆演化、utility-aware retrieval 等模块的贡献。给定材料未提供完整表格数值，适合把结果解读为机制验证，而不是只看最终分数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Section 2 的诊断实验和 Figure 3/4，它们说明为什么“有技能就是教师”这个假设不稳。再看方法部分中 task-anchor grouping、return-to-go gap、bidirectional distillation loss，以及技能记忆如何被局部 credit 更新。实验部分重点看 ablation 和 teacher routing analysis，判断收益来自局部监督方向，还是来自额外 rollout 和技能库规模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a fixed-teacher failure mode in skill-augmented agentic RL. Retrieved textual skills are not always helpful; a skill-conditioned prompt can improve one local state and hurt another. Treating the skill-conditioned branch as a privileged teacher can therefore distill locally wrong behavior into the base policy.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is moderate, since the work is mainly about agent post-training. The useful lesson is about training-signal quality: external memories, reflections, and skill texts should not be trusted just because they look like higher-level supervision. The direction of supervision should be assigned by local credit. This matters for SFT/RL pipelines that use synthetic trajectories, tool logs, or self-reflection traces as training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: UCOB treats skill-conditioned and no-skill prompts as two on-policy context views of the same model. It samples mixed rollouts, groups records by task and anchor state, and computes return-to-go for each view inside the same local group. The view with the higher local return becomes the teacher for the other view. Helpful skill-conditioned behavior is distilled into the no-skill context, while misleading skill-induced behavior is corrected by the no-skill branch. The same return gap is reused to update task-level and state-level skill memories, guide utility-aware retrieval, and train the reflection-based skill writer.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers long-horizon agent tasks including ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA. Diagnostic results show that the skill-conditioned branch is not consistently better than the no-skill branch; on WebShop, skill-conditioned evaluation remains weaker throughout training. Making skill-conditioned rollouts on-policy reduces exposure mismatch but still does not make the skill view a reliable teacher. UCOB improves over skill-free RL, skill-memory baselines, and fixed-direction self-distillation variants. Ablations isolate the effects of local teacher routing, memory evolution, and utility-aware retrieval. The provided material does not expose all table-level numbers, so the main value is the training-mechanism evidence rather than a single headline score.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the diagnostics in Section 2 and Figures 3–4, since they motivate the rejection of a fixed privileged teacher. Then read the method details for task-anchor grouping, return-to-go gaps, bidirectional distillation, and credit-based memory updates. In the experiments, focus on ablations and teacher-routing analysis to separate the effect of local supervision direction from extra rollouts or larger skill memories.

recommendation.zh: 信用感知的局部教师选择思路对 RL 后训练中的蒸馏设计有参考，重点看 §3 的 return-to-go 对比机制。
recommendation.en: The credit-aware local teacher selection idea is informative for distillation design in RL post-training; focus on the return-to-go comparison mechanism in §3.

paper.title: The Weakest Link Tells It All: Outcome-Supervised Process Reward Modeling via Learnable Credit Assignment
paper.abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by providing fine-grained feedback, yet training PRMs typically requires expensive stepwise annotations. Outcome-supervised PRMs offer a scalable alternative by learning from final-answer correctness alone, but this introduces a fundamental *credit assignment* challenge, i.e., attributing outcomes to responsible reasoning steps. Existing approaches rely on either uniform or causal assignment, both of

summary.core_problem: 解决 outcome-supervised PRM 只用最终答案正确性训练时，如何把成败信号分配到具体推理步骤的 credit assignment 问题。
summary.importance: 这是 LLM 推理后训练中的方法创新。它试图降低人工 step-level annotation 成本，同时保留 PRM 对中间错误步骤的定位能力；对 RLVR、verifier 训练和推理数据质量控制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LCA，即 Learnable Credit Assignment。核心原则是 Weakest Link Assignment：一条推理链的质量由最弱步骤决定。方法把 credit assignment 和 reward modeling 联合学习，避免 uniform assignment 把最终结果平均分给所有步骤，也避免简单 causal assignment 不能稳定锚定 step correctness 的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、训练集、baseline 名称和具体提升数值；只说明目标是相比 uniform 或 causal assignment 更好识别过程错误，并用于 outcome-supervised PRM 训练。需要看正文确认数学/代码推理任务、PRM backbone 和是否真正提升 search/RL 效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in outcome-supervised process reward modeling, where only final-answer correctness is observed but rewards must be assigned to individual reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method for reasoning LLMs. It aims to reduce the cost of step-level annotations while retaining the ability of PRMs to localize intermediate reasoning errors, which is relevant to RLVR, verifier training, and reasoning-data filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed LCA framework jointly learns credit assignment and process reward modeling under a Weakest Link Assignment principle: a reasoning chain is only as strong as its weakest step. It is designed to avoid uniform assignment and simple causal assignment, both of which may fail to ground credit in step correctness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims improved process error identification relative to uniform or causal assignment, but the main paper should be checked for reasoning domains, PRM backbones, and downstream search/RL gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法定义和消融；若 weakest-link 信号真能稳定学出来，可用于内部 verifier/PRM 数据管线。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations only; if the weakest-link signal is stable, it is useful for internal verifier and PRM data pipelines.

paper.title: GBC: Gradient-Based Connections for Optimizing Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) provide a promising framework for solving complex tasks through role specialization and structured interaction. However, their performance is often limited by miscoordination and, more fundamentally, the lack of fine-grained credit assignment across agents. Existing approaches typically rely on coarse-grained feedback, making it difficult to identify which agents or interaction steps are responsible for errors. We propose Gradient-B

summary.core_problem: 如何解决基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中由于缺乏细粒度信用分配导致的协调不良和优化困难问题？
summary.importance: 提出了一种将多智能体系统建模为计算图并利用基于梯度的连接权重进行细粒度归因和优化的方法，为多智能体协作的精准调试提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Gradient-Based Connections (GBC) 方法。将 MAS 建模为计算图，引入基于梯度的连接权重，在 token 级别量化每个智能体输出对下游智能体的影响。通过构建归因图并反向传播特定任务的损失信号，实现错误源的精确识别和目标 prompt 优化。进一步开发了 AgentChord（摘要截断）。
summary.experiments: 论文未在摘要中提供具体的实验数据和 Baseline 对比，但强调了其在精确识别错误源和 prompt 优化方面的能力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自加州大学圣克鲁兹分校和伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校 (UIUC)，Dilek Hakkani-Tür 和 Gokhan Tur 是对话系统领域的资深专家。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the miscoordination and optimization difficulties in LLM-based multi-agent systems caused by the lack of fine-grained credit assignment?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a method that models multi-agent systems as computational graphs and uses gradient-based connection weights for fine-grained attribution and optimization, providing a new perspective for precise debugging of multi-agent collaboration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Gradient-Based Connections (GBC). Models MAS as a computational graph and introduces gradient-based connection weights to quantify the influence of each agent's output on downstream agents at the token level. By constructing an attribution graph and backpropagating task-specific loss signals, it enables precise identification of error sources and targeted prompt optimization. Further develops AgentChord (abstract truncated).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide specific experimental data or baseline comparisons but emphasizes its capability in precisely identifying error sources and prompt optimization.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from UC Santa Cruz and UIUC. Dilek Hakkani-Tür and Gokhan Tur are senior experts in the field of dialogue systems.

recommendation.zh: 将 MAS 视为计算图并尝试做 token 级别的梯度归因，这种将深度学习优化思想引入离散 agent 系统的尝试值得关注，可看其归因机制的具体实现。
recommendation.en: Treats MAS as a computational graph and attempts token-level gradient attribution; this effort to introduce deep learning optimization concepts into discrete agent systems is worth noting. Check the specific implementation of its attribution mechanism.

paper.title: SpatialFlow-GRPO: Where Spatial Credit Drives Image Editing
paper.abstract: Recent online reinforcement learning has substantially improved image editing quality. However, existing Flow-GRPO-style methods usually rely on a single whole-image reward, which makes fine-grained editing optimization difficult. We observe that a key obstacle in image editing is this spatial uniformity assumption: a whole-image reward cannot distinguish how different spatial regions contribute to image quality. To address this issue, we propose SpatialFlow-GRPO, a training framework that intro

summary.core_problem: 解决图像编辑 RL 中 whole-image reward 过粗，无法给不同空间区域分配准确 credit 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成后训练方法：把 GRPO/Flow-GRPO 类在线 RL 从整图奖励推进到区域级奖励，对理解生成模型中的 reward granularity 和 credit assignment 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpatialFlow-GRPO，将 region-aware rewards 转换为 semantic-region-level 优化信号，并在 policy update 中把区域 advantage 对齐到对应 latent positions。还训练了区域感知 reward model SFReward，构建 SFReward-14K 和 MultiEditBench。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示方法在 OmniGen2 和 FLUX.2-klein-4B 上评估，并与 Flow-GRPO 比较；声称在 GEdit-Bench 和多区域编辑相关评测上优于 Flow-GRPO，但给定信息未包含具体数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles coarse credit assignment in RL-based image editing, where a single whole-image reward cannot identify which spatial regions caused quality changes.
summary_en.importance: It is a multimodal generation post-training method. The useful signal is the move from image-level rewards to region-level reward and advantage assignment for diffusion or flow-based editing models.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpatialFlow-GRPO converts region-aware rewards into semantic-region-level optimization signals and aligns regional advantages with corresponding latent positions during policy updates. It also trains SFReward, builds SFReward-14K, and introduces MultiEditBench.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on OmniGen2 and FLUX.2-klein-4B against Flow-GRPO. The abstract claims better performance on GEdit-Bench and multi-region editing evaluation, but exact numbers are not included in the supplied excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 看 reward 到 latent credit 的映射即可；对文本 RLVR 是旁证，不要把图像区域性直接类比成 token credit。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward-to-latent credit mapping; it is a useful analogy for RLVR, but image regions should not be naively equated with token credit.

paper.title: BiPACE: Bisimulation-Guided Policy Optimization with Action Counterfactual Estimation for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Stepwise group-based RL is an attractive way to train long-horizon LLM agents without a learned critic: it reuses multiple sampled rollouts to estimate local advantages. Its weakness is less visible but more fundamental: every group-relative estimator assumes that the steps it compares are equivalent for credit assignment. We show that current agentic variants violate this assumption through a state-action credit mismatch. The observation-hash partition is overly fine on the state side, creating

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LLM agent 的无 critic 分组式 RL 中，step-level advantage 估计因状态分组过细、动作归因过粗而失真的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇后训练信用分配方法论文，贡献不在 agent 应用本身，而在指出现有 stepwise group-based RL 的一个结构性偏差：比较的步骤并不真正可比。对做 RL-pretrain 接口、长轨迹 credit assignment、无 critic 训练的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BiPACE，一个可直接替换现有估计器的 advantage 估计方法，不引入 critic、辅助损失或额外 rollout。方法包含两部分：BiGPO 用 actor 隐状态空间中的余弦距离做聚类，近似 policy-induced bisimulation，以修正 observation-hash 过细导致的 singleton group；ACE 用动作反事实估计把状态值与动作特异 credit 分开，避免组内均值把两者混在一起。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示其在长时程 agent 训练场景中做了受控比较，重点验证两点：一是当前 agentic group-relative estimator 确实存在 state-action credit mismatch；二是 BiPACE 在不增加 rollout 成本的前提下改善 step-level 学习信号。未见参数量、基座模型和具体 benchmark 细节，需读正文确认 setup 是否足够干净、收益是否跨环境稳定。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自芝加哥大学、港科大（广州）、斯坦福大学和中科大。机构组合较强，但作者名单里暂无可直接确认的业界高辨识度一线 RLHF/agent 研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets a failure mode in critic-free, stepwise group-based RL for long-horizon LLM agents, where step-level advantage estimates are distorted by overly fine state partitioning and overly coarse action credit assignment.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training credit-assignment paper rather than an agent application paper. Its value is in identifying a structural bias in current group-relative estimators: the compared steps are not actually equivalent for credit assignment. That matters for RL-pretrain interfaces, long-trajectory optimization, and critic-free training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes BiPACE, a drop-in advantage estimator that does not add a critic, auxiliary losses, or extra rollouts. It has two parts: BiGPO clusters steps by cosine distance in the actor hidden-state geometry as an empirical policy-induced bisimulation proxy, fixing the singleton-group issue from observation hashing; ACE uses action counterfactual estimation to separate state value from action-specific credit instead of collapsing both into a within-group mean.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments are designed to show two things: current agentic group-relative estimators suffer from a state-action credit mismatch, and BiPACE improves step-level learning signals without extra rollout cost. The abstract does not expose model size, base model, or benchmark details, so the cleanliness of the setup and robustness across environments need verification in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Chicago, HKUST (Guangzhou), Stanford University, and USTC. The institution mix is strong, though no widely recognized frontline RLHF/agent author can be confidently identified from the metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 pretrain 核心，但它把“组内步骤可比”这个默认前提拆掉了；若你在做 GRPO/长轨迹 RL，先看方法假设再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it usefully breaks the hidden assumption that grouped steps are comparable; if you work on GRPO-style long-horizon RL, inspect the estimator assumptions before deciding to reproduce.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Learning with a Single Rollout via Monte Carlo Pass@k Critic
paper.abstract: Estimating token-level advantages in reinforcement learning (RL) for language models remains challenging because scaling up episodic experience collection is expensive. The difficulty intensifies for baseline advantage estimation methods, where repeated sampling causes trajectories to diverge into substantially different reasoning prefixes. In this context, RL algorithms such as GRPO prove limited: an outcome reward is too sparse to be attributed to specific actions like intermediate steps, and

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是单条 rollout 条件下的 token 级信用分配。数学推理和代码任务常用可验证终局奖励，但终局正确性只告诉模型答案对不对，不能稳定说明中间哪些 token 或步骤应被强化。GRPO 这类多样本方法依赖同一 prompt 下多条 completion 的比较，但长推理、工具调用或 agent 轨迹会让不同 rollout 走向差异很大，采样成本也高。论文希望在每个 prompt 只采一条轨迹时，仍然得到可用于 PPO 更新的稠密优势信号。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 reasoning model 的 RL 训练信号有启发。核心价值在于把“终局奖励”转成“前缀可达性/成功概率”的 critic，而不是只依赖 outcome reward 或 TD bootstrap。这个方向适合思考 RL pretrain、长链推理、工具型 agent 训练中的信号质量问题：当重复采样昂贵且轨迹不可比时，训练算法需要在单条轨迹内部做信用分配。Pass@k critic 也提供了一个有用视角：训练目标不一定只估计当前策略一次采样成功率，也可以估计某个前缀是否仍保留通向正确解的可行 continuation。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 SR-PPO，即 single-rollout proximal policy optimization。它用 Monte Carlo 标注训练一个前缀级 credit model，作为 PPO 的 value/critic。给定一个 partial solution，critic 预测从该前缀继续采样 k 次时至少一次成功的概率，也就是 Pass@k value。训练时不再主要依赖 GAE 中的 TD 误差和 bootstrapped value，而是用与最终成功直接相关的 Monte Carlo 标签来学习前缀价值。优势信号由相邻前缀的价值变化给出：如果某段 continuation 让 Pass@k 估计上升，对应 token 得到正信用；如果让成功可达性下降，则得到负信用。终止位置再加入 correction term，使稠密信用信号与真实终局 outcome 对齐。论文特别强调 Pass@4，而不是只用 Pass@1。Pass@1 更接近当前策略单次成功率，容易把已较容易解决的前缀也纳入更新；Pass@k 更偏向“还有没有多条机会能解出来”，会弱化已经容易的状态，把训练压力放到仍可挽救但尚不稳定的前缀上。k 趋大时，Pass@k 接近 reachability：该前缀是否存在成功 continuation。这把“状态是否可解”和“当前策略一次是否解出”区分开来。
summary.experiments: 给定正文中明确的信息包括：实验面向数学推理；训练设定为每个 prompt 单条 rollout；主 critic 使用 Pass@4；比较对象围绕 outcome-only RL、GRPO 式多 rollout 信号和 PPO/GAE 式 TD critic。可见的实验主张是，Pass@k critic 能在单 rollout 下提供比终局奖励更细的 token 级训练信号，并减少多 rollout 采样带来的计算成本和异质轨迹比较噪声。消融重点应包括 Pass@1 与 Pass@4 的差异、是否加入 terminal correction、Monte Carlo prefix critic 与 TD/GAE critic 的差异、以及不同推理长度下信用分配稳定性。提供的正文片段没有给出完整表格、模型参数量、数据规模或具体提升数字，因此不应从片段外推数值结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看方法部分中 Pass@k value 的定义，以及 SR-PPO 如何把相邻前缀 value difference 转成 token advantage；这是主要创新。其次看 terminal correction 的公式，它决定稠密奖励是否会偏离真实终局奖励。再看 Pass@1、Pass@4 和 reachability 解释，重点理解为什么 k 增大会让 critic 更关注“可解性”而不是“当前策略一次采样概率”。实验部分优先看三类消融：critic 训练标签、k 的选择、与 GRPO/PPO-GAE 的采样效率对比。若关心长上下文 agent RL，可以重点看作者如何描述多 rollout 轨迹异质性，因为这部分比数学任务本身更有迁移价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies token-level credit assignment when only one rollout is available per prompt. Verifiable-reward training for math and code usually provides a delayed binary outcome, but that signal cannot identify which intermediate tokens or reasoning steps helped. Multi-sample methods such as GRPO become costly and noisy when different completions follow very different reasoning paths. The goal is to make PPO work in this single-rollout regime by extracting a dense training signal from the realized trajectory itself.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to reasoning post-training and RL signal design than to base pretraining directly. Its useful idea is to replace a sparse outcome reward, or a TD-bootstrapped value estimate, with a prefix-level success critic trained from Monte Carlo outcome labels. For researchers working on RL pretraining, long-horizon reasoning, or tool-using agents, the paper points to a practical issue: additional rollouts may be too expensive, and heterogeneous trajectories may not be comparable. A Pass@k critic also separates two notions that are often mixed together: whether a prefix still has a path to success, and whether the current policy will succeed with one sample.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is single-rollout PPO with a Monte Carlo Pass@k critic. For each partial solution, a credit model predicts the probability that at least one of k continuations will end with a correct answer. This predicted Pass@k value is used as the critic for policy optimization. Instead of using GAE with temporal-difference bootstrapping, the critic is trained against Monte Carlo outcome labels tied to eventual success. Token-level advantages are obtained from value changes along the trajectory: a continuation receives positive credit if it increases the estimated chance of future success, and negative credit if it lowers that estimate. A terminal correction term keeps the dense credit signal aligned with the observed final reward. The paper emphasizes Pass@4 as the main operating point. Compared with Pass@1, it gives a more selective signal: easy prefixes are downweighted, while prefixes that remain solvable but uncertain receive more training pressure. As k grows, the value approaches a reachability question: whether any successful continuation exists from the prefix.
summary_en.experiments: The visible experimental setup targets mathematical reasoning, uses one rollout per prompt, and centers the main critic on Pass@4. The relevant baselines are outcome-only reinforcement learning, group-based multi-rollout methods such as GRPO, and PPO with GAE-style TD value estimation. The main experimental claim is that a Pass@k prefix critic can provide denser token-level credit under a single-rollout budget, while avoiding the cost and trajectory mismatch of repeated sampling. The most important ablations are expected to be Pass@1 versus Pass@4, terminal correction on versus off, Monte Carlo prefix critic versus TD critic, and robustness as reasoning traces become longer. The provided full-text excerpt does not include complete result tables, model sizes, data scale, or numeric gains, so numeric conclusions should not be inferred beyond the stated setup.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus first on the formal definition of the Pass@k value and the way SR-PPO converts value differences between adjacent prefixes into token advantages. Then read the terminal correction term, since it controls whether the dense signal remains consistent with the final outcome. The Pass@1, Pass@4, and reachability discussion is also worth reading carefully, because it explains why increasing k shifts the critic from single-sample success probability toward solvability. In the experiments, prioritize ablations on the critic label, the choice of k, and sample-efficiency comparisons against GRPO and PPO-GAE. For long-horizon agent training, the discussion of heterogeneous rollouts is likely more transferable than the math benchmark details.

recommendation.zh: 针对 LLM RLHF 中 GRPO 采样成本高的问题，提出用单次 rollout 训练 token-level critic，值得关注其 critic 训练的稳定性和实际效果对比。
recommendation.en: Addresses the high sampling cost of GRPO in LLM RLHF by proposing a token-level critic trained with a single rollout; worth checking the stability of critic training and empirical comparisons.

paper.title: Semantic Consistency Policy Optimization for Reinforcement Learning of LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning effectively post-trains LLM agents for long-horizon, sparse-reward tasks by deriving step-level credit from trajectory outcomes. However, this ties a step's credit to its rollout's final outcome: semantically near-identical intermediate steps receive opposite credit depending on whether their trajectory eventually succeeded or failed. Such semantic credit inconsistency sends conflicting gradients to similar actions and wastes the partially-correct progress insi

summary.core_problem: 解决基于分组的LLM智能体强化学习中，语义相近的中间步骤因轨迹最终成败不同而获得相反信用、导致梯度冲突与失败轨迹中部分正确进展被浪费的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出无价值函数的奖励塑形思路，缓解分组RL中的语义信用不一致问题，为长程稀疏奖励任务的后训练提供新方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出语义一致性策略优化（SCPO），属于改进型方法；核心是在同一rollout分组内，用成功的兄弟轨迹为失败步骤打分，对沿兄弟轨迹取得的新进展赋予正向步骤级信用，无需额外价值网络。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个长程智能体基准上测试，与强分组RL基线对比，SCPO达到或超过基线性能，ALFWorld上成功率为93.7±4.1%。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses semantic credit inconsistency in group-based RL for LLM agents: semantically similar intermediate steps receive opposite rewards depending on their rollout's final outcome, wasting partial progress in failed trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a value-free reward shaping approach to mitigate credit misalignment, offering a new direction for post-training agents on long-horizon sparse-reward tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Semantic Consistency Policy Optimization (SCPO), an improved RL method that scores failed steps against successful sibling trajectories within the same rollout group and assigns positive step-level credit to new progress along the sibling path, without a separate value network.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ALFWorld and WebShop long-horizon agent benchmarks; SCPO matches or outperforms strong group-based baselines, achieving 93.7±4.1% success rate on ALFWorld.

recommendation.zh: 信用分配思路对RLHF/RL智能体训练有弱启发，重点看§3的兄弟轨迹打分规则即可，实验规模偏小，结论当参考信号。
recommendation.en: The credit assignment idea offers weak signal for RLHF and agent training; focus on §3 sibling scoring rules, treat small-scale results as reference only.

paper.title: EXPO-SQL: Execution-based Clause-level Policy Optimization for Text-to-SQL
paper.abstract: Text-to-SQL enables users to query databases using natural language by generating executable SQL queries. Recent methods have increasingly adopted Large Language Models based reinforcement learning (RL) to leverage execution feedback for training. However, existing RL methods assign uniform query-level rewards to all clauses in a SQL query, treating correct and incorrect clauses equally. This coarse-grained reward design leads to insufficient learning signals for correct SQL generation. To addre

summary.core_problem: 解决 Text-to-SQL 中基于执行反馈的 RL 奖励过粗的问题：整条 SQL 共享同一个 query-level reward，无法区分哪些子句正确、哪些子句出错。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练奖励设计。它不是通用 LLM 预训练工作，但对 RLVR/RLAIF 中的 credit assignment 有参考价值：当输出结构可分解且可执行时，细粒度奖励比单一终局奖励更有学习信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EXPO-SQL，将 SQL 拆到 clause level，并通过执行结果、错误信息、子句级增量执行来定位错误子句，再把奖励分配到不同 SQL 子句。方法是在已有 LLM + RL text-to-SQL 框架上做奖励粒度改造，不是新的基座训练范式。
summary.experiments: 在常用 Text-to-SQL benchmarks 上比较监督微调、prompting 和已有 RL 方法。摘要称 EXPO-SQL 显著优于这些 baseline，但未给出模型规模、训练 token、具体提升幅度和完整 ablation 细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Sungkyunkwan University；未从给定信息中确认团队在 LLM 预训练或 RLVR 方向的代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses coarse reward assignment in execution-based RL for Text-to-SQL, where a whole SQL query receives one reward even if only some clauses are wrong.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a post-training reward-design idea. It is not a general LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to RLVR-style credit assignment when outputs have executable, decomposable structure.
summary_en.technical_approach: EXPO-SQL decomposes SQL into clauses and assigns clause-level rewards by inspecting execution results, error messages, and incremental clause-wise execution. The method refines reward granularity within an existing LLM-based RL setup rather than changing the base model or training paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on widely used Text-to-SQL benchmarks against supervised fine-tuning, prompting, and prior RL methods. The abstract claims clear gains, but the provided metadata does not include model sizes, training scale, exact deltas, or detailed ablations.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Sungkyunkwan University; no widely known LLM pretraining track record is identifiable from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 任务很窄；若关心 RLVR 的 credit assignment，只看 clause reward 构造，SQL benchmark 结果不用深读。
recommendation.en: Narrow task paper; if you study RLVR credit assignment, read only the clause-reward design and skip most SQL benchmark details.

paper.title: Group-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Group-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly enhanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic scenarios. To achieve finer-grained policy updates, recent agentic RL frameworks have shifted from trajectory-level to step-level training. However, long-horizon agentic RL suffers from severe reward sparsity and delay, as feedback is often deferred for dozens of interaction steps. While existing step-level frameworks refine training granularity, their credit assignment remains coarse-grain

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是长程 Agent RL 中的信用分配问题：step-level 训练降低了上下文和显存压力，但仍把探索轨迹当成彼此独立的线性序列，导致稀疏、延迟奖励下的状态价值估计方差高，关键动作也难以被准确放大。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 Agent post-training 的算法改进。它的启发在于训练信号的组织方式：长程交互数据不应只按 trajectory 或 step 切开，还可以按状态转移结构重组。对做 RL pretrain、agentic mid-training 或环境交互数据训练的人来说，G2PO 提供了一个清晰的思路：先把采样轨迹还原成状态图，再在图上估计价值和优势，减少单条轨迹偶然性带来的噪声。
summary.technical_approach: G2PO 的核心做法有两步。第一，把多条 Agent 探索轨迹重构成状态转移图。相同或相似的环境观察被聚合成一个 state group，动作被看作从源状态到目标状态的有向边。第二，在图上重新定义价值和优势。状态价值不再由单条轨迹的最终结果决定，而是对同一 state group 中多个样本的结果做聚合，近似估计该状态通向成功的概率。动作优势则由边两端的价值增量给出，形式上接近 1-step TD error。与 GiGPO 这类只在同一局部状态内比较动作的方法不同，G2PO 会把全图所有边的 TD error 放入一个全局参考组做标准化，从而让跨状态、跨阶段的关键转移也能得到较高权重。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 AppWorld 三个长程 Agent benchmark，模型包括 Qwen-2.5-1.5B、7B 和 14B。论文报告 G2PO 相比 prompt-based 方法和 RL baseline 都有稳定收益。相对 GRPO，在 WebShop 上最高提升 22.2% success rate，在 ALFWorld 上最高提升 14.4%。AppWorld 用于验证复杂环境观察下的有效性。作者强调该方法主要改变 advantage 估计和样本组织方式，几乎不引入额外计算成本。文中还用状态价值方差分析说明，基于单条轨迹的估计容易受后续随机失败或偶然成功影响，而 state-group 聚合能缓解这一问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 对 trajectory-level、step-level 和 graph-level 视角的对比；方法部分重点看 state grouping 的定义、value aggregation 的公式、edge-centric advantage 以及全局标准化方式。实验部分优先看 WebShop/ALFWorld 的主表和关于状态价值方差、局部归一化与全局归一化的消融。需要特别留意 state similarity 如何判定，因为这是方法能否从 benchmark 迁移到真实网页、软件环境或多模态 Agent 的关键细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in long-horizon agentic RL. Step-level training reduces context growth, but it still treats exploration as isolated linear trajectories, which gives noisy value estimates and weak credit assignment under sparse delayed rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. Its value is in how it reorganizes interaction data before applying RL. For researchers working on RL-based agent training, RL pretraining, or environment-interaction mid-training, the main lesson is that trajectories can be lifted into a state-transition graph, and the training signal can be computed on that graph rather than on individual rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: G2PO reconstructs sampled agent trajectories into a directed state-transition graph. Identical or similar observations are grouped into state groups, and actions become edges between source and destination states. State value is estimated by aggregating outcomes over all states in the same group, instead of relying on one trajectory’s terminal reward. Action advantage is then computed from the value increment across an edge, which resembles a one-step TD error in sparse-reward tasks. Unlike local group methods such as GiGPO, which compare actions only within the same state, G2PO normalizes edge-level TD errors against a global reference group containing transitions from the whole graph. This gives more weight to transitions that make large absolute progress toward task success.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses WebShop, ALFWorld, and AppWorld with Qwen-2.5 models at 1.5B, 7B, and 14B scale. G2PO consistently improves over prompt-based methods and RL baselines. The reported gains over GRPO reach up to 22.2 percentage points in success rate on WebShop and 14.4 points on ALFWorld. AppWorld is used to test the method under more complex observations. The claimed overhead is minimal because the method changes the advantage estimation and grouping procedure rather than adding expensive model calls. The paper also analyzes variance in state-value estimation and argues that aggregating over state groups is less sensitive to accidental success or failure in a single rollout.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on Figure 1 for the shift from trajectory-level and step-level views to a graph view. In the method section, read the definitions of state grouping, group-aggregated value estimation, edge-centric advantage, and global normalization. In the experiments, prioritize the main WebShop and ALFWorld tables, plus ablations on graph aggregation and local versus global normalization. The most important implementation detail to check is how observation similarity is defined, since this will determine whether the method transfers beyond clean benchmark environments.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法定义和 credit assignment 实验即可；若图结构优势估计稳定，值得在内部长程 agent RL 里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and credit-assignment ablations; if the graph-based estimator is stable, it is worth reproducing in internal long-horizon agent RL.

paper.title: Drowning in Routine: Signal Dilution in Multi-Turn Agent Training
paper.abstract: Multi-turn agents interleave consequential decisions with routine execution: some actions change the downstream return distribution, while others are necessary but reward-equivalent. The cost of trajectory-level credit assignment, often attributed to long horizons, is in fact governed by decision density $ρ$: the fraction of turns whose actions affect the return. When decision density is low, routine turns create signal dilution: they add gradient variance to trajectory-level estimators such as
