summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是把 token credit assignment 写成带权 REINFORCE / GRPO / RLOO 估计器：轨迹级 advantage 仍由 outcome reward 和 prompt-level baseline 给出，但 token 梯度项乘以位置权重 w_t，并做长度归一化，使不同 weighting scheme 的总更新尺度可比。第二步是分析已有 intrinsic weighting 的退化机制。surprisal、entropy reduction、policy-reference divergence 都依赖输出分布差异；LoRA 更新幅度受低秩结构限制，policy 与 reference 的 token 分布差异容易缺少足够的位置信息，归一化后就会变成 uniform broadcast 或 spurious sparsity。ARCA 不再从输出分布估计 salience，而是直接测量 adapter 对 hidden state 的影响：对同一输入做一次正常前向，再做一次关闭 adapter 的前向，用每个位置的 adapter residual 范数 ||h_adapted_t - h_base_t||_2 作为 salience，再归一化成 token 权重。这个信号与 LoRA 实际参与计算的位置相关，不需要额外 reward model、value model 或 tree search。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-1.7B，在 MATH 上做 matched sweep，并报告七次运行设置。重点不是只比较最终准确率，而是先用 concentration diagnostics 检查 token 权重是否仍有结构。指标包括 weight Gini 和 effective token count，用来区分近似均匀分配、过度稀疏分配和较健康的位置差异。结果显示，输出分布型 token salience 在 LoRA 设置下容易退化；ARCA 的 adapter-residual 权重保持更稳定的非均匀结构，并在同等 RL 训练设置下给出更合理的 credit redistribution。给定内容没有提供完整数值表，因此不宜外推具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 分钟。优先看 Methods 中 estimator 的定义，尤其是 token 权重如何插入 GRPO / RLOO，以及长度归一化如何避免把 credit assignment 和学习率缩放混在一起。再看退化分析部分，重点关注为什么 LoRA 下 output-distribution salience 会被压平或变成任务无关稀疏。实验部分主要看 Gini、effective token count 与 MATH 结果的对应关系。值得深挖的是 adapter residual 是否会受 layer 选择、LoRA rank、adapter 初始化、训练阶段影响；如果这些因素强相关，ARCA 更像一组 LoRA-RL 诊断工具，而不只是一个 weighting rule。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in token-level credit assignment when RL fine-tuning is performed with LoRA. Many token weighting methods assume a fully trainable policy and derive salience from output-distribution quantities such as surprisal, entropy reduction, or policy-reference divergence. Under LoRA, the policy is restricted to a low-rank neighborhood of the reference model. After within-trajectory normalization, these signals can collapse into nearly uniform weights or concentrate on a small set of task-agnostic positions.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a clearer interface between RL post-training and the trainable parameterization. It shows that credit assignment is not independent of the adaptation mechanism. For RLVR and reasoning-oriented LoRA training, a token weighting rule designed under full fine-tuning may lose useful structure before optimization starts. This is useful for pretraining researchers because it connects reward signal quality, parameter subspace, and gradient geometry. The contribution is best viewed as a diagnostic and recipe-level correction rather than a new large-scale training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates token credit assignment as a weighted REINFORCE-style estimator on top of trajectory-level rewards. The scalar advantage can come from RLOO or GRPO-style prompt-level normalization, while token weights redistribute that advantage across positions. Length normalization keeps the total update scale comparable across weighting rules. The analysis then shows why output-distribution salience can degenerate under LoRA: the low-rank adapter induces only limited movement away from the reference distribution, so normalized token differences may no longer carry meaningful positional information. ARCA replaces output-distribution salience with an adapter-internal signal. It computes the per-token norm of the adapter residual, ||h_adapted_t - h_base_t||_2, by comparing a normal forward pass with a forward pass where the adapter is disabled. The resulting weights track where the adapter actually changes hidden states and require no value model, reward model, or search procedure.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical setup uses Qwen3-1.7B on MATH with a matched seven-run sweep. The paper emphasizes concentration diagnostics before downstream accuracy. It measures weight Gini and effective token count to identify uniform broadcast, excessive sparsity, and usable token-level variation. The reported pattern is that output-distribution-based salience often degenerates under LoRA, while ARCA preserves more stable non-uniform token weights and gives a more coherent redistribution of trajectory-level advantages. The supplied content does not expose the full numerical tables, so exact gains should be checked in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient for most readers, around 30 minutes. Focus on the estimator definition in the methods section, especially how token weights are inserted into GRPO or RLOO and why length normalization matters. Then read the degeneration analysis for output-distribution salience under LoRA. In the experiments, look at the relationship between Gini, effective token count, and MATH performance. The most useful follow-up question is whether adapter-residual salience changes with LoRA rank, layer placement, initialization, and training phase.

recommendation.zh: 精准指出了 LoRA 做 RL 时 token 级别 reward 信号退化的问题，并用 adapter 残差做 credit assignment，对做 post-train 的人很有启发。
recommendation.en: Accurately identifies the degeneration of token-level reward signals when doing RL with LoRA, and uses adapter residuals for credit assignment, highly inspiring for post-train researchers.

paper.title: VeriGate: Verifier-Gated Step-Level Supervision for GRPO
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is an effective recipe for training reasoning models with verifier-based outcome rewards, but its supervision is sparse: when all sampled trajectories for a prompt receive the same verifier reward, the group-relative advantage collapses to zero and learning stalls. Outcome-only rewards also provide no step-level credit assignment, limiting exploration and making it harder to learn robust reasoning. We present VeriGate (Verifier-Gated Step-Level GRPO), a

summary.core_problem: 现有仅依赖验证器结果奖励的GRPO算法在难推理任务上存在奖励退化导致的零梯度问题，同时缺乏细粒度步级信用分配；而直接引入过程奖励模型（PRM）又会破坏验证器的权威性，引入奖励黑客风险，且步级奖励聚合易产生累积误差，三类需求难以同时兼顾。
summary.importance: 该方法解决了GRPO在推理任务训练中的核心痛点，在保留可验证奖励可靠性的前提下补充了稠密的过程监督信号，对大推理模型的RL训练流程优化有直接的工程参考价值，也为对齐训练中结果奖励与过程奖励的结合提供了新的实现范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VeriGate三步核心设计：1）验证器门控机制：仅当同组所有采样轨迹都获得零验证器奖励、GRPO出现零梯度时才启用PRM监督，否则完全沿用标准GRPO的验证器奖励更新，保留验证器的最高优先级；2）未来累积奖励信用分配：不将PRM步级得分聚合为单轨迹标量，而是转换为未来累积奖励，每个token根据其后续推理路径的质量获得对应信用；3）组归一化token级优势：将未来累积奖励转换为组归一化的token级优势，直接替换退化的GRPO轨迹级更新；该设计对PRM奖励的逐prompt正仿射变换具有不变性，可降低奖励黑客风险。
summary.experiments: 在MATH数据集上训练1.5B和7B规模的Qwen2.5-Instruct模型，在6个推理基准上平均准确率分别提升20%和12%；显著降低零梯度失败的比例，相比纯结果GRPO和将PRM作为结果奖励的基线，奖励黑客行为大幅减少。实验同时显示1.5B基础模型在MATH数据集上有45.6%的prompt会出现全零奖励组，训练1个epoch后仍有39.9%的比例，验证了零梯度问题的普遍性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言的核心设计思路和GRPO缺陷分析章节，重点关注验证器门控的触发逻辑和未来累积奖励的计算方式，预计阅读时间15-25分钟，实验部分的消融结果可按需查阅。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing outcome-only GRPO suffers from zero-gradient problems caused by reward degeneracy on hard reasoning tasks, and lacks fine-grained step-level credit assignment; directly introducing Process Reward Models (PRMs) undermines verifier authority, introduces reward hacking risks, and step reward aggregation is prone to cumulative errors, making it difficult to balance all three requirements.
summary_en.importance: This method solves the core pain point of GRPO for reasoning task training, supplements dense process supervision while retaining the reliability of verifiable rewards, providing direct engineering reference for RL training optimization of large reasoning models, and a new paradigm for combining outcome and process rewards in alignment training.
summary_en.technical_approach: VeriGate adopts three core designs: 1) Verifier gating mechanism: PRM supervision is only enabled when all sampled trajectories in a group receive zero verifier reward and GRPO encounters zero gradient, otherwise standard GRPO updates with verifier rewards are fully adopted to retain verifier authority; 2) Future-cumulated reward credit assignment: PRM step scores are not aggregated into a single trajectory scalar, but converted into future-cumulated rewards, so each token receives credit based on the quality of the subsequent reasoning path it enables; 3) Group-normalized token-level advantages: future-cumulated rewards are converted into group-normalized token-level advantages to replace degenerate trajectory-level GRPO updates. The design is invariant to prompt-wise positive affine transformations of PRM rewards, reducing reward hacking risks.
summary_en.experiments: 1.5B and 7B Qwen2.5-Instruct models trained on MATH achieve 20% and 12% average accuracy improvements respectively on 6 reasoning benchmarks; zero-gradient failure rates are significantly reduced, and reward hacking behavior is greatly decreased compared to outcome-only GRPO and PRM-as-outcome baselines. Experiments also show 45.6% of prompts for the 1.5B base model produce all-zero reward groups on MATH, and the proportion remains 39.9% after one training epoch, verifying the universality of the zero-gradient problem.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, prioritize core design ideas in the introduction and the analysis of GRPO defects, focus on the trigger logic of verifier gating and the calculation of future-cumulated rewards. Expected reading time is 15-25 minutes, and ablation results in the experiment section can be consulted as needed.

recommendation.zh: verifier-gated切换+未来累积奖励两个设计点都有实际价值，应在内部RL推理训练中做ablation；建议读§3方法细节。
recommendation.en: Both the verifier-gated switching and future-cumulated reward designs have practical value; should be ablated in internal RL reasoning training pipelines. Read §3 for method details.

paper.title: Influence-Guided Symbolic Regression: Scientific Discovery via LLM-Driven Equation Search with Granular Feedback
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for scientific discovery, yet their application to symbolic regression is often constrained by inefficient search strategies and coarse feedback signals. Current methods typically guide LLMs using scalar metrics (e.g., global Mean Squared Error), which fail to identify which components of a proposed equation are driving performance or causing error. We introduce \textit{Influence-Guided Symbolic Regression} (IGSR), a method that frames equati

summary.core_problem: 让LLM在符号回归/方程发现中获得“更细粒度的反馈”，从而提升搜索效率与可控性。
summary.importance: 把“标量奖励”改成“可归因的分项贡献信号”，这类credit assignment思路对RL/对齐与工具使用型agent有借鉴，但不直接触及预训练recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 两步迭代：LLM生成候选基函数/项；用影响分数Δ_j评估每一项对泛化误差的边际贡献并剪枝；再把该机制嵌入MCTS做结构搜索与改写。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据集与数值；应与仅用全局MSE/标量得分引导的LLM搜索、以及无影响分解的MCTS/启发式方法对比样本效率与最终拟合/泛化。

summary_en.core_problem: Improve LLM-based symbolic regression by providing granular, term-level feedback instead of a single scalar score.
summary_en.importance: A credit-assignment upgrade (from scalar reward to attributable signals) that can inform RL/alignment and tool-using agents, but it is not pretraining work.
summary_en.technical_approach: Iterate between (1) LLM proposing candidate basis terms and (2) computing influence scores Δ_j for each term’s marginal generalization contribution to prune/refine; integrate into MCTS for structured equation search.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks datasets/numbers; likely compares against scalar-MSE-guided LLM search and MCTS baselines on sample efficiency and generalization.

recommendation.zh: 把“标量reward”拆成可归因的分项反馈，credit assignment更干净；只需看影响分数定义+MCTS如何用它。
recommendation.en: Turns scalar reward into attributable term-level feedback for cleaner credit assignment; read the influence-score definition and how MCTS consumes it.

paper.title: Guidance Contrastive Token Credit Assignment for Discrete Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Group-advantage-based reinforcement learning methods, such as GRPO and DAPO, have demonstrated strong performance across diverse domains, including mathematical reasoning and text-to-image generation. However, their reliance on sample-level rewards introduces a key limitation as uniform credit assignment across all tokens fails to capture fine-grained, token-level contributions. To address this issue, we propose Guidance Contrastive Policy Optimization (GCPO), a novel algorithm that enables per-

summary.core_problem: GRPO 和 DAPO 等基于组优势的强化学习方法使用样本级奖励，对序列中所有 token 进行统一的信用分配，忽略了不同 token 在推理或生成中的实际贡献差异（例如 CoT 中关键推理步骤与填充词的区别）。
summary.importance: 提出了一种细粒度的 token 级信用分配方法，通过对比正负 prompt 下的模型预测差异来估计每个 token 的重要性，为离散策略优化提供了更精确的监督信号。该思路可跨文本和图像两种模态应用，对 RL post-training 的精细化发展有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: GCPO（Guidance Contrastive Policy Optimization）的核心是用 classifier-free guidance（CFG）的思想来做 token 信用分配：对同一策略分别在正 prompt（正常输入）和负 prompt（如图像生成中的空 prompt、语言任务中的"请生成错误答案"）下进行预测，计算每个 token 位置上正负预测分布的 KL 散度，将其作为该 token 的重要性权重。然后用这些权重对样本级优势进行加权，替代 GRPO 中统一的优势广播。为了解决 KL 散度数值范围不稳定、超参难调的问题，论文采用基于排序（rank-based）的归一化方法，根据每个 token 在序列内的 KL 排名来分配权重，而非使用原始 KL 值。GCPO 在文本到图像生成和 VLM 的多模态思维链推理两个场景中进行了验证。
summary.experiments: 论文在文本到图像生成和 VLM 多模态推理两个领域进行了实验。在图像生成中，GCPO 通过更精确的 token 权重提升了训练稳定性和下游性能；在 VLM 推理中，即使推理过程不使用 CFG，GCPO 的 token 加权仍然带来了性能提升。由于提供的全文内容截断，具体的模型规模、数据集和量化指标需要参考论文完整版本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议重点关注第 3 节（GCPO 方法）中 token 信用分配的核心机制——正负 prompt 对比和 KL 散度计算；以及第 3.2 节中基于排序的归一化技巧，这是工程落地的关键。实验部分关注图像和文本两个模态的结果对比。预计阅读时间 30-45 分钟。值得注意的深挖点：负 prompt 的选择对语言任务的敏感性、排序归一化与 softmax/clip 的对比、以及该方法与其他 token 级信用分配工作（如基于梯度或熵的方法）的相对优劣。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在提供的文本中明确给出，需参考论文完整版本。

summary_en.core_problem: Group-advantage-based RL methods like GRPO and DAPO use sample-level rewards and assign uniform credit across all tokens in a sequence, ignoring the heterogeneous contributions of different tokens—for example, critical reasoning steps versus filler words in chain-of-thought.
summary_en.importance: GCPO proposes a fine-grained token-level credit assignment mechanism that estimates per-token importance by contrasting model predictions under positive versus negative prompts, providing more precise supervision signals for discrete policy optimization. The idea spans both text and image modalities, informing the refinement of RL post-training methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: GCPO (Guidance Contrastive Policy Optimization) applies classifier-free guidance (CFG) to token credit assignment. The same policy generates predictions under both a positive prompt (normal input) and a negative prompt (e.g., empty prompt for image generation, "please generate a wrong answer" for language tasks). The KL divergence between positive and negative prediction distributions at each token position is computed and used as an importance weight. These weights then scale the sample-level advantage, replacing the uniform advantage broadcasting in GRPO. To handle the unstable numerical range of KL divergence and avoid task-specific hyperparameter tuning, a rank-based normalization is employed: per-token weights are derived from the KL divergence's rank within the sequence rather than its raw value. GCPO is validated in two settings: text-to-image generation and multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning in VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover text-to-image generation and VLM multimodal reasoning. In image generation, GCPO improves training stability and downstream performance through more precise token weighting. In VLM reasoning, GCPO's token weighting still yields gains even when CFG is not used during inference. Specific model sizes, datasets, and quantitative metrics require the full paper as the provided content is truncated.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on Section 3 (the GCPO method), particularly the core mechanism of positive/negative prompt contrast and KL divergence computation, and Section 3.2 on rank-based normalization—the key engineering detail. In experiments, compare results across image and text modalities. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes. Worth deeper investigation: the sensitivity of negative prompt selection for language tasks, comparison of rank-based normalization versus softmax/clipping, and how this approach compares with other token-level credit assignment methods (e.g., gradient-based or entropy-based).
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author details are not explicitly provided in the available text; refer to the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation；若 contrastive advantage 稳定，它会改变 RLVR 里“整段奖励足够好”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the contrastive advantage is stable, it weakens the default assumption that sequence-level rewards are enough for RLVR.

paper.title: Beyond Trajectory Rewards: Step-level Credit Assignment for Agentic Search via Graph Modeling
paper.abstract: In Agentic Search, trajectory-level outcome rewards fail to quantify the behavioral contributions of individual steps, while existing step-level reward methods typically rely on costly tree sampling. We view world knowledge as a latent world graph and each IS task as search within a latent task graph, where effective steps should make graph progress toward the answer node. Based on this prior, we propose Graph-Distance Contribution Reward (GDCR), a step-level process reward that scores newly-ret

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agentic search 里的 credit assignment：最终答案对错只能给整条轨迹一个稀疏奖励，但搜索型 agent 的关键能力恰恰体现在中间步骤——检索了什么实体、是否把有用实体真正纳入后续思考、哪些步骤在向答案逼近，哪些只是绕路。已有 step-level reward 方法通常靠 tree sampling 展开多条后续轨迹，再把叶子奖励回传给中间节点，计算代价很高，尤其在长轨迹信息检索任务里更难扩展。作者想要的是一种不依赖大规模树采样、但仍能给每一步分配相对合理信用的方法。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练不是同一层问题，但和 post-train、RL、长程推理 agent 的训练信号设计直接相关。对做 RL for search / tool-use / deep research agent 的人，这篇工作的启发点在于：如果任务天然有外部知识结构，就可以把“是否朝答案推进”显式化，而不必完全依赖 rollout 估值。这个思路对 credit assignment 很实用，也可能迁移到代码搜索、网页导航、多跳检索等场景。贡献量级偏中等，属于 RL 信号工程和 agent training recipe 的改进，不是通用 RL 理论突破。对纯 pretrain 研究者，价值主要在于理解后训练阶段如何构造更密的过程监督。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个 answer-grounded graph-progress prior。作者把世界知识看成潜在 world graph，把每个信息检索任务看成其中一个 query-conditioned latent task graph，答案节点是搜索终点。一个好的中间步骤，应该让 agent 在这个图上更接近答案节点。由于真实 latent graph 不可见，训练时作者为每个 QA 样本构造一个 Entity-Relation graph 作为代理图，节点是实体，边是语义或关系连接。

在这个图上，作者定义了 Graph-Distance Contribution Reward，简称 GDCR。它不只看当前 step 检索到了哪些新实体，还看当前 thought 里引用了哪些新实体。原因很直接：有些实体虽然被检索到了，但没有进入后续推理链，对最终答案并没有形成有效贡献。于是 GDCR 分成两部分：newly-retrieved entities 的贡献，以及 newly-cited entities 的贡献。每个实体的分数由它到答案节点的最短路径距离决定，越接近答案，贡献越高。这样做的直觉是，用图距离近似“这一步是否在向答案推进”。

在优化层面，作者提出 SAPO，Step Advantage Policy Optimization。它先对一条轨迹内的 GDCR 做归一化和截断，再把 trajectory-level outcome advantage 和 step-level GDCR advantage 结合起来训练策略。这样既保留最终答案目标，又给中间关键行为更细的奖励。和 ARPO 这类基于树采样的 step-level 方法相比，SAPO 不需要为每个中间节点展开大量 continuation，因此训练效率更高。

这个方法的关键假设也很明确：训练时能拿到答案，并能构造质量尚可的 ER graph；图上的最短路径距离能近似真实任务中的信息价值；实体抽取和引用检测足够可靠。如果这些前提不成立，step reward 可能会偏。另一个值得注意的点是，它奖励的是“靠近答案的实体进展”，因此更适合事实型、多跳检索任务；对需要抽象规划、策略试探、或答案不对应单一实体节点的任务，图距离未必是好代理。
summary.experiments:
从正文可见，作者在 4 个具有挑战性的 benchmark 上验证 SAPO，并把它与 trajectory-level RL 以及代表性的 tree-sampling step-level 方法 ARPO 做比较。摘要明确给出的结论是：SAPO 在性能和训练效率上都优于 ARPO。这里最重要的不是单个分数，而是它证明了一个更便宜的 step credit 近似可以替代昂贵树采样的一大部分作用。

实验设计上，作者还做了针对性分析，支持 GDCR 的两个组成部分都有必要。文中提到一项分布分析：有些被检索到的实体虽然与答案相关，但如果没有在后续 thought 中被显式引用，就不会真正推动最终解答。这正是把 newly-cited entities 单独纳入 reward 的原因。换句话说，作者不是只奖励 retrieval recall，而是同时奖励“检索到”与“用起来”。

虽然当前给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但从论文叙述可以确认几件事：一，任务是长轨迹、复杂信息检索，不是单步 QA；二，SAPO 的优势之一是训练成本低于树采样方法；三，收益来自 reward sparsity 的缓解和对关键步骤的更细粒度强化。读实验时应重点看：不同 benchmark 上提升是否稳定；效率比较是按 wall-clock、sample efficiency 还是 rollout 数量衡量；以及当 ER graph 噪声变大时，GDCR 是否仍然稳健。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，把 latent world graph / task graph 的建模直觉吃透。然后直接看 GDCR 定义，弄清楚 reward 到底如何从 newly-retrieved 和 newly-cited entities 计算出来，距离函数如何映射成分数，是否有归一化或截断。接着看 SAPO 的 advantage 公式，理解它是怎样把 step reward 和 trajectory reward 混合的。

实验部分重点看三类内容：一是与 ARPO 及纯 trajectory-level RL 的主结果对比；二是 newly-cited reward 的消融，因为这是这篇工作相对直观但也最容易被忽略的贡献；三是效率分析，确认它节省的是训练算力还是采样预算。若时间有限，30 分钟内读完方法和主实验即可形成判断。

值得深挖的点有三个。第一，ER graph 的构造质量决定了 reward 上限，图是从什么资源抽出来的、覆盖率如何、是否泄漏答案信息。第二，最短路径距离是否过于局部，能否被更强的图表示或 learned value 取代。第三，这种 graph-based step reward 能否迁移到非检索型 agent，比如代码修复或网页操作，其中“答案节点”未必是显式实体。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in agentic search. Final-answer rewards are sparse and assign the same signal to all steps, even though search trajectories contain highly uneven contributions: some retrievals uncover the key bridge entity, some citations actually move reasoning forward, and many steps are redundant. Existing step-level methods often rely on tree sampling and reward backpropagation from sampled continuations, which becomes expensive for long-horizon information-seeking tasks. The goal here is to obtain useful step-level credit without that rollout cost.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training and RL for search-heavy agents. The main value is methodological: if a task has an external knowledge structure, one can turn progress toward the answer into an explicit training signal instead of estimating everything through sampled futures. That is a practical idea for search agents and may transfer to multi-hop retrieval, web research, or code search settings. The contribution is moderate in scale: it improves RL signal design and training efficiency rather than introducing a new general RL framework.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central idea is an answer-grounded graph-progress prior. The authors view world knowledge as a latent world graph and each information-seeking task as a query-conditioned latent task graph whose terminal node is the answer. A good intermediate step should move the agent closer to that answer node. Since the true latent graph is unavailable, they build a training-time Entity-Relation graph for each QA instance as a proxy, with entities as nodes and semantic or relational links as edges.

On top of that graph, they define Graph-Distance Contribution Reward, or GDCR. The reward has two components. One scores newly retrieved entities at the current step; the other scores newly cited entities that appear in the current thought. This distinction matters because retrieval alone is not enough: an entity may be fetched but never used in subsequent reasoning. Each entity receives a contribution score based on its shortest-path distance to the answer node, with closer entities receiving higher reward. The intuition is simple: graph distance acts as a proxy for whether the step makes meaningful progress toward the answer.

They then introduce Step Advantage Policy Optimization, SAPO. SAPO normalizes and bounds GDCR within each trajectory, then combines trajectory-level outcome advantages with GDCR-based step advantages during policy optimization. This preserves the final-answer objective while giving denser reinforcement to critical intermediate behaviors. Compared with tree-sampling methods such as ARPO, SAPO avoids expanding many continuations from each step, which is where the efficiency gain comes from.

The assumptions are important. The method needs answer supervision during training, a reasonably good ER graph, and reliable entity extraction plus citation detection. It is also better suited to fact-centric multi-hop search where progress can be represented as movement toward an answer entity. For tasks requiring abstract planning or where the answer is not naturally an entity node, shortest-path distance may be a weak proxy.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates SAPO on four challenging benchmarks and compares it against trajectory-level RL baselines as well as ARPO, a representative tree-sampling step-level method. The headline result stated in the paper is that SAPO outperforms ARPO in both performance and training efficiency. The key point is less about one benchmark number and more about the demonstration that a cheap graph-based proxy can recover much of the benefit of expensive step-level rollout estimation.

The analysis also supports the need for both reward components. The authors note that some retrieved entities are answer-relevant but never explicitly cited later, which means they do not actually contribute to the final reasoning chain. This motivates rewarding newly cited entities separately from newly retrieved ones. In other words, the method does not only reward retrieval recall; it rewards retrieval that gets incorporated into reasoning.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so exact benchmark numbers are not recoverable here. Still, several conclusions are clear from the paper text: the tasks involve long-horizon information seeking rather than single-step QA; SAPO's advantage includes lower training cost than tree-sampling methods; and the gain comes from reducing reward sparsity while reinforcing high-value intermediate actions. When reading the experiments, the most important checks are whether gains are consistent across datasets, how efficiency is measured, and how robust GDCR remains when the ER graph is noisy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the motivating figure. The paper is easiest to understand if the latent world-graph and task-graph intuition is clear from the beginning. Then go directly to the GDCR definition and inspect how rewards are computed from newly retrieved and newly cited entities, how shortest-path distance is mapped to a scalar reward, and whether any normalization or clipping is applied. After that, read the SAPO objective to see exactly how step-level and trajectory-level advantages are combined.

In the experiments, focus on three things: the main comparison against ARPO and pure trajectory-level RL, the ablation on the newly cited reward term, and the efficiency analysis. Those three pieces are enough to judge whether the method is merely plausible or actually useful. A solid skim should take around 30 minutes.

Three deeper questions are worth pursuing. First, the quality of the ER graph likely sets the ceiling for the method, so inspect how the graph is built and whether answer leakage is possible. Second, shortest-path distance is a hand-crafted proxy; consider whether a learned graph value function could do better. Third, think about transfer: this reward design is natural for retrieval-centric agents, but much less obviously applicable to agents whose state is not organized around explicit entities.

recommendation.zh: 只看 GDCR 定义和 SAPO ablation；图距离奖励是便宜的过程监督，但会受 ER graph 构建噪声限制。
recommendation.en: Read the GDCR definition and SAPO ablation; graph-distance reward is cheap process supervision, but ER-graph noise is the likely failure point.

paper.title: ESPO: Early-Stopping Proximal Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: When a large language model under reinforcement learning commits a wrong reasoning step early in a trajectory, standard algorithms force it to keep generating until the maximum horizon, spending compute on tokens that never receive positive reward and polluting advantage estimates with post-failure noise. We propose ESPO (Early-Stopping Proximal Policy Optimization), which detects trajectory failure on-the-fly and terminates rollouts early. At each generation step, ESPO computes a surrogate regr

summary.core_problem: 在 LLM 的 RL 训练中，模型一旦在推理轨迹早期犯下错误，标准 PPO 类算法仍会强制其继续生成直到最大长度，导致两方面浪费：一是在注定失败的 token 上消耗计算，二是这些失败后 token 的优势估计会引入噪声，误导梯度方向。
summary.importance: 提出了一种零额外成本的 rollout 早期终止机制，可直接嵌入现有 PPO/DAPO/GRPO 等 RL 训练 pipeline，同时提升训练效率和最终效果。对 RL pretrain（如 R1-Zero 范式）的训练成本优化有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: ESPO 不改动 PPO 的目标函数，仅在 rollout 收集阶段加入终止判断。核心组件包括：(1) 每步替代遗憾（surrogate regret）：从解码时已计算的 logits 中提取，衡量采样 token 与贪心最优 token 的偏离度；(2) EMA 归一化：用指数移动平均维持遗憾信号与 critic 值估计的尺度可比性；(3) 值门控停止准则：当归一化的累积遗憾显著超过 critic 估计的剩余价值时，终止 rollout；(4) 终端失败惩罚：将截断轨迹视为吸收失败状态，在停止步产生集中的负 TD-error，避免逐步 reward shaping 带来的非平稳偏置。
summary.experiments: 在 1.5B 和 7B 模型上对比 PPO 和 DAPO。1.5B 规模下，ESPO 在三个 benchmark 上平均准确率 59.09%（PPO 57.03%，DAPO 58.29%），累计消耗 token 9.28 亿（DAPO 12.24 亿，减少 24%；PPO 10.70 亿，减少 13%）。随机截断消融实验（保持相同截断率但忽略策略置信度和价值估计）在 AIME 2024 上仅得 42.4%，确认了提升来源于截断位置的智能判断而非单纯减少 token 用量。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 章方法部分（替代遗憾的定义和停止准则推导）、表 2 中的消融实验（特别是 Variant F 随机截断对照）。预计阅读时间 20-25 分钟。核心创新在于完全复用已有 logit 和 critic 信号，不引入额外可训练参数。

summary_en.core_problem: In RL training for LLMs, once a model makes an early error in a reasoning trajectory, standard PPO-like algorithms force it to continue generating until the maximum horizon, leading to compute waste on doomed tokens and noisy advantage estimates that misdirect gradient signals.
summary_en.importance: Presents a zero-overhead early rollout termination mechanism that can be directly embedded into existing RL training pipelines (PPO/DAPO/GRPO), improving both training efficiency and final performance. Offers practical cost optimization for RL pretrain paradigms like R1-Zero.
summary_en.technical_approach: ESPO does not modify the PPO objective; it only adds a termination check during rollout collection. Core components: (1) Per-step surrogate regret: computed from logits already available during decoding, measuring the gap between the sampled token and the greedy action; (2) EMA normalization: maintains scale comparability between the regret signal and critic value estimates throughout training; (3) Value-gated stopping criterion: terminates the rollout when normalized cumulative regret significantly exceeds the critic's estimated remaining value; (4) Terminal failure penalty: treats truncated trajectories as absorbing failure states, producing concentrated negative TD-error at the stopping step without the non-stationary bias of per-step reward shaping.
summary_en.experiments: Compared PPO and DAPO at 1.5B and 7B scales. At 1.5B, ESPO achieved 59.09% average accuracy across three benchmarks (PPO: 57.03%, DAPO: 58.29%) while consuming 928M total tokens (DAPO: 1224M, -24%; PPO: 1070M, -13%). A random truncation ablation (matching ESPO's truncation rate but ignoring policy confidence and value estimates) scored only 42.4% on AIME 2024, confirming improvements come from intelligent truncation decisions, not reduced token budget alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (method derivation of surrogate regret and stopping criterion), and ablation studies in Table 2, especially Variant F random truncation control. Expected reading time: 20-25 minutes. The key insight is reusing existing logit and critic signals with no additional trainable parameters.

recommendation.zh: 结果幅度不大，但 early-failure credit assignment 很对路；读算法和 compute-normalized 消融，别只看 AIME 数字。
recommendation.en: The headline gain is modest, but early-failure credit assignment is the right target; read the algorithm and compute-normalized ablations, not just AIME.

paper.title: StepOPSD: Step-Aware Online Preference Distillation for Agent Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for multi-turn agents suffers from a credit-assignment mismatch: rewards are sparse and trajectory-level, while success often hinges on a few local decisions. Existing online policy distillation (OPD) provides denser token-level supervision, but typically treats heterogeneous agent trajectories as monolithic strings rather than causal interaction units. We present StepOPSD, a post-rollout preference self-distillation framework that takes the agent step as the unit of credi

summary.core_problem: 多轮智能体强化学习存在信用分配错配问题：奖励稀疏且仅在整条轨迹维度发放，而任务成败往往取决于少数局部决策；现有在线策略蒸馏方法将异质的智能体轨迹视为整体字符串，忽略交互的因果单元边界，在环境观测等模型不可控的token上浪费监督信号。
summary.importance: 为智能体后训练阶段的RL与蒸馏信号融合提供了轻量的信用重分配思路，在不改变在线交互逻辑的前提下优化RL的优势估计，对GRPO类RL训练流程的改进有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出以智能体交互步为单位的事后偏好自蒸馏框架StepOPSD。首先将完整轨迹拆解为以行动为中心的步段，过滤掉环境观测等模型不可控的token；为每个步段构造加入事后信息的教师上下文，对比师生模型的token对数概率差，基于标准化的每步信用预算，转换为保留符号的优势塑形项，注入GRPO更新流程。与RLSD对全序列token重加权、SDAR对全序列做软token门控的方法不同，StepOPSD将监督限定在实际驱动智能体行为的行动段内，是现有GRPO pipeline的可插拔模块，完全不改动在线rollout逻辑。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld的Heat、PickTwo子集和Search-QA的TriviaQA、HotpotQA子集上取得最优或次优成绩；消融实验发现更小的局部裁剪阈值α_clip能普遍提升训练稳定性，全局混合强度λ_mix则具有任务依赖性：具身控制任务适合更弱的塑形，检索类QA适合更强的塑形。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读方法章节的步段拆分规则和优势塑形公式，实验部分的双参数调优结论，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning faces a credit assignment mismatch: rewards are sparse and distributed only at the full trajectory level, while task success usually depends on a small number of local decisions. Existing online policy distillation methods treat heterogeneous agent trajectories as monolithic strings, ignoring causal interaction unit boundaries and wasting supervision on tokens that the model cannot control, such as environment observations.
summary_en.importance: It provides a lightweight credit redistribution approach for integrating RL and distillation signals in agent post-training, optimizing RL advantage estimation without modifying online interaction logic, and has direct reference value for improving GRPO-based RL training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: StepOPSD is a hindsight preference self-distillation framework centered on agent interaction steps. It first decomposes full trajectories into action-centered step segments, filtering out uncontrollable tokens such as environment observations. For each step segment, it constructs a teacher context augmented with hindsight information, compares the token log-probability gap between teacher and student, and converts it into a sign-preserving advantage shaping term based on a normalized per-step credit budget, which is injected into the GRPO update process. Unlike RLSD which reweights all tokens in the full sequence, or SDAR which applies soft token gating over the entire sequence, StepOPSD restricts supervision to action segments that actually drive agent behavior. It is a drop-in module for existing GRPO pipelines and does not change online rollout dynamics at all.
summary_en.experiments: It achieves top-1 or top-2 performance on ALFWorld Heat, PickTwo subsets and Search-QA TriviaQA, HotpotQA subsets. Ablation studies show that smaller local clipping threshold α_clip generally improves training stability, while global mixing strength λ_mix is task-dependent: weaker shaping works better for embodied control tasks, and stronger shaping works better for retrieval QA tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the step segmentation rules and advantage shaping formula in the method section, and the two-parameter tuning conclusions in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 RL 奖励分配细化到 step 级别，对长序列 agent 训练的 credit assignment 有启发，值得关注其 advantage shaping 的具体实现。
recommendation.en: Refining RL reward assignment to the step level offers insights for credit assignment in long-horizon agent training; the advantage shaping implementation is worth checking.

paper.title: Knowing When to Ask: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for LLM Tool Use
paper.abstract: Humans know when to reach for help e.g. $347 \times 28$ warrants a calculator while $2+2$ does not. Language models do not. Prompt-based approaches can instruct a model when to invoke tools, but this scaffolding does not teach it to recognize the boundary of its own knowledge. RL approaches that assign a single outcome reward to the whole trajectory fare no better: trajectory-level credit cannot isolate which tool call in a successful episode actually helped, nor penalize unnecessary calls. We p

summary.core_problem: 训练 LLM 判断何时需要调用工具、何时应依赖参数知识，解决 trajectory-level reward 无法给单个工具调用分配责任的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工具使用 RL 的信用分配方法。它把“是否该问工具”从提示规则转成可学习的 competence boundary，对后训练和 agent 训练信号设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CARL，即 Competence-Aware Reinforcement Learning。它用模型自身 rollouts 训练 critic，在自然工具使用边界处分段，例如 code fence delimiter 和 context block transition；再从单个二元 outcome 中为每个 segment 分配独立 credit，不需要外部 judge 或 step-level annotation。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、任务集、baseline 数值和提升幅度。已知比较对象包括 prompt-based tool-use scaffolding 和单一 outcome reward 的 trajectory-level RL；实验意图是减少错误工具调用和不必要调用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper trains LLMs to decide when to call a tool and when to rely on parametric knowledge, addressing the failure of trajectory-level rewards to assign credit to individual tool calls.
summary_en.importance: This is a credit-assignment method for RL-based tool use. It turns the boundary between internal competence and external assistance from a prompt heuristic into a learned signal, making it relevant to post-training and agent training design.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARL, or Competence-Aware Reinforcement Learning, trains a critic on the model's own rollouts. It decomposes trajectories at natural tool-use boundaries such as code fence delimiters and context block transitions, then assigns independent segment-level credit from a single binary outcome without external judges or step-level annotations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, task suites, baseline numbers, or improvement magnitudes. The stated baselines are prompt-based tool-use scaffolds and trajectory-level RL with a single outcome reward; the intended effect is to reduce both missed and unnecessary tool calls.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 credit assignment 设计；若二元 outcome 真能稳定分段归因，可迁移到 RLVR 的过程信号构造。
recommendation.en: Read the credit-assignment design; if binary outcomes reliably yield segment credit, it can inform RLVR process-signal construction.

paper.title: Agents that Matter: Optimizing Multi-Agent LLMs via Removal-Based Attribution
paper.abstract: As multi-agent systems (MAS) become increasingly complex, identifying the contributions of individual agents is critical for system optimization. However, existing approaches lack a rigorous, unified framework for credit assignment. In this work, we formalize agent attribution as a cooperative game, parameterized by the coalition distribution, removal protocol, and target metric. Using this framework, we show that Leave-One-Out (LOO) identifies bottleneck agents as effectively as combinatorial m

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是多智能体 LLM 系统里的 credit assignment：当系统表现变好或变差时，如何把贡献或责任归因到具体 agent、角色和交互结构上，而不是只看整体成功率。
summary.importance: 这篇对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 agent 系统评测和后训练闭环有参考价值。它提醒了一点：多 agent 系统的能力不是单个模型能力的简单相加，角色拓扑、通信协议、移除方式和评价指标都会改变归因结果。对于用 agentic workflow 生成数据、做自动评测或做 RL 环境的研究，可靠的归因方法会影响训练信号质量。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 agent attribution 形式化为 protocol-conditioned cooperative game。一个归因查询由三部分定义：目标指标 G、coalition distribution 权重 w_i(S)、以及 removal protocol b。这个定义的关键是把“移除一个 agent”从一个默认操作变成显式协议。不同协议对应不同问题：直接 agent ablation 更像是在找结构瓶颈；LLM judge 的 introspective removal 更像是让模型想象缺失 agent 后会怎样，论文指出它不能忠实近似真实 ablation；model replacement 则把原 agent 替换成参考模型，用来衡量相对 backbone 的增益。方法上还比较了 Leave-One-Out 和更组合式的 Shapley 类方法，结论是 LOO 在识别瓶颈 agent 时已经足够有效，计算成本低很多。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖代码生成和医疗决策两个场景。主要结果包括：LOO 相比组合 coalition 方法减少约 3.2 到 7.5 倍计算开销，同时仍能有效识别关键 agent；agent ablation 会把归因集中到 orchestrator 等结构上不可缺少的角色；LLM judge 的 introspective removal 与真实 ablation 诱导出的归因游戏不同，不能直接替代。论文还提出 model replacement 协议，并用归因结果指导干预：将低归因 agent 替换为开源替代模型，在部分设置中性能提升最高约 17%，token 使用量最高下降约 35%。医疗场景中还观察到诊断准确率贡献和伦理对齐贡献可能解耦，提升准确率的 agent 不一定提升 ethics score。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看统一框架部分，尤其是 attribution query 如何由 metric、coalition distribution 和 removal protocol 共同决定；再看实验中 LOO 与 Shapley 类方法的计算-效果权衡，以及 ablation、introspective judge、model replacement 三种 removal protocol 的差异。对预训练研究员而言，最有用的是它对“训练或评测信号来自哪种反事实”的拆解，而不是具体 agent 应用场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in multi-agent LLM systems: when a system succeeds, fails, or improves, how should the contribution be assigned to individual agents, roles, and interaction structures rather than only to the aggregate workflow?
summary_en.importance: The work is not a direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining, but it is useful for agent evaluation and the post-training feedback loop. It makes clear that multi-agent performance is not a simple sum of model capabilities. Role topology, communication protocol, removal procedure, and target metric all change the attribution result. This matters for agentic data generation, automated evaluation, and RL environments where attribution quality affects the reliability of training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates agent attribution as a protocol-conditioned cooperative game. An attribution query is specified by a target metric G, a coalition distribution w_i(S), and a removal protocol b. The important design choice is that “removing an agent” is not treated as a fixed operation. Different protocols answer different questions. Direct agent ablation exposes structural bottlenecks such as orchestrators. Introspective removal with an LLM judge asks a model to simulate the missing-agent counterfactual, but the paper shows that it does not faithfully approximate real ablation. Model replacement replaces an agent with a reference model and measures contribution relative to the backbone. The paper also compares Leave-One-Out with combinatorial Shapley-style attribution and finds that LOO is often enough for identifying bottleneck agents at much lower cost.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover code generation and medical decision-making. Key findings include: LOO reduces computation by roughly 3.2x to 7.5x compared with combinatorial coalition methods while still identifying important agents; direct ablation concentrates attribution on structurally indispensable roles such as orchestrators; introspective LLM judges induce a different attribution game from real ablation and should not be treated as a drop-in proxy. The proposed model-replacement protocol is used for intervention: replacing low-attribution agents with open-source alternatives improves performance by up to about 17% while reducing token usage by up to about 35% in some settings. In the medical setting, contributions to diagnostic accuracy and ethical alignment are often decoupled.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the unified framework, especially how the metric, coalition distribution, and removal protocol jointly define an attribution query. Then read the empirical comparison between LOO and Shapley-style methods, and the contrast among ablation, introspective judging, and model replacement. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the decomposition of counterfactual evaluation signals, not the specific application domains.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 §3 的形式化和 LOO 对比；它给 agent 系统调参一个干净基线，也提醒别用自省 judge 代替真实 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the formalism and LOO comparison in §3; it gives agent tuning a clean baseline and warns against replacing ablations with introspective judges.

paper.title: RICE-PO: Turning Retrieval Interactions into Credit Signals for Reasoning Agents
paper.abstract: Retrieval is increasingly moving from one-shot matching toward interactive reasoning, where language agents iteratively inspect evidence, reformulate queries, and search again. Training such agents raises a credit-assignment challenge: executable actions such as queries or summaries can be directly evaluated by the retriever, while latent reasoning steps are not directly observable and only affect future executable actions. This asymmetry makes outcome-level reward assignment unreliable, as the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是交互式检索推理 agent 中的信用分配问题：查询、摘要这类可执行动作能直接用检索器打分，但中间 reasoning span 只是影响后续查询，不能直接观测。只用最终检索奖励做 RL，容易把奖励错误分配给并未真正改变检索结果的推理步骤。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 阶段的训练信号设计有参考价值。它把工具交互中的可观测反馈转成局部学习信号，重点不是训练更强的 retriever，而是让 reasoning agent 学会哪些中间决策真的影响外部工具结果。这类方法对 RL 数据构造、过程监督替代方案、critic-free policy optimization 都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: RICE-PO 的核心做法是利用检索任务中“可执行动作”和“潜在推理动作”的不对称性。每一轮 agent 先生成 reasoning segment，再生成 summary/query，summary 会送入固定 retriever 得到文档和检索指标。方法先用三个诊断量选择值得检查的局部决策点：policy uncertainty 用高熵 summary 找模型不确定的位置；reasoning-to-summary influence 检查不同 reasoning continuation 是否导致不同 summary 奖励；future residual stability 检查后续轮次是否保留当前局部奖励差异，而不是被后面的交互完全覆盖。对被选中的锚点，方法从同一历史状态构造局部分支，用 retriever 评价不同 summary，得到 step-specific retrieval reward。只有当 reasoning 对 summary 有足够影响、且未来残差稳定时，才把 summary 的奖励回传给前面的 latent reasoning span。它不训练 critic，也不依赖 process reward model，而是用检索器本身提供的可执行反馈构造局部偏好信号。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 BRIGHT 和 BEIR 检索任务，比较对象包括 prompt-based 交互式 agent 和 group-based RL baseline。论文报告 RICE-PO 在这些任务上有稳定提升，并做了几类分析：高不确定性点选择是否有效，局部 retrieval feedback 的质量，latent reasoning credit propagation 是否可靠，以及 counterfactual branching 带来的额外成本。给定材料中没有提供具体 NDCG、Recall 或训练规模数字，因此不应过度解读提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议看引言、Preliminaries 和方法部分中三个 branch diagnostics 的定义。重点关注两点：第一，为什么 summary 可以直接打检索奖励，而 reasoning 不能直接打；第二，future residual stability 如何避免把后续轮次造成的收益错误归因到当前 reasoning。实验部分可快速看 BRIGHT/BEIR 主结果和 branching cost 分析，预计 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in interactive retrieval agents. Executable actions such as generated queries or summaries can be directly evaluated by a retriever, while latent reasoning spans only affect future executable actions. A final outcome reward is therefore too coarse and can reward reasoning tokens that did not causally improve retrieval.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for post-training signal design. It shows how tool interactions can be converted into localized learning signals without a learned critic or a separate process reward model. The most relevant lesson for foundation-model training is the treatment of observability: only actions with direct environmental feedback should receive direct credit, while latent reasoning needs gated attribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: RICE-PO models each retrieval episode as multiple rounds. At each round, the policy emits a reasoning segment and then a summary segment; the summary is used as the next retrieval query and receives retrieval feedback. The method selects critical decision points using three diagnostics: policy uncertainty, which finds high-entropy executable summaries; reasoning-to-summary influence, which checks whether alternative reasoning continuations change the summary reward; and future residual stability, which verifies that the local reward difference is not later overturned. For selected anchors, it builds local counterfactual branches from the same history, evaluates the resulting summaries with retrieval metrics, and uses these rewards as step-specific supervision. Rewards are propagated backward to latent reasoning only when the reasoning span has sufficient influence and the future residual remains stable.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on BRIGHT and BEIR retrieval tasks against prompt-based interactive agents and group-based RL baselines. It reports consistent gains and includes analyses of uncertainty-based anchor selection, local feedback quality, reliability of backward credit propagation, and the compute cost of counterfactual branching. The provided text does not include exact metric values, model sizes, or training budgets, so the empirical magnitude should be checked in the tables before drawing strong conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction, the formal setup, and the section defining the three branch diagnostics. The key part is the distinction between directly executable summaries and non-executable reasoning spans. The residual-stability gate is also worth checking, because it is the mechanism that prevents later retrieval rounds from corrupting local credit. The main result tables and branching-cost analysis should be enough for a 20–30 minute read.

recommendation.zh: 读方法里 anchor 和 counterfactual credit 的定义；若信号构造干净，可迁移到 tool-use RL 的奖励分解实验。
recommendation.en: Read the definitions of anchors and counterfactual credit; if the signal construction is clean, it is portable to reward decomposition experiments for tool-use RL.

paper.title: Beyond Trajectory-Level Attribution: Graph-Based Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods have achieved remarkable success in improving the performance of large language models (LLMs) and have been rapidly extended to agentic tasks. However, their credit assignment relies heavily on coarse-grained trajectory-level attribution according to final outcomes, making it difficult to capture the contribution of individual steps, such as valuable steps obscured within failed trajectories. To uncover latent information and enable more faithful s

summary.core_problem: 现有的基于组的强化学习（如 GRPO）在多轮智能体任务中，依赖于粗粒度的轨迹级归因（仅根据最终成败分配奖励），无法准确捕捉单个步骤的贡献，导致信用分配存在噪声且效率低下。
summary.importance: 打破了轨迹级归因的限制，提出了一种基于图的细粒度信用分配方法，能够挖掘失败轨迹中的有价值步骤和成功轨迹中的冗余步骤，显著提升了智能体强化学习的训练效率，且保持了无 Critic 架构的轻量级优势。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GraphGPO（Graph-based Group Policy Optimization）。该方法将所有 rollout 轨迹聚合为一个统一的状态转移图（节点为状态，边为步骤）。利用图中的全局信息，估计每个状态到任务目标的距离，从而为每个步骤分配奖励，摆脱了对单条轨迹的依赖。最后，将源自同一状态的出边分组，估计基于图的优势函数，用于策略优化。
summary.experiments: （摘要未提供具体实验结果数字，但提到）相比之前的方法，GraphGPO 实现了更忠实的步骤级信用分配，显著提高了训练效率，且引入的图计算开销可忽略不计，实现了稳定的收敛。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对轨迹级归因缺陷的分析（图1的统计数据），以及 GraphGPO 如何构建状态转移图并计算基于图的优势函数。适合快速了解智能体 RL 信用分配的新思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing group-based RL methods (e.g., GRPO) for multi-turn agentic tasks rely on coarse-grained trajectory-level attribution (assigning rewards based solely on final outcomes), failing to accurately capture the contribution of individual steps, leading to noisy credit assignment and inefficient learning.
summary_en.importance: Breaks the limitations of trajectory-level attribution by proposing a graph-based, fine-grained credit assignment method. It uncovers valuable steps in failed trajectories and redundant steps in successful ones, significantly improving training efficiency for agentic RL while maintaining the lightweight advantage of a critic-free architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes GraphGPO (Graph-based Group Policy Optimization). It aggregates all rollout trajectories into a unified state-transition graph (nodes are states, edges are steps). Leveraging global graph information, it estimates the distance from each state to the task goal to assign step-level rewards, independent of individual trajectories. Finally, outgoing edges from the same state are grouped to estimate graph-based advantages for policy optimization.
summary_en.experiments: (Specific experimental numbers are not provided in the abstract, but it mentions) Compared to previous methods, GraphGPO achieves more faithful step-level credit assignment, significantly improves training efficiency, and achieves stable convergence with negligible graph computation overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of trajectory-level attribution flaws in the Introduction (statistics in Figure 1) and how GraphGPO constructs the state-transition graph and calculates graph-based advantages. Suitable for a quick overview of new ideas in credit assignment for agentic RL.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法图和 advantage 定义；若实现不依赖强状态去重，它会改变 agent RL 的归因默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and advantage definition; if it avoids brittle state deduplication, it can shift the default credit-assignment setup for agent RL.

paper.title: UnityMAS-O: A General RL Optimization Framework for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems decompose complex tasks into interacting roles, but most remain manually orchestrated by prompts, tools, and control rules, while agents are rarely optimized through a unified reinforcement learning interface. Existing RL post-training frameworks mainly target single-policy optimization and lack abstractions for user-defined multi-agent workflows, structured interaction, role-specific credit assignment, and configurable parameter sharing.   We present UnityMAS-O, a

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 多智能体系统缺少统一 RL 优化接口的问题，尤其是工作流级优化、角色级 credit assignment 和参数共享配置难以统一表达。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是系统框架与抽象层设计，而不是新的预训练或后训练算法。对研究员的价值在于：它把多智能体 workflow 作为 RL 优化单元，提供了一个较清晰的实验接口，便于研究 role decomposition、共享参数与奖励分配。
summary.technical_approach: UnityMAS-O 用四个一等对象描述多智能体 RL：逻辑角色、图结构轨迹、用户定义奖励、agent-model 映射。它把逻辑 agent 与物理模型参数解耦，支持全共享、全分离和部分共享，并允许在角色、轮次和轨迹层面分配奖励。核心创新是 workflow-level RL abstraction，而非单一 policy 的 PPO/DPO 变体。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和提升幅度，只能确认其目标是覆盖用户自定义多 agent 工作流，并比较不同参数共享和奖励分配策略。缺少 clean setup、强 baseline 和规模信息，当前更像研究基础设施而非结论性算法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the lack of a unified RL optimization interface for LLM-based multi-agent systems, especially for workflow-level optimization, role-specific credit assignment, and configurable parameter sharing.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a systems/framework abstraction rather than a new pretraining or post-training algorithm. Its value is that it treats the whole multi-agent workflow as the RL unit, which can help study role decomposition, parameter sharing, and reward allocation in a cleaner setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: UnityMAS-O models multi-agent RL with four first-class objects: logical roles, graph trajectories, user-defined rewards, and agent-model mappings. It decouples logical agents from physical model parameters, enabling full sharing, full separation, and partial sharing, with rewards assignable at role, turn, and trajectory levels. The novelty is the workflow-level RL abstraction, not a new PPO/DPO-style optimizer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or gains. It appears designed to support user-defined multi-agent workflows and compare parameter-sharing and reward-allocation strategies. Without strong baselines, scale details, or clean ablations in the abstract, it reads more like research infrastructure than a definitive algorithmic result.

recommendation.zh: 更像多-agent RL 实验平台，不直接改 pretrain prior；若你在做 role-sharing 或 workflow credit assignment，只看抽象接口设计，效果数字先别太当真。
recommendation.en: This is closer to a multi-agent RL research scaffold than a result that changes pretraining priors; read it for the abstraction, not for headline gains.

paper.title: Credit Assignment with Resets in Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Contemporary reinforcement learning with verifiable reward methods post-train language models on multi-step reasoning by assigning a single outcome reward uniformly across all tokens in a trajectory. Such uniform assignment ignores which steps contributed to success or failure. Improving credit assignment can address this limitation by enabling targeted refinement of faulty reasoning steps, rather than updating entire trajectories uniformly. Resets are one such simple mechanism, enabling more pr

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 RLVR 训练长链推理时的信用分配问题。现有 GRPO 类方法通常把一个最终可验证奖励均匀传播到整条轨迹，导致正确步骤、错误步骤、无关步骤都被同等更新。对长 CoT 来说，这会稀释训练信号，也会让模型难以针对真正出错的位置改进。
summary.importance: 这是对推理后训练方法的实质改进，也对预训练研究有间接价值。关键点是把“结果奖励”变成更局部的“从某个状态继续生成后的反事实结果差异”。这提供了一种不依赖人工过程标注的过程级训练信号。对做 RL pretrain、long reasoning data、annealing/posttrain 接口的人来说，价值在于训练信号质量：不是简单增加 rollout 数量，而是把 rollout 放在更可能改变成败的中间状态上。理论部分也给出清楚解释：如果可改进状态在当前策略下出现概率为 pπ，那么只在这些状态 reset 可以把样本复杂度改善一个 1/pπ² 量级，并把单轮策略提升放大 1/pπ。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 reset。先从失败推理轨迹中选一个中间状态，把它当成共享前缀，然后从这个状态重新采样多个 suffix continuation。由于这些续写共享相同前缀，它们最终成功或失败的差异更容易归因到 reset 点之后的决策。训练时只对 suffix tokens 做 policy-gradient 更新，而不是更新整条原始轨迹。RRPO 随机选择 reset 状态，提供一个简单基线。SRPO 则让模型自定位失败轨迹中的第一个错误步骤，然后从该位置 reset；它不需要外部 step-level label，利用模型已有的自我错误定位能力近似 credit-assignment oracle。理论上，作者用 Conservative Policy Iteration 构造两个版本：CPI-RR 从随机 reset 状态更新，CPI-CARO 假设有一个 oracle 能判断某状态是否存在 advantage 超过阈值 τ 的改进行动。这个 oracle 版本解释了为什么 reset 到“可改进状态”比随机 reset 更有效，也为 SRPO 的设计提供依据。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖十个推理 benchmark，包含数学、科学、策略和常识推理。SRPO 优于 GRPO，以及带自我修正或 shared-prefix continuation 的 contemporaneous RL 基线。在代码任务 LiveCodeBench 上，SRPO 收敛到更高 pass rate，并且相对 GRPO 和 RRPO 学习速度快 2–3 倍。消融的重点不只是最终分数，而是 reset 位置质量：更干净的 prefix 带来更高 correction rate，clean prefixes 的修正成功率接近 erroneous prefixes 的 2 倍。结果支持一个实际判断：reset 本身有用，但收益高度依赖错误定位质量；如果 reset 点选在已经被污染的前缀之后，后续采样组的学习信号会明显变差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。优先看 Introduction 中对 RLVR 信用分配问题的表述和 Figure 1；再看算法部分中 RRPO 与 SRPO 的 rollout 组织方式，尤其是只更新 suffix tokens 的细节；理论部分重点读 CPI-RR、CPI-CARO 和 Theorem 1，理解 pπ 因子如何进入样本复杂度与单轮改进；实验部分重点看十个 benchmark 总表、LiveCodeBench 曲线，以及 self-localization quality 的消融。值得深挖的问题有三个：第一，self-localization 错误会不会引入系统性负反馈；第二，reset suffix 更新和 KL 约束如何平衡，避免局部修正破坏整体推理风格；第三，这类方法能否前移到 mid-training 或高质量推理数据生成，而不只用于最终 RL 后训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in RLVR for long-form reasoning. Standard GRPO-style training uses a single verifiable outcome reward and applies it broadly across the whole trajectory. This makes correct, incorrect, and irrelevant reasoning steps receive nearly the same learning signal, which is especially inefficient for long chains of thought.
summary_en.importance: This is a meaningful step for reasoning post-training and a useful signal-design result for pretraining researchers. The central idea is to turn outcome reward into a more localized counterfactual signal: restart from an intermediate reasoning state, sample several continuations, and compare their outcomes. This gives a process-like learning signal without human step-level supervision. The theoretical result is also useful: if improvable states occur with on-policy probability pπ, concentrating resets on those states improves sample complexity by a factor of 1/pπ² and increases per-iteration improvement by 1/pπ compared with random resets.
summary_en.technical_approach: The shared primitive is reset-based rollout generation. Given a failed trajectory, the method selects an intermediate state as a shared prefix, samples multiple suffix continuations from that state, and applies policy-gradient updates only to the suffix tokens. Since the continuations share the same prefix, differences in final outcome can be attributed more directly to decisions after the reset point. RRPO chooses the reset state uniformly at random. SRPO asks the model to self-localize the first erroneous reasoning step and resets there, requiring no external process labels. The theory section formalizes this through Conservative Policy Iteration. CPI-RR samples random reset states, while CPI-CARO assumes an oracle that tests whether a state is improvable, meaning that it admits an action whose advantage exceeds a threshold τ. This oracle construction clarifies why targeted resets can be much more sample-efficient than random resets, and SRPO is an approximate practical version using self-localization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical suite spans ten reasoning benchmarks covering math, science, strategic reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. SRPO outperforms GRPO and contemporary baselines based on self-correction or shared-prefix continuation. On LiveCodeBench, SRPO reaches a higher pass rate and learns 2–3 times faster than GRPO and RRPO. The most informative ablation concerns localization quality: clean prefixes correct nearly twice as often as erroneous prefixes. This supports the main mechanism. Resets help, but their benefit depends strongly on whether the selected state is actually a useful point for intervention.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the motivation and Figure 1 for the credit-assignment framing. Then inspect the algorithmic details of RRPO and SRPO, especially how suffix groups are formed and why only suffix tokens receive updates. In the theory section, focus on CPI-RR, CPI-CARO, and Theorem 1 to understand where the pπ factors come from. In the experiments, prioritize the aggregate reasoning benchmark table, the LiveCodeBench learning curves, and the self-localization quality ablations. The main open questions are whether incorrect self-localization can create systematic negative updates, how suffix-only updates interact with KL control, and whether reset-based learning can be moved earlier into mid-training or reasoning data generation.

recommendation.zh: 应把 reset 当作 RLVR credit assignment 的最小可复现实验；先看算法和保守更新分析，再决定是否进内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Treat resets as a minimal RLVR credit-assignment ablation; read the algorithm and conservative-update analysis before porting it internally.

paper.title: Not only where, But when: Temporal Scheduling for RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a core technique for post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs). While policy optimization is driven by all sampled tokens under a globally broadcast scalar reward, the heterogeneous policy behaviors exhibited along trajectories are largely overlooked without differentiation. Existing works address this by credit allocation, including token-level advantage reweighting, and selective token optimization, however, the allocation cr

summary.core_problem: 在基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，现有的信用分配（credit allocation）方法通常在整个训练过程中使用固定的分配标准，忽略了训练动态中不同阶段对不同策略行为的优化需求。
summary.importance: 提出在 RLVR 优化中引入时间维度（temporal scheduling），指出“何时”调度学习信号与“何处”分配信号同样重要，为 RLVR 训练动态的控制提供了一个新的、正交的优化维度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出在训练过程中动态调度信用分配标准：在训练初期优先优化由分配标准强调的特定 token（例如通过优势重加权或稀疏 token 优化），然后随着训练的进行逐渐衰减，过渡到一般的全 token 优化。此外，发现简单的轨迹百分比（trajectory percentiles）可以作为一种有效的调度标准，即先从后续 token（可靠的延续）开始调度，逐步纳入早期 token（可靠的推理脚手架）。
summary.experiments: 在不同模型规模和 RLVR 算法（如 GRPO）上，结合连续优势重加权和离散稀疏 token 优化等现有信用分配策略，实验表明时间调度能带来一致的性能提升，并能有效缓解标准 RLVR 优化中因适应异构策略行为而导致的策略熵下降问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Introduction 中对现有静态信用分配局限性的分析，以及如何将时间调度与现有方法结合的具体实现细节。分析部分关于策略熵变化的讨论也值得一读。

summary_en.core_problem: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), existing credit allocation methods typically employ stagnant allocation criteria throughout the training process, neglecting the evolving optimization needs for different policy behaviors during training dynamics.
summary_en.importance: Introduces the temporal dimension to RLVR optimization, arguing that 'when' learning signals are scheduled is as crucial as 'where' they are allocated, providing a novel and orthogonal dimension for controlling RLVR training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes to dynamically schedule credit allocation criteria over the course of training: prioritizing specific tokens emphasized by the allocation criteria (e.g., via advantage reweighting or sparse token optimization) in the early stages, and gradually attenuating towards general full-token optimization. Furthermore, identifies simple trajectory percentiles as an effective scheduling criterion, starting with later tokens (trustworthy continuation) and incrementally incorporating earlier tokens (reliable reasoning scaffolding).
summary_en.experiments: Across various model scales and RLVR algorithms (e.g., GRPO), combining with existing credit allocation strategies like continuous advantage reweighting and discrete sparse token optimization, experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements. It also effectively mitigates the drop in policy entropy caused by accommodating heterogeneous policy behaviors in standard RLVR optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the analysis of the limitations of stagnant credit allocation, and the specific implementation details of how temporal scheduling is combined with existing methods. The analysis section discussing the changes in policy entropy is also worth reading.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation：若调度优于静态 token credit，它会影响 RLVR 数据和 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations: if scheduling beats static token credit, it affects how RLVR losses and data are designed.

paper.title: From Reasoning Chains to Verifiable Subproblems: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning Enables Credit Assignment for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has shown strong promise for LLM reasoning, but outcome-based RLVR remains inefficient on hard problems because correct final-answer rollouts are rare and sample-level credit assignment cannot use partial progress in failed attempts. We introduce SCRL (Subproblem Curriculum Reinforcement Learning), a curriculum RL framework that derives verifiable subproblems from reference reasoning chains and fixes the final subproblem as the original probl

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 RLVR 在难题上的信用分配问题。标准 GRPO/RLVR 依赖最终答案奖励；如果同一题的一组采样全错，组内归一化后没有有效梯度。即使有接近正确的推理轨迹，最终答案错误也会让整段 rollout 得到同样的负反馈。作者要解决的是：如何让模型仍然保持 on-policy 探索，同时从难题中的中间进展得到可验证、可归因的训练信号。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在 post-train RL 与预训练能力边界的接口处。它不是简单增加数学题或模仿专家解，而是把专家解拆成一组可验证子问题，让难题从“全错无梯度”的区域变成“前几步可学习”的课程。对基座研究的启发在于：能力提升不只取决于题目难度，还取决于训练目标能否在模型当前能力边界附近产生非退化梯度。这个思路也可以迁移到代码、长程推理、工具使用等有中间状态可验证的任务。
summary.technical_approach: SCRL 包含三步。第一，给定原题和参考解，用外部 LLM 离线构造 K 个从易到难的可验证子问题，最后一个子问题固定为原题。子问题不是提示模型照着专家前缀继续写，而是要求模型在一次 on-policy rollout 中依次回答所有子问题。这样，中间结论需要模型自己生成，而不是由提示直接提供。第二，对每个子问题答案独立验证，并做 progress-aware correction：只保留从第一个子问题开始的最长连续正确前缀。例如奖励 [1,1,0,1] 会被改成 [1,1,0,0]，避免模型在没有建立前序结论时偶然答对后续问题也得到信用。第三，做 subproblem-level normalization：在每个子问题位置上独立归一化奖励，并把对应 advantage 分配给该子问题的答案 span，而不是把一个样本级 advantage 分给整段推理。为减少训练和原始推理格式的错配，作者还使用 mixed-group training，同时优化带子问题课程的 rollout 和原始问题 rollout。和 SFT/离线模仿相比，SCRL 保留 on-policy 分布；和给专家前缀的 curriculum RL 相比，它不把关键中间结论直接放进上下文，而是把这些结论变成模型需要求解的可验证目标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个数学推理 benchmark，使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-14B 作为主要模型。相对强 curriculum-learning baseline，SCRL 在 Qwen3-4B / 14B 上分别带来 +4.1 / +1.9 平均分提升。在 3 个困难 benchmark 上，报告了 +3.7 pass@1 和 +4.6 pass@64 的提升。消融结果支持两个关键判断：一是 subproblem-level credit assignment 比只看最终答案更有效；二是方法不强依赖高度人工筛选的子问题，也不强依赖特别强的子问题生成器。理论部分给出 metric recovery 分析：把原始问题的策略流形提升到子问题乘积流形后，困难问题中原本退化的梯度信号可以被较早子问题恢复，且原题越难，相对恢复比例越高。实验趋势与这个解释一致。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分的三个细节：子问题生成约束、progress-aware correction、subproblem-level normalization。核心创新在第三点，但前两点决定了奖励信号是否干净。理论部分重点看 gradient dead zone 与 metric recovery 的形式化定义，判断它是否只是解释性分析，还是能指导后续课程构造。实验部分优先看 7 个 benchmark 的主表、困难题 pass@1/pass@64 结果、以及消融表。最值得深挖的是 mixed-group training：它直接关系到课程格式训练是否会损害模型在原始问题格式下的推理能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete failure mode of RLVR on hard reasoning problems: outcome-only rewards give little or no usable credit when all sampled rollouts fail, and a near-miss solution receives the same rollout-level signal as an immediate failure. The central question is how to extract verifiable intermediate learning signals from hard problems while keeping the policy on its own on-policy exploration distribution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits at the interface between RL post-training and capability expansion. Instead of adding more hard math problems or imitating expert traces, the method changes the reward granularity so that difficult prompts can still produce non-degenerate gradients near the model’s current capability boundary. This is relevant beyond math RLVR: code repair, tool use, theorem proving, and long-horizon agent tasks all have variants where intermediate states may be made verifiable.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCRL first uses an external LLM and a reference solution to derive an ordered curriculum of K verifiable subproblems. The final subproblem is the original problem. The policy is then asked to answer all K subproblems in a single on-policy rollout. This differs from prefix-hint curricula: the intermediate facts are not injected as fixed context; the model must derive them itself. Each subproblem answer is verified separately. A progress-aware correction keeps only the longest consecutive solved prefix, so a reward vector such as [1,1,0,1] becomes [1,1,0,0]. This prevents accidental success on later subproblems from receiving credit when earlier dependencies were not solved. The key optimization step is subproblem-level normalization: rewards are normalized independently at each subproblem position, and the resulting advantages are assigned to the corresponding answer spans. The method also uses mixed-group training, jointly optimizing curriculum rollouts and original-problem rollouts to reduce prompt-format mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B and evaluate on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks. SCRL improves over strong curriculum-learning baselines by +4.1 average points on Qwen3-4B and +1.9 average points on Qwen3-14B. On three hard benchmarks, it reports +3.7 pass@1 and +4.6 pass@64 gains. Ablations indicate that subproblem-level credit assignment is a major source of the gain, and that the method does not require heavily curated subproblems or an unusually strong subproblem generator. The theoretical analysis frames the effect as metric recovery: decomposing a hard problem into a product of subproblem spaces can recover gradients from earlier solvable parts, with larger relative recovery as the original problem becomes harder.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the method section closely, especially the construction of verifiable subproblems, progress-aware correction, and subproblem-level normalization. The normalization rule is the main algorithmic change, while the correction rule is important for reward validity. In the theory section, focus on the definition of gradient dead zones and the metric recovery argument. In the experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, hard-benchmark pass@1/pass@64 results, and ablations on credit assignment and subproblem generation quality. The mixed-group training design is also worth checking because it addresses whether curriculum-formatted training transfers back to the original prompt format.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现子问题级 advantage 的 ablation；它可能改变 outcome-only RLVR 在难题上够用的 prior。
recommendation.en: The subproblem-level advantage ablation is worth reproducing immediately; it challenges the prior that outcome-only RLVR is enough on hard reasoning.
